Essuula XV Wulira, Ayi Mukama, okusaba kwange; emmeeme yange ereme kuggwaamu maanyi wansi w’okukangavvula kwo, era nange nneme kuggwaamu maanyi mu kukwatulira okusaasira kwo kwonna, kwe wanzigya mu makubo gange gonna amabi ennyo, olyoke obeere essanyu gye ndi okusinga okusikiriza kwonna kwe nnagobereranga edda; ndyoke nkwagale n’omutima gwange gwonna, era nkwate omukono gwo n’okwagala kwange kwonna, era olyoke ondokole mu buli kukemebwa, okutuusa ku nkomerero. Kubanga laba, Ayi Mukama, Kabaka wange era Katonda wange, buli kintu ekigasa obuto bwange kye bwayiga kibeere kya kukuweereza; kya kukuweereza, nti njogera, mpandiika, nsoma, mbala. Kubanga wampa okukangavvula kwo, bwe nnali nga njiga ebitaliimu; era ekibi kyange eky’okusanyukira ebitaliimu ebyo wakisonyiwa. Mu byo, mazima, nnayigiramu ebigambo bingi ebigasa, naye ebyo biyinza okuyigibwa ne mu bintu ebitali bya butaliimu; era eryo lye kkubo ery’obukuumi ebigere by’obuvubuka mwe bisaanira okutambulira. Essuula XVI Naye zikusanze ggwe, omugga ogw’amaanyi ogw’empisa z’abantu! Ani alikuyimirira? olituusa ddi obutakalira? olituusa ddi okusiikuula abaana ba Kaawa okubatwala mu nnyanja eyo ennene era ey’entiisa, ne abo abalinnya ku musaalaba mwe basomokera ne kibazibuwalira? Saasoma mu ggwe ebya Jove ow’okubwatuka era omwenzi? byombi, awatali kubuusabuusa, teyandisobodde kubiba; naye bwe kityo okubwatuka okw’obulimba kusobole okuwagira n’okutumbula obwenzi obwa nnamaddala. Era kaakano ani ku basomesa baffe abambala ebyambalo ebiwanvu awuliriza n’okutu okutebenkevu oyo ayogerera waggulu ng’ava mu ssomero lyabwe bennyini nti, “Bino byali bifumo bya Homer, ng’atwala eby’abantu ku bakatonda; singa yatuleetera eby’obwakatonda!” Naye yandyogedde mazima okusingawo singa yagamba nti, “Bino mazima bifumo bye; naye ng’awa abantu ababi obutonde obw’obwakatonda, emisango gireme kuba nate misango, era buli agikola alabike ng’agoberera, si bantu abaayonooneka ddala, wabula bakatonda ab’omu ggulu.” Era naye, ggwe omugga ogw’omu ggeyeena, mu ggwe mwe basuulibwa abaana b’abantu nga bawebwa empeera ennene, olw’okufuna okuyiga okwo; era bakikolera omukolo omunene, nga kino kikolebwa mu kibangirizi ky’olukiiko, mu maaso g’amateeka agateekawo omusaala ogw’okwongerako ku bye abayizi basasula; era ggwe okuba enjazi zo n’owuluguma nti, “Wano ebigambo we biyigirwa; wano we bayigira okwogera obulungi; ekyetaagisa ennyo okutuukiriza by’oyagala, oba okunyweza endowooza.” Ng’olinga tetwandimanyidde ebigambo nga “enkuba eya zaabu,” “ebisambi,” “okusendasenda,” “amasinzizo g’eggulu,” oba ebirala mu kitundu ekyo, singa Terence teyaleeta ku siteegi omuvubuka omukaba, ng’assaawo Jupiter ng’ekyokulabirako kye eky’okusendasenda. “Ng’atunuulira ekifaananyi, olugero mwe lwali luteekeddwa, Jove bwe yakka ng’enkuba eya zaabu Mu bisambi bya Danae okusendasenda omukazi.” Era olwo laba bw’asikiriza yekka okwegomba okw’obukaba ng’alinga alina obuyinza obw’omu ggulu: “Era katonda ki? Jove omukulu, Akankanya amasinzizo g’eggulu agasingayo waggulu n’okubwatuka kwe, Nange, omuntu omunaku afa, sikole bwe ntyo! Nnakikola, era n’omutima gwange gwonna nnakikola.” Ebigambo tebiyigibwa mangu n’akatono okusingawo olw’obugwenyufu buno bwonna; naye olw’ebyo obugwenyufu bukolebwa n’ensonyi entono. Si nti nnenya ebigambo, kubanga biri, ng’okugamba, bibya ebirondemu era eby’omuwendo; wabula omwenge ogwo ogw’ensobi gwe tunywesebwa mu byo abasomesa abatamiivu; era bwe tutanywa naffe, tukubibwa, ne tubulwa omulamuzi atali mutamiivu gwe tuyinza okujulirira. Kyokka, Ayi Katonda wange (mu maaso go kaakano mwe nsobola okujjukira kino awatali kufuna kabi), ebyo byonna nnabiyiga mu nnaku nga njagala, n’essanyu lingi, era olw’ekyo ne bannangirira okuba omwana asuubirwamu ebirungi. Essuula XVII Ngumiikiriza, Ayi Katonda wange, nga njogera katono ku magezi gange, ekirabo kyo, ne ku busirusiru bwe nnagamalirako. Kubanga nnaweebwa omulimu, ogwali omuzibu ennyo eri emmeeme yange, nga gugenderedde okutenderezebwa oba okuswazibwa, n’okutya emiggo, okwogera ebigambo bya Juno, bwe yali ng’asunguwala era ng’akungubaga nti teyasobola “Okukyusa omulangira ono ow’e Troy okuva e Latinum.” Ebigambo ebyo nnali mpulidde nti Juno teyabyogera n’akatono; naye twakakibwa okubula nga tugoberera ebigere by’enfumo zino ez’ebitontome, n’okwogera mu bigambo ebya bulijjo kumpi ekyo kye yayogera mu bitontome. Era okwogera kw’oyo kwe kwasinga okutenderezebwa, eyasinga okulaga obusungu n’ennaku, nga byambaziddwa ebigambo ebisinga okusaanira, ng’akuuma ekitiibwa ky’omuntu gw’ayogerako. Kiki ekyo gye ndi, Ayi obulamu bwange obw’amazima, Katonda wange, nti okwogera kwange kwatenderezebwa okusinga bangi ab’emyaka gyange n’omutendera gwange? ebyo byonna si mukka na mpewo? era tewaali kirala kye nnandikozesezza okukulaakulanya amagezi gange n’olulimi lwange? Okukutendereza, Ayi Mukama, okukutendereza kwandiwaniridde ettabi ly’omutima gwange eryali likyali eggonvu n’omuti ogw’Ebyawandiikibwa byo; bwe kityo teryandiwalulidde mu bintu ebyo ebitaliimu, ng’omuyiggo ogwonoonese eri ennyonyi ez’omu bbanga. Kubanga mu ngeri ezisukka mu emu abantu bawaayo ssaddaaka eri bamalayika abajeemu. Essuula XVIII Naye kya kitalo ki nti nnatwalibwa bwe ntyo mu bitaliimu, ne nva mu maaso go, Ayi Katonda wange, ng’abantu bateekebwa mu maaso gange ng’ebyokulabirako, abo, bwe baanyumyanga ekikolwa kyabwe ekimu ekitali kibi mu kyo kyennyini, ne bakola ensobi mu lulimi oba mu nnyogera, bwe baanenyezebwanga, baakwatibwanga ensonyi; naye bwe baanyumyanga obulamu bwabwe obutalimu nteekateeka mu bigambo ebingi, ebinyirira era ebitegekeddwa obulungi, bwe baatenderezebwanga, beenyumirizanga? Ebyo obiraba, Ayi Mukama, n’osirika; olwawo okusunguwala, ojjudde okwagala n’obwesigwa. Olisirika emirembe gyonna? era ne kaakano Ggwe oggya mu bunnya buno obw’entiisa emmeeme ekunoonya, erina ennyonta y’essanyu lyo, omutima gwayo ogukugamba nti, Nnoonyezza amaaso go; amaaso go, Ayi Mukama, nnaagoonyanga. Kubanga okwegomba okuzikizibwa kwe kukuvaako. Kubanga si na bigere byaffe, oba okukyusa ekifo, abantu kwe bakulekera, oba kwe bakomawo gy’Oli. Oba omwana wo oyo omuto yanoonya embalaasi oba amagaali, oba amaato, n’abuuka n’ebiwaawaatiro ebirabika, oba n’atambula olw’okutambuza ebitundu by’omubiri gwe, alyoke mu nsi ey’ewala asaasaanye mu binyumu byonna bye wamuwa ng’agenda? Ggwe Kitaffe omwagazi bwe wamuwa, era omwagazi gy’ali n’okusingawo bwe yakomawo nga talina kantu. Kale mu kwegomba okw’obukaba, kwe kugamba, okwegomba okuzikizibwa, mwe muli obuwala obwa nnamaddala okuva ku maaso go. Laba, Ayi Mukama Katonda, weewaawo, laba n’obugumiikiriza nga bw’omanyidde, abaana b’abantu bwe bakwata n’obwegendereza amateeka ag’endagaano ag’ennukuta n’ebitundu by’ebigambo, ge baaweebwa abo abaayogera nga bo tebannabaawo, nga balagajjalira endagaano ey’olubeerera ey’obulokozi obutaggwaawo gye baaweebwa Ggwe. N’olwekyo, omusomesa oba omuyizi w’amateeka g’enjatula ag’obusika alinyiiza abantu nnyo bw’anaayogera ng’alekayo ennukuta emu, n’agamba “omutu,” ng’amenya amateeka g’olulimi, okusinga bw’anaaba nga ye, “omuntu,” akyawa “omuntu” ng’amenya amateeka go. Ng’olinga omulabe yenna ayinza okuba ow’akabi okusinga obukyayi bw’amusunguwaliramu; oba ng’ayinza okulumya ennyo oyo gw’ayigganya okusinga bw’alumya emmeeme ye yennyini olw’obulabe bwe. Mazima tewali kumanya kwa nnukuta kuyinza kuba kwa buzaale ng’ekiwandiiko ky’omuntu ow’omunda, “nti akola munne ekyo ky’atandyagadde kukolebwa munne.” Ng’amakubo go tegekkaanyizika, Ayi Katonda, Ggwe wekka omukulu, atuula waggulu ng’osirise, era ng’olw’etteeka eritakoowa ogaba obuzibe bw’amaaso ng’ekibonerezo eri okwegomba okutagondera mateeka. Mu kunoonya ettutumu ly’okwogera obulungi, omuntu ayimiridde mu maaso g’omulamuzi omuntu, ng’ali wakati mu kibiina ky’abantu, ng’ayogera ku mulabe we n’obukyayi obusingirayo ddala, ajja kwegendereza nnyo nnyini, aleme, olw’ensobi y’olulimi, okutta ekigambo “omuntu”; naye tafaayo, aleme, olw’ekiruyi ky’omwoyo gwe, okutta omuntu owa nnamaddala. Eyo ye nsi nze omunaku gye nnali ngalamidde ku mulyango gwayo mu buto bwange; eyo ye siteegi gye nnatyanga ennyo okukola ensobi mu lulimi, okusinga, nga maze okugikola, okukwatirwa obuggya abo abataagikola. Ebyo mbyogera era mbikwatulira Ggwe, Ayi Katonda wange; olw’ebyo nnafuna ettendo okuva eri abo, be nnalowooza mu kiseera ekyo nti okubasanyusa bwe bwali obulungi bwonna. Kubanga saalaba bunnya bwa bugwenyufu, mwe nnasuulibwa okuva mu maaso go. Mu maaso gaabwe kiki ekyali kisinga okuba eky’omuzizo okunsinga nze, nga sisanyusa n’abo abaali nga nze? nga nnimba obulimba obutabalika omusomesa wange, abakulu bange, bazadde bange, olw’okwagala okuzannya, olw’okwegomba okulaba eby’okwesanyusaamu ebitaliimu n’obutateeka mwoyo wansi okubikoppa! Era nnabbanga, mu sitoowa ya bazadde bange ne ku mmeeza yaabwe, ng’okululunkanira kunfuze omuddu, oba ndyoke mbe na kye mpa abalenzi, abantundako omuzannyo gwabwe, gwe baali baagala nga nange bwe nnaguyagala. Mu muzannyo ogwo nate, emirundi mingi nnanoonyanga okuwangula mu bukuusa, nga nange nzenna mpanguddwa okwegomba okutaliimu okw’okusinga abalala. Era kiki kye nnali sisobola kugumiikiriza, oba, bwe nnakizuulanga, kye nnanenyanga n’obukambwe, okusinga ekyo kyennyini kye nnali nkola abalala? era bwe nnazuulibwanga ne nnenyezebwa olw’ekyo, nnalondawo okuyomba okusinga okukkiriza. Era buno bwe butaliiko musango obw’obuto? Si bwe kiri, Ayi Mukama, si bwe kiri; nkwegayirira okusaasira kwo, Ayi Katonda wange. Kubanga ebibi bino byennyini, emyaka egy’okukula bwe gijja, ebibi bino byennyini biva ku basomesa n’abakulu, ku mpeke n’emipiira n’enkazaluggya, ne bidda ku balamuzi ne bakabaka, ku zaabu n’ebyalo n’abaddu, ng’ebibonerezo ebikakali bwe bidda mu kifo ky’omuggo. Kale obuwanvu obutono obw’obuto bwe wasiima, Ggwe Kabaka waffe, ng’akabonero k’obwetoowaze, bwe wagamba nti, Abafaanana ng’abo be bannannyini bwakabaka obw’omu ggulu. Naye, Ayi Mukama, Ggwe Omutonzi era Omufuzi w’ebitonde byonna, asingira ddala ekitiibwa era asingira ddala obulungi, okwebaza kwali kukugwanidde Ggwe Katonda waffe, ne bwe wandinteekeddewo obuto bwokka. Kubanga ne mu kiseera ekyo nnaliwo, nnali mulamu, era nnawulira; era nnalina mu nze okufaayo ku bulamu bwange okwasimbibwa mu nze—akabonero k’Obumu obwo obw’ekyama mwe nnava; nnakuumanga n’okutegeera okw’omunda obulamba bw’obusimu bwange, era mu bintu bino ebitono bye nnagobereranga, ne mu birowoozo byange ku bintu ebitono, nnayiga okusanyukira amazima, nnakyawa okulimbibwa, nnalina okujjukira okw’amaanyi, nnaweebwa ekirabo ky’okwogera, emikwano gyangumyanga omwoyo, nneewalanga obulumi, obuswavu, n’obutamanya. Mu kitonde ekitono bwe kityo, kiki ekitaali kya kitalo, ekitaali kya kwewuunyisa? Naye byonna birabo bya Katonda wange: si nze neebiwa; era birungi, era byonna awamu nze kennyini. Kale mulungi oyo eyantonda, era ye bulungi bwange; era mu maaso ge ndijaguza olwa buli kirungi kye nnalina nga ndi mwana. Kubanga ekibi kyange kyali kino, nti si mu ye, wabula mu bitonde bye—nze kennyini n’abalala—mwe nnanoonyeza essanyu, obukulu, amazima, era bwe ntyo ne ngwa butereevu mu nnaku, mu kutabulwa, mu nsobi. Weebale Ggwe, essanyu lyange n’ekitiibwa kyange n’obwesige bwange, Katonda wange, weebale Ggwe olw’ebirabo byo; naye Ggwe bikuumire nze. Kubanga bw’otyo bw’olinkuuma, era ebyo bye wampa birigaziwa ne bituukirizibwa, era nze kennyini ndibeera na Ggwe, kubanga n’okubaawo Ggwe wakimpa.

fields.title: Ekitabo II
fields.body_html:
Essuula I

Kaakano njagala okujjukira obugwagwa bwange obw’edda, n’obwonoonefu bw’omubiri obwayonoona emmeeme yange; si lwa kuba nti mbyagala, wabula ndyoke nkwagale Ggwe, Ayi Katonda wange. Kino nkikola olw’okwagala okwagala kwo; nga nzirayo mu makubo gange amabi ennyo nga nzijukira n’obukaawu bungi, Ggwe olyoke ombeere omuwoomu (Ggwe obuwoomi obutaggwaawo, Ggwe obuwoomi obw’essanyu era obwesigika); era ng’onkuŋŋaanya nate okuva mu kusaasaana kwange, mwe nnayuzibwayuzibwamu ebitundutundu, bwe nnali nga nkukubye amabega Ggwe, Omu Omulungi, ne nneebulira mu bintu ebingi ennyo. Kubanga mu buvubuka bwange edda nnayakirira okwekkusa ebintu eby’ensi wansi; ne nneetantala okuddamu okufuuka ensiko, nga nneemalira ku kwagala okw’engeri nnyingi okw’ebisiikirize: obulungi bwange ne buggwaawo, ne mpunya bubi mu maaso go; nga nneesanyusa nze kennyini, era nga njagala okusiimibwa mu maaso g’abantu.

Essuula II

Era kiki kye nnasanyukiranga, wabula okwagala n’okwagalibwa? Naye saakuuma kigero kya kwagala, okw’omwoyo eri omwoyo, ensalo y’omukwano eyakaayakana: wabula okuva mu kwegomba okw’omubiri okw’ebisooto, n’okubugujja kw’obuvubuka, ne muvaamu olufu olwabikka era ne luzikiza omutima gwange, ne siyinza kwawula kumasamasa kwa kwagala okutangaavu ku kifu ky’okwegomba okw’obukaba. Byombi byabugujjiranga mu nze nga bitabuddwatabuddwa, ne bisindika obuvubuka bwange obutaliiko kibuziyiza ne bugwa mu kiwonvu eky’okwegomba okutali kutukuvu, ne binnyika mu bunnya bw’ebikolwa eby’obuswavu. Obusungu bwo bwali bunkuŋŋaanidde ku mutwe, so nga sikimanyi. Nnali nzibye amatu olw’okukubagana kw’olujegere lw’obufa bwange, kye kibonerezo ky’amalala g’emmeeme yange, ne nkyama ne ngenda wala okuva gy’Oli, nawe n’ondeka, ne nsuukundibwa, ne nnyonooneka, ne nsaasaana, ne mbugujja nga mpitirira mu bwenzi bwange, nawe n’osirika, Ayi Ggwe essanyu lyange eryalwawo! Mu biseera ebyo wasirika, nange ne mbungeeta nga neeyongera okuva gy’Oli wala nnyo nnyo, nga nnyingira mu nnimiro ez’ennaku ezitabala ebibala ezisingawo n’okusingawo, nga ndi mu kunakuwala okw’amalala, ne mu bukoowu obutawummula.

Woowe! Singa omuntu yenna mu biseera ebyo yaluŋŋamya obutabanguko bwange, n’akozesa bulungi obulungi obuyitawo obw’ebintu bino, ensonda ezisembayo ez’obutonde bwo! Singa yassa ekkomo ku ssanyu lyabyo, amayengo g’obuvubuka bwange galyoke geesuule ku lubalama lw’obufumbo, bwe gaali gatasobola kukkakkana, ne gakuumirwa mu kigendererwa eky’okuzaala abaana, nga etteeka lyo bwe liragira, Ayi Mukama: Ggwe abumba mu ngeri eno ezzadde ly’obufa bwaffe buno, kubanga osobola n’omukono omukkakkamu okufufuggaza amaggwa agaagobwa mu lusuku lwo? Kubanga obuyinza bwo obw’ekitalo tebuli wala naffe, newaakubadde nga ffe tuli wala naawe. Oba nnandibadde mpuliriza n’obwegendereza obusingawo eddoboozi eriva mu bire: Wabula abafumbo, obufumbo bujja kubaleetera emitawaana gye nandiyagadde mwewale. Era kirungi omusajja obutakwatanga ku mukazi. Era, Omusajja atali mufumbo yeemalira ku bya Mukama, engeri gy’asanyusa Mukama; Naye omufumbo yeeraliikirira bya nsi, nga bw’anaasanyusa mukazi we.

Ebigambo bino nnandibadde mbiwuliriza n’obwegendereza obusingawo, era bwe nnandyawuddwa olw’obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, nnandirindiridde n’essanyu erisingawo okugwa mu kifuba kyo; naye nze, omunaku, ne mbimba ng’ennyanja esiikuuse, nga ngoberera okuyiika kw’amayengo gange, nga nkuleka Ggwe, ne mpitiriza ensalo zo zonna; naye saawona mbooko zo. Kubanga ani ku bafa ayinza okuziwona? Kubanga bulijjo wali nange, ng’onkangavvula n’okusaasira, era ng’ommansira ku masanyu gange gonna agatali ga mateeka obukaawu obusinga obungi: ndyoke nnoonye amasanyu agatatabuddwamu bukaawu. Naye amasanyu ago gye nnandigazudde, saasobola kukimanya, wabula mu Ggwe, Ayi Mukama, Ggwe ayigiriza ng’oyita mu nnaku, era atufumita, olyoke otuwonye; era atutta, tuleme kufa nga tuli wala naawe. Nnali ludda wa, era nnali nnyingidde wala kwenkana wa mu buwaŋŋanguse okuva mu masanyu g’ennyumba yo, mu mwaka ogwo ogw’ekkumi n’omukaaga ogw’emyaka gy’omubiri gwange, obulalu bw’okwegomba (obuntu obutalina nsonyi bwe bukkiriza mu ddembe lyonna, newaakubadde amateeka go nga tegabukkiriza) bwe bwanfuga, ne nneewaayo gye buli ddala? Mu kiseera ekyo abantu bange tebaafaayo kunnyamba kuwona kugwa kwange nga bampasiza; kye baafaako kyokka kwe kuba nti njige okwogera obulungi ennyo, mbeere omwogezi asendasenda.

Essuula III

Kubanga mu mwaka ogwo okusoma kwange kwayimirizibwamu: bwe nnamala okukomawo okuva e Madaura (ekibuga ekiriraanyeewo, gye nnali ŋŋenze okuyiga ebyennimi n’obwogezi), ensimbi ez’olugendo olulala olw’e Carthage nga zinteekerwateekerwa; era ekyo kyava nnyo mu kumalirira kwa kitange okusinga mu bugagga bwe, kubanga yali munnansi wa ddembe omwavu ow’e Thagaste. Kino nkibuulira ani? Si Ggwe, Katonda wange; wabula mu maaso go nkibuulira bantu bannange, wadde ekitundu ekitono eky’abantu ekiyinza okusanga ebiwandiiko byange bino. Era lwaki? Buli anaabisoma alowooze bunnya ki bwe tuteekwa okukukaabiramu. Kubanga kiki ekiri okumpi n’amatu go okusinga omutima ogwatula, n’obulamu obw’okukkiriza? Ani ataatendereza kitange, kubanga, ng’ayitiriza obusobozi bw’eby’obugagga bwe, yali agenda kuwa mutabani we byonna bye yali yeetaaga okugenda olugendo oluwanvu olw’okusoma? Kubanga bannansi bangi abaali n’obusobozi obusingako ennyo tebaakolera baana baabwe bwe batyo. Naye kitange oyo yennyini teyafaayo ku ngeri gye nnali nkula nga nzija gy’Oli, oba nga nnali mulongoofu; kyokka mbe nga mwogezi omulungi, newaakubadde nga nnali mukalu eri okulima kwo, Ayi Katonda, Ggwe Mukama yekka ow’amazima era omulungi ow’ennimiro yo, ye mutima gwange.

Naye bwe nnali mbeera ne bazadde bange mu mwaka ogwo ogw’ekkumi n’omukaaga, nga ndese essomero okumala akabanga (ekiseera eky’obugayaavu nga kiyingiddewo olw’obwavu bwa bazadde bange), amaggwa g’okwegomba okutali kulongoofu ne gamera ne gampitirira ku mutwe, era nga tewali mukono gugakuulamu. Kitange bwe yandaba mu bwogero, nga nkula okufuuka omusajja, era nga nzijudde obuvubuka obutawummula, n’asanyuka n’abuulira mmange, ng’alowooza dda ku bazzukulu be; ng’asanyukira okutabanguka okwo okw’ebiwulizi, ensi mw’ekwerabirira Ggwe Omutonzi waayo, n’eyagala ekitonde kyo mu kifo kyo Ggwe kennyini, olw’omwenge ogutalabika ogw’obwagazi bwayo bwennyini, ng’ekyama era ng’efukamirira ebintu ebisingira ddala okuba ebya wansi. Naye mu kifuba kya mmange wali otandise dda yeekaalu yo, n’omusingi gw’ekifo kyo ekitukuvu w’obeera, so nga kitange yali akyali muyizi eyeeteekerateekera okubatizibwa, era nga kino kyakatandika. Mmange n’atya n’okutya okutukuvu n’okukankana; era newaakubadde nga nnali sinnabatizibwa, n’antiira amakubo ago amakyamu abo mwe batambulira abakukyusiza amabega gaabwe, so si amaaso gaabwe.

Zinsanze! Era nneetantala okugamba nti wasirika, Ayi Katonda wange, bwe nnali nga ngenda wala okuva gy’Oli? Ddala wansirikira ddala mu biseera ebyo? Era bigambo bya ani, wabula ebibyo, bye wanyimbira mu matu gange ng’oyita mu mmange, omwesigwa wo? Tewali na kimu ku byo ekyakka mu mutima gwange ne nkikola. Kubanga yayagala, era nzijukira nga yandabula mu kyama n’okweraliikirira kungi, “obutayendanga; naye okusingira ddala obutayonoonanga mukazi wa musajja mulala.” Ebyo byandabikira okuba amagezi g’ekikazi, ge nnandiswadde okugondera. Naye gaali gago, so nga sikimanyi: era nnalowooza nti osirise era nti ye yali ayogera; so nga mu ye tewansirikira; era mu ye wanyoomebwa nze, mutabani we, omwana w’omuzaana wo, omuweereza wo. Naye nnali sikimanyi; ne nfubutuka n’obuzibe bw’amaaso obwenkanidde awo, ne nkwatibwa ensonyi mu bannange olw’okubeera n’obuswavu obutono okusinga obwabwe, bwe nnabawuliranga nga beenyumiriza mu bikolwa byabwe eby’obuswavu, ddala, nga bwe beeyongera okwewaana, bwe beeyongera okwonooneka: ne nsanyukira, si mu ssanyu ly’ekikolwa kyokka, naye ne mu kutenderezebwa. Kiki ekisaanira okunenyezebwa wabula ekibi? Naye ne nneefuula omubi okusinga bwe nnali, nneme kunenyezebwa; era bwe wabanga ekintu kye saayonoona ng’abo abaabiwaayo, nnagambanga nti nnakola kye saakola, nneme kulabika ng’atalina kye nsobola nga bwe nnali nsingako obutaliiko musango; oba ng’atali wa muwendo, nga bwe nnali omulongoofu okusingawo.

Laba bannange be nnatambula nabo mu nguudo za Babulooni, ne nneekulukuunya mu bitosi byayo, ng’alinga ali ku kitanda ky’eby’akaloosa n’amafuta ag’omuwendo omungi. Era ndyoke nneenyweze ddala mu makkati gaayo, omulabe atalabika n’anninnyirira, n’ansendasenda, kubanga nnali mwangu okusendebwasendebwa. Ne mmange ow’omubiri gwange (eyali adduse dda mu makkati ga Babulooni, naye ng’akyatambula mpola ku mabbali gaayo bwe yali ambuulirira okuba omulongoofu, teyafaayo nnyo ku ebyo bye yali awulidde ku nze okuva ku bba, okuziyiza mu nsalo z’okwagala okw’obufumbo (bwe kiba nga tekyali kisobola kusalibwako ddala) ekyo kye yawulira nga kya kabi mu kiseera ekyo era nga kya kabi mu biseera eby’omu maaso. Teyakifaako, kubanga yatya nti omukazi ayinza okufuuka ekizibu n’ekiziyiza eri essuubi lyange. Si essuubi ly’ensi egenda okujja, mmange lye yali assa mu Ggwe; wabula essuubi ly’okuyiga, bazadde bange bombi lye baali beegomba ennyo nfune; kitange, kubanga yali takulowoozaako n’akatono, ate nze yandowoozaako bya bwereere byokka; mmange, kubanga yalowooza nti amasomo ago aga bulijjo tegaalibadde kiziyiza, wabula gandinnyambyeko okukutuukako. Kubanga bwe ntyo bwe ndowooza, nga nzijukira, nga bwe nsobola, embeera ya bazadde bange. Mu kiseera ekyo, enkoba zansumulukirwa nnyo, okusukka ekigero kyonna eky’obukambwe obusaanidde, nzannye bwe njagala, ddala, okutuuka n’okwekkusa mu buli kye nnayagalanga. Era mu byonna mwalimu olufu, olwankisa, Ayi Katonda wange, okumasamasa kw’amazima go; era obutali butuukirivu bwange ne bubalukawo ng’obuva mu bugevvu bwennyini.

Essuula IV

Obubbi bubonerezebwa etteeka lyo, Ayi Mukama, n’etteeka eriwandiikiddwa mu mitima gy’abantu, obutali butuukirivu bwennyini lye butasobola kusangula. Kubanga mubbi ki agumiikiriza omubbi? Wadde omubbi omugagga, tagumiikiriza abba olw’obwavu. Naye nze nneegomba okubba, ne mbba, nga sikakiddwa njala, wadde obwavu, wabula olw’okwekkusa okukola obulungi, n’okwejjumbira obutali butuukirivu. Kubanga nnabba ekyo kye nnalina ekimala, era ekisingako ennyo obulungi. Era saafaayo kunyumirwa kye nnabba, wabula nnasanyukira obubbi n’ekibi kyokka. Waaliwo omuti gwa pea okumpi n’ennimiro yaffe ey’emizabbibu, nga gujjudde ebibala, ebitaasikiriza wadde olwa langi oba olw’obuwoomi. Okugukunkumula n’okubba ebibala byagwo, ffe abavubuka abamu ab’empisa embi twagenda, ekiro kimu ekikeeredde (nga tumaze okulwawo nga tuzannyira mu nguudo okutuusa mu kiseera ekyo, ng’empisa yaffe embi bwe yali), ne tutwala emigugu eminene, si kubirya, wabula okubisuulira embizzi, nga tumaze kubikomba bukombi. Era ekyo kyali kukola kye twayagala kyokka, kubanga kyali kigaaniddwa. Laba omutima gwange, Ayi Katonda, laba omutima gwange, gwe wasaasira nga guli wansi ddala mu bunnya obutaliiko ntobo. Kaakano, laba, omutima gwange ka gukubuulire kye gwali gunoonya eyo, nga mbeera omubi awatali nsonga, nga tewali kye nkemebwa nakyo kukola bubi, wabula obubi bwennyini. Bwali bugwagwa, ne mbwagala; nnayagala okuzikirira, nnayagala ensobi yange, si ekyo kye nnasobya olw’akyo, wabula ensobi yange yennyini. Ggwe emmeeme ey’obugwagwa, egwa okuva ku ggulu lyo okutuuka mu kuzikirira okw’enkomeredde; nga tenoonya kintu kyonna okuyita mu buswavu, wabula obuswavu bwennyini!

Essuula V

Kubanga waliwo okusikiriza mu mibiri emirungi, mu zaabu ne ffeeza, ne mu bintu byonna; ne mu kukwatagana kw’omubiri, okuwulira kumu kwa maanyi nnyo, era buli kiwulizi kirina ekintu kyakyo ekikisaanira. Ekitiibwa ky’ensi nakyo kirina obulungi bwakyo, n’obuyinza obw’okuwangula, n’obw’okufuga; era wano we wava n’ennyonta y’okwesasuza. Naye okufuna ebyo byonna, tetuteekwa kukuvaako, Ayi Mukama, wadde okuva ku tteeka lyo. N’obulamu bwe tulimu wano bulina okusikiriza kwabwo, olw’ekigero kyabwo, n’okukwatagana n’ebintu byonna ebirungi eby’ensi eno. N’omukwano gw’abantu gunyumira olw’ekisiba ekiwoomu, olw’obumu obukolebwa mu mmeeme nnyingi. Olw’ebyo byonna, n’ebiringa ebyo, ekibi kikolebwa, kubanga olw’okwegomba ebirungi bino eby’omutendera ogwa wansi ennyo okusukkiridde, ebirungi ebisinga era ebya waggulu birekebwa,—Ggwe, Mukama Katonda waffe, amazima go, n’etteeka lyo. Kubanga ebintu bino ebya wansi birina amasanyu gaabyo, naye si nga Katonda wange, eyakola ebintu byonna; kubanga mu ye omutuukirivu mw’asanyukira, era ye ssanyu ly’abo abalina omutima omulongoofu.

Kale, bwe tubuuza lwaki omusango gwazzibwa, tetukikkiriza, okuggyako nga kirabise nti wayinza okubaawo okwegomba okufuna ebimu ku ebyo bye twayise ebirungi ebya wansi, oba okutya okubifiirwa. Kubanga birungi era birabika bulungi; newaakubadde nga bwe bigeraageranyizibwa n’ebirungi ebyo ebya waggulu era eby’essanyu, bya wansi era tebiriimu kitiibwa. Omuntu asse munne; lwaki? Yayagala mukazi we oba ettaka lye; oba yayagala okunyaga okweyimirizaawo; oba yatya okufiirwa ebintu ebiringa ebyo olw’oyo; oba, ng’ayonoonyeddwa, yali ayaka omuliro ogw’okwesasuza. Waliwo ayinza okutta awatali nsonga, ng’asanyukira kutta kwokka? Ani yandikikkirizza? Kubanga ne ku musajja oyo ow’ekiruyi era omukambwe, gwe boogerako nti yali mubi era mukambwe awatali nsonga, era waliwo ensonga eweebwa; “Omukono oba omutima gulemenga” (bw’agamba) “okuddirira olw’obugayaavu.” Era olw’ekigendererwa ki? Ng’ayita mu kweyongera mu musango, alyoke, ng’amaze okuwamba ekibuga, afune ekitiibwa, obufuzi, obugagga, era asumululwe okuva mu kutya amateeka, n’ebizibu bye ebiva mu bwetaavu bw’awaka, n’okumanya obubi bwe. Kale, ne Catiline yennyini teyayagala bubi bwe, wabula ekintu ekirala, kye yabukolera.

Essuula VI

Kale kiki nze omunaku kye nnayagala ennyo mu ggwe, ggwe obubbi bwange, ggwe ekikolwa eky’ekizikiza, mu mwaka ogwo ogw’ekkumi n’omukaaga ogw’emyaka gyange? Tewali kyali kirungi mu ggwe, kubanga wali bubbi. Naye ddala oli kintu, nze okwogera naawe bwe ntyo? Ebibala bye twabba byali birungi, kubanga byali kitonde kyo, Ggwe asinga byonna obulungi, Omutonzi wa byonna, Ggwe Katonda omulungi; Katonda, obulungi obusinga byonna era obulungi bwange obw’amazima. Ebibala ebyo byali birungi, naye si byo emmeeme yange ennaku bye yeegomba; kubanga nnalina ebisingako obulungi bingi, era ebyo nnabinoga, ndyoke mbbe kyokka. Kubanga, bwe nnamala okubinoga, nnabisuula, embaga yange yokka mu byo nga kye kibi kyange, kye nnasanyukira okunyumirwa. Kubanga singa ekimu ku bibala ebyo kyayingira mu kamwa kange, ekyakiwoomesa kyali kibi. Era kaakano, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, mbuuza kiki mu bubbi obwo ekyansanyusa; era laba tebulina bulungi bwonna; sitegeeza bulungi ng’obwo obuli mu bwenkanya ne mu magezi; wadde ng’obwo obuli mu birowoozo ne mu kujjukira, ne mu biwulizi, ne mu bulamu bw’omubiri bw’omuntu; wadde ng’emmunyeenye bwe zirina ekitiibwa era bwe zirabika obulungi mu mbuga zaazo; oba ensi, oba ennyanja, ejjudde obulamu obutannazaalibwa, nga bizaalibwa okuddira ekyo ekivunda; nedda, wadde obulungi obwo obw’obulimba era obw’ekisiikirize obubeera mu bibi ebirimbalimba.

Kubanga bw’atyo amalala bwe gakoppa obugulumivu; so nga Ggwe wekka ggwe Katonda agulumizibwa okusinga byonna. Okwegomba ekitiibwa, kiki kye kinoonya, wabula ekitiibwa n’ettendo? So nga Ggwe wekka ggwe osaanidde okuweebwa ekitiibwa okusinga byonna, era ow’ekitiibwa emirembe n’emirembe. Obukambwe bw’abakulu bwagala okutiibwa; naye ani asaanidde okutiibwa wabula Katonda yekka, mu buyinza bwe kiki ekiyinza okunyagibwa oba okuggibwamu? Ddi, oba wa, oba gye kidda, oba ani akikola? Okwegonza kw’abakaba kwagala kubalibwe ng’okwagala: so nga tewali kintu ekiwoomu okusinga okwagala kwo; era tewali kintu ekyagalibwa mu ngeri ey’obulamu okusinga amazima go ago, agamasamasa era amalungi okusinga byonna. Okwagala okumanya buli kimu kweyisa ng’okwegomba amagezi; so nga Ggwe omanyi byonna okusinga byonna. Ddala, obutamanya n’obusirusiru byennyini byekweka wansi w’erinnya ly’obwesimbu n’obutalumya; kubanga tewali kizuulibwa nga kyesimbu okukusinga Ggwe: era kiki ekitalumya okusingawo, kubanga ebikolwa bye bennyini bye birumya omwonoonyi? Ddala, obugayaavu bwandyagadde okuwummula; naye kuwummula ki okunywevu okuggyako Mukama? Okwejalabya kwagala kuyitibwe obungi n’obugagga; naye Ggwe oli kujjula n’obungi obutaggwaawo obw’amasanyu agatavunda. Okwonoona ebintu kweyisa ng’okugaba: naye Ggwe ggwe Mugabi asinga okugaba ennyo ebirungi byonna. Omululu gwagala okubeera n’ebintu bingi; nawe olina ebintu byonna. Obuggya buwakanira okusinga: kiki ekikusinga Ggwe? Obusungu bunoonya okwesasuza: ani eyeesasuza mu bwenkanya okukusinga Ggwe? Okutya kwekanga ebintu ebitali bya bulijjo era ebijja amangu, ebiteeka mu kabi ebintu ebyagalwa, era kwegendereza okubikuuma; naye eri Ggwe kiki ekitali kya bulijjo oba ekijja amangu, oba ani ayawula ku Ggwe ky’oyagala? Oba wa, wabula gy’Oli, obukuumi obutanyeenya? Ennaku ekoggera olw’ebintu ebibuze, essanyu ly’okwegomba kwayo; kubanga teyagala kintu na kimu kuggibwako, nga bwe kitasoboka kintu kyonna kukuggibwako Ggwe.

Bw’etyo emmeeme bw’eyenda, bw’ekuvaako, ng’enoonya awatali Ggwe, ekyo ky’etasanga nga kirongoofu era nga tekiriiko bbala, okutuusa lw’ekomawo gy’Oli. Bwe batyo bonna bakukoppa mu ngeri ekyamu, abo abeeyawula wala naawe, ne beegulumiza okukuwakanya. Naye ne mu kukukoppa bwe batyo, balaga nti Ggwe Mutonzi w’obutonde bwonna; noolwekyo tewali kifo we bayinza kwekweka ddala nga bakuvaako. Kale kiki kye nnayagala mu bubbi obwo? Era mu ki mwe nnakoppa, wadde mu ngeri ey’obwonoonefu n’ekyamu, Mukama wange? Nnayagala, wadde mu kubba, okukola ekikontana n’etteeka lyo, kubanga mu maanyi saasobola, ndyoke, nga ndi musibe, nkoppe eddembe eryalemazibwa nga nkola awatali kubonerezebwa ebintu ebyangaanibwa, ekifaananyi ekiddugaze eky’Obuyinza bwo obw’ekitalo? Laba, omuddu wo, ng’adduka mukama we, n’afuna ekisiikirize. Woowe obuvundu! Woowe obulamu obw’ekivve, n’obuziba bw’okufa! Nnali nsobola okwagala ekyo ekitakkirizibwa, olw’ensonga nti tekikkirizibwa yokka?

Essuula VII

Mukama ndimusasula ntya, olw’okuba nti, ebyo bwe mbijjukira, emmeeme yange tekyabitya? Nja kukwagala, Ayi Mukama, nkwebaze, era nkwatulire erinnya lyo; kubanga onsonyiye ebikolwa byange bino ebinene bwe bityo era eby’ekivve. Kino nkitwala nti kiva mu kisa kyo n’okusaasira kwo, nti osaanuusizza ebibi byange ng’omuzira. Era ekisa kyo kye kyanziyiza okukola ebibi byonna bye saakola; kubanga kiki kye sandisobodde kukola, nze eyayagala ekibi olw’ekibi kyennyini? Ddala, byonna njatula nti nnabisonyiyibwa; ebibi bye nnakola olw’obukakanyavu bwange, n’ebyo, olw’okunkulembera kwo, bye saakola. Muntu ki, bw’apima obunafu bwe, ayinza okwetantala okugamba nti obulongoofu bwe n’obutaliiko musango bwe byava mu maanyi ge; alyoke akwagale ekitono, ng’alinga eyali teyeetaaga nnyo kusaasira kwo, kw’osonyiwa nakwo ebibi abo abakudda? Kubanga buli eyayitibwa Ggwe, n’agoberera eddoboozi lyo, n’ayewala ebyo by’asoma nga nzijukira era nga njatula ku nze, aleme kunnyooma, nze bwe nnali omulwadde, ne mponyezebwa Omusawo oyo, olw’obuyambi bwe ye kennyini kwe yava obutaba mulwadde, oba okusingawo, obutaba mulwadde nnyo: era olw’ekyo akwagale nnyo bw’atyo, wadde n’okusingawo; kubanga oyo gw’alaba nga yanzigya mu bulwadde obw’amaanyi bwe butyo obw’ekibi, oyo y’alaba nga ye yamukuuma obutagwa mu bulwadde bw’ekibi obufaanana bwe butyo.

Essuula VIII

Kiki kye nnagasibwa olwo (Nga ndi muntu munaku!) mu bintu ebyo, kaakano bye nkwatirwa ensonyi okujjukira? Okusingira ddala, mu bubbi obwo bwe nnayagala olw’obubbi bwennyini; era nabwo tebwali kintu, noolwekyo nze eyabwagala nneeyongera okuba omunaku. Kyokka sandibukoze nzekka: bwe ntyo bwe nnali mu biseera ebyo, nzijukira, nzekka sandibukoze. Kale nnayagalamu n’okubeera awamu ne banange be nnabukola nabo? Kale saayagala kintu kirala okuggyako obubbi, ddala, saayagala kirala kyonna; kubanga n’okubeera awamu ne banange nakwo tekwali kintu. Kiki ddala? Ani ayinza okunjigiriza, okuggyako Oyo atangaaza omutima gwange, n’abikkula ensonda zaagwo ez’ekizikiza? Kiki ekijjidde mu birowoozo byange okubuuza, n’okukubaganya ebirowoozo, n’okulowooza? Kubanga singa nnayagala ebibala bye nnabba, era nga njagala okubinyumirwa, nnandibikoze nzekka, singa okubba kwokka kwali kumala okuntuusa ku ssanyu lyange; era sandyetaaze kukoleeza kuyenja kw’okwegomba kwange n’okusikirizibwa banange. Naye olw’okuba nti essanyu lyange teryali mu bibala ebyo, lyali mu musango gwennyini, okubeera awamu n’abonoonyi bannange kwe kwalireeta.

Essuula IX

Kale kino kyali kiwulizi ki? Kubanga ddala kyali kigwagwa nnyo: era zinsanze nze eyakirina. Naye kyali ki? Ani asobola okulaba ebyonoono bye? Gwali muzannyo, ogwali ng’ogusagambiza emitima gyaffe, kubanga twalimbalimba abo abaali tebalowooza na katono kye twali tukola, era abandikikyawa ennyo. Kale lwaki essanyu lyange lyali lya ngeri eyo nti saakikola nzekka? Kubanga tewali n’omu ateera kuseka yekka? Mu bulijjo tewali n’omu; naye oluusi okuseka kuwangula abantu nga bali bokka, nga tewali muntu yenna ali nabo, singa ekintu ekisesa ennyo kijja mu biwulizi byabwe oba mu birowoozo byabwe. Kyokka kino saakikola nzekka; nzekka sandikikoze. Laba Katonda wange, mu maaso go, okujjukira okulamu okw’emmeeme yange; nzekka sandikoze bubbi obwo, mwe ebyo bye nnabba bitaansanyusa, wabula okubba kwennyini; era nzekka sandyagadde kukikola, era sandikikoze. Ggwe omukwano ogutaliimu kukwagala! Ggwe asendasenda emmeeme mu ngeri etategeerekeka, ggwe omululu gw’okukola obubi olw’okusaaga n’obukaba, ggwe ennyonta y’okufiirwa kw’abalala, awatali kwegomba magoba gange wadde okwesasuza: naye bwe kyogerwa nti, “Tugende, tukikole,” tukwatibwa ensonyi okuba nga tetuli bataliiko nsonyi.

Essuula X

Ani ayinza okusumulula ekifundikwa ekyo ekyezinze era ekizibu? Kigwagwa: nkyawa okukirowoozaako, okukitunuulira. Naye Ggwe gwe neegomba, Ayi Butuukirivu n’Obutaliiko musango, obulungi era obusanyusa amaaso gonna amalongoofu, era ow’okukkusa okutakoowa. Mu Ggwe mulimu okuwummula okujjuvu, n’obulamu obutatabulwa. Buli ayingira mu Ggwe, ayingira mu ssanyu lya Mukama we: era taatyenga, era aliba bulungi nnyo mu Oyo Asinga Obulungi bwonna. Nnaseeyeeya ne nkuvaako, ne mbula, Ayi Katonda wange, ne nkyama nnyo okuva gy’Oli, Ggwe ekinywezo kyange, mu nnaku ezo ez’obuvubuka bwange, ne nfuuka gye ndi ensi enkalu etabala.
fields.body_text: Essuula I Kaakano njagala okujjukira obugwagwa bwange obw’edda, n’obwonoonefu bw’omubiri obwayonoona emmeeme yange; si lwa kuba nti mbyagala, wabula ndyoke nkwagale Ggwe, Ayi Katonda wange. Kino nkikola olw’okwagala okwagala kwo; nga nzirayo mu makubo gange amabi ennyo nga nzijukira n’obukaawu bungi, Ggwe olyoke ombeere omuwoomu (Ggwe obuwoomi obutaggwaawo, Ggwe obuwoomi obw’essanyu era obwesigika); era ng’onkuŋŋaanya nate okuva mu kusaasaana kwange, mwe nnayuzibwayuzibwamu ebitundutundu, bwe nnali nga nkukubye amabega Ggwe, Omu Omulungi, ne nneebulira mu bintu ebingi ennyo. Kubanga mu buvubuka bwange edda nnayakirira okwekkusa ebintu eby’ensi wansi; ne nneetantala okuddamu okufuuka ensiko, nga nneemalira ku kwagala okw’engeri nnyingi okw’ebisiikirize: obulungi bwange ne buggwaawo, ne mpunya bubi mu maaso go; nga nneesanyusa nze kennyini, era nga njagala okusiimibwa mu maaso g’abantu. Essuula II Era kiki kye nnasanyukiranga, wabula okwagala n’okwagalibwa? Naye saakuuma kigero kya kwagala, okw’omwoyo eri omwoyo, ensalo y’omukwano eyakaayakana: wabula okuva mu kwegomba okw’omubiri okw’ebisooto, n’okubugujja kw’obuvubuka, ne muvaamu olufu olwabikka era ne luzikiza omutima gwange, ne siyinza kwawula kumasamasa kwa kwagala okutangaavu ku kifu ky’okwegomba okw’obukaba. Byombi byabugujjiranga mu nze nga bitabuddwatabuddwa, ne bisindika obuvubuka bwange obutaliiko kibuziyiza ne bugwa mu kiwonvu eky’okwegomba okutali kutukuvu, ne binnyika mu bunnya bw’ebikolwa eby’obuswavu. Obusungu bwo bwali bunkuŋŋaanidde ku mutwe, so nga sikimanyi. Nnali nzibye amatu olw’okukubagana kw’olujegere lw’obufa bwange, kye kibonerezo ky’amalala g’emmeeme yange, ne nkyama ne ngenda wala okuva gy’Oli, nawe n’ondeka, ne nsuukundibwa, ne nnyonooneka, ne nsaasaana, ne mbugujja nga mpitirira mu bwenzi bwange, nawe n’osirika, Ayi Ggwe essanyu lyange eryalwawo! Mu biseera ebyo wasirika, nange ne mbungeeta nga neeyongera okuva gy’Oli wala nnyo nnyo, nga nnyingira mu nnimiro ez’ennaku ezitabala ebibala ezisingawo n’okusingawo, nga ndi mu kunakuwala okw’amalala, ne mu bukoowu obutawummula. Woowe! Singa omuntu yenna mu biseera ebyo yaluŋŋamya obutabanguko bwange, n’akozesa bulungi obulungi obuyitawo obw’ebintu bino, ensonda ezisembayo ez’obutonde bwo! Singa yassa ekkomo ku ssanyu lyabyo, amayengo g’obuvubuka bwange galyoke geesuule ku lubalama lw’obufumbo, bwe gaali gatasobola kukkakkana, ne gakuumirwa mu kigendererwa eky’okuzaala abaana, nga etteeka lyo bwe liragira, Ayi Mukama: Ggwe abumba mu ngeri eno ezzadde ly’obufa bwaffe buno, kubanga osobola n’omukono omukkakkamu okufufuggaza amaggwa agaagobwa mu lusuku lwo? Kubanga obuyinza bwo obw’ekitalo tebuli wala naffe, newaakubadde nga ffe tuli wala naawe. Oba nnandibadde mpuliriza n’obwegendereza obusingawo eddoboozi eriva mu bire: Wabula abafumbo, obufumbo bujja kubaleetera emitawaana gye nandiyagadde mwewale. Era kirungi omusajja obutakwatanga ku mukazi. Era, Omusajja atali mufumbo yeemalira ku bya Mukama, engeri gy’asanyusa Mukama; Naye omufumbo yeeraliikirira bya nsi, nga bw’anaasanyusa mukazi we. Ebigambo bino nnandibadde mbiwuliriza n’obwegendereza obusingawo, era bwe nnandyawuddwa olw’obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, nnandirindiridde n’essanyu erisingawo okugwa mu kifuba kyo; naye nze, omunaku, ne mbimba ng’ennyanja esiikuuse, nga ngoberera okuyiika kw’amayengo gange, nga nkuleka Ggwe, ne mpitiriza ensalo zo zonna; naye saawona mbooko zo. Kubanga ani ku bafa ayinza okuziwona? Kubanga bulijjo wali nange, ng’onkangavvula n’okusaasira, era ng’ommansira ku masanyu gange gonna agatali ga mateeka obukaawu obusinga obungi: ndyoke nnoonye amasanyu agatatabuddwamu bukaawu. Naye amasanyu ago gye nnandigazudde, saasobola kukimanya, wabula mu Ggwe, Ayi Mukama, Ggwe ayigiriza ng’oyita mu nnaku, era atufumita, olyoke otuwonye; era atutta, tuleme kufa nga tuli wala naawe. Nnali ludda wa, era nnali nnyingidde wala kwenkana wa mu buwaŋŋanguse okuva mu masanyu g’ennyumba yo, mu mwaka ogwo ogw’ekkumi n’omukaaga ogw’emyaka gy’omubiri gwange, obulalu bw’okwegomba (obuntu obutalina nsonyi bwe bukkiriza mu ddembe lyonna, newaakubadde amateeka go nga tegabukkiriza) bwe bwanfuga, ne nneewaayo gye buli ddala? Mu kiseera ekyo abantu bange tebaafaayo kunnyamba kuwona kugwa kwange nga bampasiza; kye baafaako kyokka kwe kuba nti njige okwogera obulungi ennyo, mbeere omwogezi asendasenda. Essuula III Kubanga mu mwaka ogwo okusoma kwange kwayimirizibwamu: bwe nnamala okukomawo okuva e Madaura (ekibuga ekiriraanyeewo, gye nnali ŋŋenze okuyiga ebyennimi n’obwogezi), ensimbi ez’olugendo olulala olw’e Carthage nga zinteekerwateekerwa; era ekyo kyava nnyo mu kumalirira kwa kitange okusinga mu bugagga bwe, kubanga yali munnansi wa ddembe omwavu ow’e Thagaste. Kino nkibuulira ani? Si Ggwe, Katonda wange; wabula mu maaso go nkibuulira bantu bannange, wadde ekitundu ekitono eky’abantu ekiyinza okusanga ebiwandiiko byange bino. Era lwaki? Buli anaabisoma alowooze bunnya ki bwe tuteekwa okukukaabiramu. Kubanga kiki ekiri okumpi n’amatu go okusinga omutima ogwatula, n’obulamu obw’okukkiriza? Ani ataatendereza kitange, kubanga, ng’ayitiriza obusobozi bw’eby’obugagga bwe, yali agenda kuwa mutabani we byonna bye yali yeetaaga okugenda olugendo oluwanvu olw’okusoma? Kubanga bannansi bangi abaali n’obusobozi obusingako ennyo tebaakolera baana baabwe bwe batyo. Naye kitange oyo yennyini teyafaayo ku ngeri gye nnali nkula nga nzija gy’Oli, oba nga nnali mulongoofu; kyokka mbe nga mwogezi omulungi, newaakubadde nga nnali mukalu eri okulima kwo, Ayi Katonda, Ggwe Mukama yekka ow’amazima era omulungi ow’ennimiro yo, ye mutima gwange. Naye bwe nnali mbeera ne bazadde bange mu mwaka ogwo ogw’ekkumi n’omukaaga, nga ndese essomero okumala akabanga (ekiseera eky’obugayaavu nga kiyingiddewo olw’obwavu bwa bazadde bange), amaggwa g’okwegomba okutali kulongoofu ne gamera ne gampitirira ku mutwe, era nga tewali mukono gugakuulamu. Kitange bwe yandaba mu bwogero, nga nkula okufuuka omusajja, era nga nzijudde obuvubuka obutawummula, n’asanyuka n’abuulira mmange, ng’alowooza dda ku bazzukulu be; ng’asanyukira okutabanguka okwo okw’ebiwulizi, ensi mw’ekwerabirira Ggwe Omutonzi waayo, n’eyagala ekitonde kyo mu kifo kyo Ggwe kennyini, olw’omwenge ogutalabika ogw’obwagazi bwayo bwennyini, ng’ekyama era ng’efukamirira ebintu ebisingira ddala okuba ebya wansi. Naye mu kifuba kya mmange wali otandise dda yeekaalu yo, n’omusingi gw’ekifo kyo ekitukuvu w’obeera, so nga kitange yali akyali muyizi eyeeteekerateekera okubatizibwa, era nga kino kyakatandika. Mmange n’atya n’okutya okutukuvu n’okukankana; era newaakubadde nga nnali sinnabatizibwa, n’antiira amakubo ago amakyamu abo mwe batambulira abakukyusiza amabega gaabwe, so si amaaso gaabwe. Zinsanze! Era nneetantala okugamba nti wasirika, Ayi Katonda wange, bwe nnali nga ngenda wala okuva gy’Oli? Ddala wansirikira ddala mu biseera ebyo? Era bigambo bya ani, wabula ebibyo, bye wanyimbira mu matu gange ng’oyita mu mmange, omwesigwa wo? Tewali na kimu ku byo ekyakka mu mutima gwange ne nkikola. Kubanga yayagala, era nzijukira nga yandabula mu kyama n’okweraliikirira kungi, “obutayendanga; naye okusingira ddala obutayonoonanga mukazi wa musajja mulala.” Ebyo byandabikira okuba amagezi g’ekikazi, ge nnandiswadde okugondera. Naye gaali gago, so nga sikimanyi: era nnalowooza nti osirise era nti ye yali ayogera; so nga mu ye tewansirikira; era mu ye wanyoomebwa nze, mutabani we, omwana w’omuzaana wo, omuweereza wo. Naye nnali sikimanyi; ne nfubutuka n’obuzibe bw’amaaso obwenkanidde awo, ne nkwatibwa ensonyi mu bannange olw’okubeera n’obuswavu obutono okusinga obwabwe, bwe nnabawuliranga nga beenyumiriza mu bikolwa byabwe eby’obuswavu, ddala, nga bwe beeyongera okwewaana, bwe beeyongera okwonooneka: ne nsanyukira, si mu ssanyu ly’ekikolwa kyokka, naye ne mu kutenderezebwa. Kiki ekisaanira okunenyezebwa wabula ekibi? Naye ne nneefuula omubi okusinga bwe nnali, nneme kunenyezebwa; era bwe wabanga ekintu kye saayonoona ng’abo abaabiwaayo, nnagambanga nti nnakola kye saakola, nneme kulabika ng’atalina kye nsobola nga bwe nnali nsingako obutaliiko musango; oba ng’atali wa muwendo, nga bwe nnali omulongoofu okusingawo. Laba bannange be nnatambula nabo mu nguudo za Babulooni, ne nneekulukuunya mu bitosi byayo, ng’alinga ali ku kitanda ky’eby’akaloosa n’amafuta ag’omuwendo omungi. Era ndyoke nneenyweze ddala mu makkati gaayo, omulabe atalabika n’anninnyirira, n’ansendasenda, kubanga nnali mwangu okusendebwasendebwa. Ne mmange ow’omubiri gwange (eyali adduse dda mu makkati ga Babulooni, naye ng’akyatambula mpola ku mabbali gaayo bwe yali ambuulirira okuba omulongoofu, teyafaayo nnyo ku ebyo bye yali awulidde ku nze okuva ku bba, okuziyiza mu nsalo z’okwagala okw’obufumbo (bwe kiba nga tekyali kisobola kusalibwako ddala) ekyo kye yawulira nga kya kabi mu kiseera ekyo era nga kya kabi mu biseera eby’omu maaso. Teyakifaako, kubanga yatya nti omukazi ayinza okufuuka ekizibu n’ekiziyiza eri essuubi lyange. Si essuubi ly’ensi egenda okujja, mmange lye yali assa mu Ggwe; wabula essuubi ly’okuyiga, bazadde bange bombi lye baali beegomba ennyo nfune; kitange, kubanga yali takulowoozaako n’akatono, ate nze yandowoozaako bya bwereere byokka; mmange, kubanga yalowooza nti amasomo ago aga bulijjo tegaalibadde kiziyiza, wabula gandinnyambyeko okukutuukako. Kubanga bwe ntyo bwe ndowooza, nga nzijukira, nga bwe nsobola, embeera ya bazadde bange. Mu kiseera ekyo, enkoba zansumulukirwa nnyo, okusukka ekigero kyonna eky’obukambwe obusaanidde, nzannye bwe njagala, ddala, okutuuka n’okwekkusa mu buli kye nnayagalanga. Era mu byonna mwalimu olufu, olwankisa, Ayi Katonda wange, okumasamasa kw’amazima go; era obutali butuukirivu bwange ne bubalukawo ng’obuva mu bugevvu bwennyini. Essuula IV Obubbi bubonerezebwa etteeka lyo, Ayi Mukama, n’etteeka eriwandiikiddwa mu mitima gy’abantu, obutali butuukirivu bwennyini lye butasobola kusangula. Kubanga mubbi ki agumiikiriza omubbi? Wadde omubbi omugagga, tagumiikiriza abba olw’obwavu. Naye nze nneegomba okubba, ne mbba, nga sikakiddwa njala, wadde obwavu, wabula olw’okwekkusa okukola obulungi, n’okwejjumbira obutali butuukirivu. Kubanga nnabba ekyo kye nnalina ekimala, era ekisingako ennyo obulungi. Era saafaayo kunyumirwa kye nnabba, wabula nnasanyukira obubbi n’ekibi kyokka. Waaliwo omuti gwa pea okumpi n’ennimiro yaffe ey’emizabbibu, nga gujjudde ebibala, ebitaasikiriza wadde olwa langi oba olw’obuwoomi. Okugukunkumula n’okubba ebibala byagwo, ffe abavubuka abamu ab’empisa embi twagenda, ekiro kimu ekikeeredde (nga tumaze okulwawo nga tuzannyira mu nguudo okutuusa mu kiseera ekyo, ng’empisa yaffe embi bwe yali), ne tutwala emigugu eminene, si kubirya, wabula okubisuulira embizzi, nga tumaze kubikomba bukombi. Era ekyo kyali kukola kye twayagala kyokka, kubanga kyali kigaaniddwa. Laba omutima gwange, Ayi Katonda, laba omutima gwange, gwe wasaasira nga guli wansi ddala mu bunnya obutaliiko ntobo. Kaakano, laba, omutima gwange ka gukubuulire kye gwali gunoonya eyo, nga mbeera omubi awatali nsonga, nga tewali kye nkemebwa nakyo kukola bubi, wabula obubi bwennyini. Bwali bugwagwa, ne mbwagala; nnayagala okuzikirira, nnayagala ensobi yange, si ekyo kye nnasobya olw’akyo, wabula ensobi yange yennyini. Ggwe emmeeme ey’obugwagwa, egwa okuva ku ggulu lyo okutuuka mu kuzikirira okw’enkomeredde; nga tenoonya kintu kyonna okuyita mu buswavu, wabula obuswavu bwennyini! Essuula V Kubanga waliwo okusikiriza mu mibiri emirungi, mu zaabu ne ffeeza, ne mu bintu byonna; ne mu kukwatagana kw’omubiri, okuwulira kumu kwa maanyi nnyo, era buli kiwulizi kirina ekintu kyakyo ekikisaanira. Ekitiibwa ky’ensi nakyo kirina obulungi bwakyo, n’obuyinza obw’okuwangula, n’obw’okufuga; era wano we wava n’ennyonta y’okwesasuza. Naye okufuna ebyo byonna, tetuteekwa kukuvaako, Ayi Mukama, wadde okuva ku tteeka lyo. N’obulamu bwe tulimu wano bulina okusikiriza kwabwo, olw’ekigero kyabwo, n’okukwatagana n’ebintu byonna ebirungi eby’ensi eno. N’omukwano gw’abantu gunyumira olw’ekisiba ekiwoomu, olw’obumu obukolebwa mu mmeeme nnyingi. Olw’ebyo byonna, n’ebiringa ebyo, ekibi kikolebwa, kubanga olw’okwegomba ebirungi bino eby’omutendera ogwa wansi ennyo okusukkiridde, ebirungi ebisinga era ebya waggulu birekebwa,—Ggwe, Mukama Katonda waffe, amazima go, n’etteeka lyo. Kubanga ebintu bino ebya wansi birina amasanyu gaabyo, naye si nga Katonda wange, eyakola ebintu byonna; kubanga mu ye omutuukirivu mw’asanyukira, era ye ssanyu ly’abo abalina omutima omulongoofu. Kale, bwe tubuuza lwaki omusango gwazzibwa, tetukikkiriza, okuggyako nga kirabise nti wayinza okubaawo okwegomba okufuna ebimu ku ebyo bye twayise ebirungi ebya wansi, oba okutya okubifiirwa. Kubanga birungi era birabika bulungi; newaakubadde nga bwe bigeraageranyizibwa n’ebirungi ebyo ebya waggulu era eby’essanyu, bya wansi era tebiriimu kitiibwa. Omuntu asse munne; lwaki? Yayagala mukazi we oba ettaka lye; oba yayagala okunyaga okweyimirizaawo; oba yatya okufiirwa ebintu ebiringa ebyo olw’oyo; oba, ng’ayonoonyeddwa, yali ayaka omuliro ogw’okwesasuza. Waliwo ayinza okutta awatali nsonga, ng’asanyukira kutta kwokka? Ani yandikikkirizza? Kubanga ne ku musajja oyo ow’ekiruyi era omukambwe, gwe boogerako nti yali mubi era mukambwe awatali nsonga, era waliwo ensonga eweebwa; “Omukono oba omutima gulemenga” (bw’agamba) “okuddirira olw’obugayaavu.” Era olw’ekigendererwa ki? Ng’ayita mu kweyongera mu musango, alyoke, ng’amaze okuwamba ekibuga, afune ekitiibwa, obufuzi, obugagga, era asumululwe okuva mu kutya amateeka, n’ebizibu bye ebiva mu bwetaavu bw’awaka, n’okumanya obubi bwe. Kale, ne Catiline yennyini teyayagala bubi bwe, wabula ekintu ekirala, kye yabukolera. Essuula VI Kale kiki nze omunaku kye nnayagala ennyo mu ggwe, ggwe obubbi bwange, ggwe ekikolwa eky’ekizikiza, mu mwaka ogwo ogw’ekkumi n’omukaaga ogw’emyaka gyange? Tewali kyali kirungi mu ggwe, kubanga wali bubbi. Naye ddala oli kintu, nze okwogera naawe bwe ntyo? Ebibala bye twabba byali birungi, kubanga byali kitonde kyo, Ggwe asinga byonna obulungi, Omutonzi wa byonna, Ggwe Katonda omulungi; Katonda, obulungi obusinga byonna era obulungi bwange obw’amazima. Ebibala ebyo byali birungi, naye si byo emmeeme yange ennaku bye yeegomba; kubanga nnalina ebisingako obulungi bingi, era ebyo nnabinoga, ndyoke mbbe kyokka. Kubanga, bwe nnamala okubinoga, nnabisuula, embaga yange yokka mu byo nga kye kibi kyange, kye nnasanyukira okunyumirwa. Kubanga singa ekimu ku bibala ebyo kyayingira mu kamwa kange, ekyakiwoomesa kyali kibi. Era kaakano, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, mbuuza kiki mu bubbi obwo ekyansanyusa; era laba tebulina bulungi bwonna; sitegeeza bulungi ng’obwo obuli mu bwenkanya ne mu magezi; wadde ng’obwo obuli mu birowoozo ne mu kujjukira, ne mu biwulizi, ne mu bulamu bw’omubiri bw’omuntu; wadde ng’emmunyeenye bwe zirina ekitiibwa era bwe zirabika obulungi mu mbuga zaazo; oba ensi, oba ennyanja, ejjudde obulamu obutannazaalibwa, nga bizaalibwa okuddira ekyo ekivunda; nedda, wadde obulungi obwo obw’obulimba era obw’ekisiikirize obubeera mu bibi ebirimbalimba. Kubanga bw’atyo amalala bwe gakoppa obugulumivu; so nga Ggwe wekka ggwe Katonda agulumizibwa okusinga byonna. Okwegomba ekitiibwa, kiki kye kinoonya, wabula ekitiibwa n’ettendo? So nga Ggwe wekka ggwe osaanidde okuweebwa ekitiibwa okusinga byonna, era ow’ekitiibwa emirembe n’emirembe. Obukambwe bw’abakulu bwagala okutiibwa; naye ani asaanidde okutiibwa wabula Katonda yekka, mu buyinza bwe kiki ekiyinza okunyagibwa oba okuggibwamu? Ddi, oba wa, oba gye kidda, oba ani akikola? Okwegonza kw’abakaba kwagala kubalibwe ng’okwagala: so nga tewali kintu ekiwoomu okusinga okwagala kwo; era tewali kintu ekyagalibwa mu ngeri ey’obulamu okusinga amazima go ago, agamasamasa era amalungi okusinga byonna. Okwagala okumanya buli kimu kweyisa ng’okwegomba amagezi; so nga Ggwe omanyi byonna okusinga byonna. Ddala, obutamanya n’obusirusiru byennyini byekweka wansi w’erinnya ly’obwesimbu n’obutalumya; kubanga tewali kizuulibwa nga kyesimbu okukusinga Ggwe: era kiki ekitalumya okusingawo, kubanga ebikolwa bye bennyini bye birumya omwonoonyi? Ddala, obugayaavu bwandyagadde okuwummula; naye kuwummula ki okunywevu okuggyako Mukama? Okwejalabya kwagala kuyitibwe obungi n’obugagga; naye Ggwe oli kujjula n’obungi obutaggwaawo obw’amasanyu agatavunda. Okwonoona ebintu kweyisa ng’okugaba: naye Ggwe ggwe Mugabi asinga okugaba ennyo ebirungi byonna. Omululu gwagala okubeera n’ebintu bingi; nawe olina ebintu byonna. Obuggya buwakanira okusinga: kiki ekikusinga Ggwe? Obusungu bunoonya okwesasuza: ani eyeesasuza mu bwenkanya okukusinga Ggwe? Okutya kwekanga ebintu ebitali bya bulijjo era ebijja amangu, ebiteeka mu kabi ebintu ebyagalwa, era kwegendereza okubikuuma; naye eri Ggwe kiki ekitali kya bulijjo oba ekijja amangu, oba ani ayawula ku Ggwe ky’oyagala? Oba wa, wabula gy’Oli, obukuumi obutanyeenya? Ennaku ekoggera olw’ebintu ebibuze, essanyu ly’okwegomba kwayo; kubanga teyagala kintu na kimu kuggibwako, nga bwe kitasoboka kintu kyonna kukuggibwako Ggwe. Bw’etyo emmeeme bw’eyenda, bw’ekuvaako, ng’enoonya awatali Ggwe, ekyo ky’etasanga nga kirongoofu era nga tekiriiko bbala, okutuusa lw’ekomawo gy’Oli. Bwe batyo bonna bakukoppa mu ngeri ekyamu, abo abeeyawula wala naawe, ne beegulumiza okukuwakanya. Naye ne mu kukukoppa bwe batyo, balaga nti Ggwe Mutonzi w’obutonde bwonna; noolwekyo tewali kifo we bayinza kwekweka ddala nga bakuvaako. Kale kiki kye nnayagala mu bubbi obwo? Era mu ki mwe nnakoppa, wadde mu ngeri ey’obwonoonefu n’ekyamu, Mukama wange? Nnayagala, wadde mu kubba, okukola ekikontana n’etteeka lyo, kubanga mu maanyi saasobola, ndyoke, nga ndi musibe, nkoppe eddembe eryalemazibwa nga nkola awatali kubonerezebwa ebintu ebyangaanibwa, ekifaananyi ekiddugaze eky’Obuyinza bwo obw’ekitalo? Laba, omuddu wo, ng’adduka mukama we, n’afuna ekisiikirize. Woowe obuvundu! Woowe obulamu obw’ekivve, n’obuziba bw’okufa! Nnali nsobola okwagala ekyo ekitakkirizibwa, olw’ensonga nti tekikkirizibwa yokka? Essuula VII Mukama ndimusasula ntya, olw’okuba nti, ebyo bwe mbijjukira, emmeeme yange tekyabitya? Nja kukwagala, Ayi Mukama, nkwebaze, era nkwatulire erinnya lyo; kubanga onsonyiye ebikolwa byange bino ebinene bwe bityo era eby’ekivve. Kino nkitwala nti kiva mu kisa kyo n’okusaasira kwo, nti osaanuusizza ebibi byange ng’omuzira. Era ekisa kyo kye kyanziyiza okukola ebibi byonna bye saakola; kubanga kiki kye sandisobodde kukola, nze eyayagala ekibi olw’ekibi kyennyini? Ddala, byonna njatula nti nnabisonyiyibwa; ebibi bye nnakola olw’obukakanyavu bwange, n’ebyo, olw’okunkulembera kwo, bye saakola. Muntu ki, bw’apima obunafu bwe, ayinza okwetantala okugamba nti obulongoofu bwe n’obutaliiko musango bwe byava mu maanyi ge; alyoke akwagale ekitono, ng’alinga eyali teyeetaaga nnyo kusaasira kwo, kw’osonyiwa nakwo ebibi abo abakudda? Kubanga buli eyayitibwa Ggwe, n’agoberera eddoboozi lyo, n’ayewala ebyo by’asoma nga nzijukira era nga njatula ku nze, aleme kunnyooma, nze bwe nnali omulwadde, ne mponyezebwa Omusawo oyo, olw’obuyambi bwe ye kennyini kwe yava obutaba mulwadde, oba okusingawo, obutaba mulwadde nnyo: era olw’ekyo akwagale nnyo bw’atyo, wadde n’okusingawo; kubanga oyo gw’alaba nga yanzigya mu bulwadde obw’amaanyi bwe butyo obw’ekibi, oyo y’alaba nga ye yamukuuma obutagwa mu bulwadde bw’ekibi obufaanana bwe butyo. Essuula VIII Kiki kye nnagasibwa olwo (Nga ndi muntu munaku!) mu bintu ebyo, kaakano bye nkwatirwa ensonyi okujjukira? Okusingira ddala, mu bubbi obwo bwe nnayagala olw’obubbi bwennyini; era nabwo tebwali kintu, noolwekyo nze eyabwagala nneeyongera okuba omunaku. Kyokka sandibukoze nzekka: bwe ntyo bwe nnali mu biseera ebyo, nzijukira, nzekka sandibukoze. Kale nnayagalamu n’okubeera awamu ne banange be nnabukola nabo? Kale saayagala kintu kirala okuggyako obubbi, ddala, saayagala kirala kyonna; kubanga n’okubeera awamu ne banange nakwo tekwali kintu. Kiki ddala? Ani ayinza okunjigiriza, okuggyako Oyo atangaaza omutima gwange, n’abikkula ensonda zaagwo ez’ekizikiza? Kiki ekijjidde mu birowoozo byange okubuuza, n’okukubaganya ebirowoozo, n’okulowooza? Kubanga singa nnayagala ebibala bye nnabba, era nga njagala okubinyumirwa, nnandibikoze nzekka, singa okubba kwokka kwali kumala okuntuusa ku ssanyu lyange; era sandyetaaze kukoleeza kuyenja kw’okwegomba kwange n’okusikirizibwa banange. Naye olw’okuba nti essanyu lyange teryali mu bibala ebyo, lyali mu musango gwennyini, okubeera awamu n’abonoonyi bannange kwe kwalireeta. Essuula IX Kale kino kyali kiwulizi ki? Kubanga ddala kyali kigwagwa nnyo: era zinsanze nze eyakirina. Naye kyali ki? Ani asobola okulaba ebyonoono bye? Gwali muzannyo, ogwali ng’ogusagambiza emitima gyaffe, kubanga twalimbalimba abo abaali tebalowooza na katono kye twali tukola, era abandikikyawa ennyo. Kale lwaki essanyu lyange lyali lya ngeri eyo nti saakikola nzekka? Kubanga tewali n’omu ateera kuseka yekka? Mu bulijjo tewali n’omu; naye oluusi okuseka kuwangula abantu nga bali bokka, nga tewali muntu yenna ali nabo, singa ekintu ekisesa ennyo kijja mu biwulizi byabwe oba mu birowoozo byabwe. Kyokka kino saakikola nzekka; nzekka sandikikoze. Laba Katonda wange, mu maaso go, okujjukira okulamu okw’emmeeme yange; nzekka sandikoze bubbi obwo, mwe ebyo bye nnabba bitaansanyusa, wabula okubba kwennyini; era nzekka sandyagadde kukikola, era sandikikoze. Ggwe omukwano ogutaliimu kukwagala! Ggwe asendasenda emmeeme mu ngeri etategeerekeka, ggwe omululu gw’okukola obubi olw’okusaaga n’obukaba, ggwe ennyonta y’okufiirwa kw’abalala, awatali kwegomba magoba gange wadde okwesasuza: naye bwe kyogerwa nti, “Tugende, tukikole,” tukwatibwa ensonyi okuba nga tetuli bataliiko nsonyi. Essuula X Ani ayinza okusumulula ekifundikwa ekyo ekyezinze era ekizibu? Kigwagwa: nkyawa okukirowoozaako, okukitunuulira. Naye Ggwe gwe neegomba, Ayi Butuukirivu n’Obutaliiko musango, obulungi era obusanyusa amaaso gonna amalongoofu, era ow’okukkusa okutakoowa. Mu Ggwe mulimu okuwummula okujjuvu, n’obulamu obutatabulwa. Buli ayingira mu Ggwe, ayingira mu ssanyu lya Mukama we: era taatyenga, era aliba bulungi nnyo mu Oyo Asinga Obulungi bwonna. Nnaseeyeeya ne nkuvaako, ne mbula, Ayi Katonda wange, ne nkyama nnyo okuva gy’Oli, Ggwe ekinywezo kyange, mu nnaku ezo ez’obuvubuka bwange, ne nfuuka gye ndi ensi enkalu etabala.

fields.title: Ekitabo III
fields.body_html:
Essuula I

Ne nzija e Carthage, era eyo okwagala okw’obugwagwa kwanneetooloola enjuyi zonna, nga kuvuga mu matu gange ng’entamu ennene eyeesera. Nnali sinnaba kwagala, naye nnayagalanga okwagala; era olw’obwetaavu obwali bukwese munda yange ennyo, nneekyawanga olw’obutaba mwetaavu ekimala. Nnanoonyanga kye nnyinza okwagala, nga njagala okwagala kwennyini, ne nkyawa emirembe n’ekkubo eritaliimu mitego. Kubanga munda yange mwalimu enjala ey’emmere ey’omunda, ye Ggwe wennyini, Ayi Katonda wange; naye enjala eyo teyandumya; wabula saalina kwegomba kwonna kwa mmere etaggwaawo, si lwa kuba nti nnali nkkuse, wabula gye nnakoma okuba omwereere, gye nnakoma okugikyawa. Olw’ensonga eyo emmeeme yange yali nnafu era ejjudde amabwa; yeesuulanga ebweru mu nnaku, ng’eyaayaanira okukwatibwako n’okukunyuulibwa ebintu ebiwulirwa omubiri. Naye singa ebyo tebyalina mmeeme, tebyandibadde bya kwagalwa. Kale okwagala n’okwagalibwa kyali kinnyumira; naye okusingawo, bwe nnafunanga okweyagalira mu muntu gwe nnayagala, bwe ntyo ne nnyonoona ensulo y’omukwano n’obucaafu bw’okwegomba okubi, ne nzikiza obutangaavu bwagwo n’ekizikiza kya ggeyeena eky’obukaba; era bwe ntyo, wadde nga nnali mucaafu era nswaza, olw’amalala amayitirivu nnayagalanga okulabika ng’omuntu omulungi ow’empisa ez’omu lubiri. Awo ne nneesuula ne nnyingira mu kwagala mwe nnali njaayaanira okusibibwa. Ayi Katonda wange, Ggwe Kisa kyange, omususa gwenkana wa gwe wamansira ku buwoomi obwo ku lwange, olw’obulungi bwo obungi? Kubanga nnayagalibwa, era mu kyama ne ntuuka ku nkolagana ey’okweyagala; ne nsibibwa n’essanyu mu njegere ezireeta ennaku, ndyoke nkubibwe n’emiggo egy’ekyuma egyokya: obuggya, n’okuteebereza obubi, n’okutya, n’obusungu, n’okuyombagana.

Essuula II

Era n’emizannyo egy’oku siteegi gyansikiriza nnyo, nga gijjudde ebifaananyi by’ennaku zange, n’enku ezaakumanga omuliro gwange. Lwaki omuntu ayagala okunakuwazibwa ng’atunuulira ebintu eby’ennaku n’eby’ekikangabwa, by’atandikkirizza n’akatono kumutuukako ye kennyini? naye ng’omulabi ayagala okuwulira ennaku ku lwabyo, era ennaku eyo yennyini ye ssanyu lye. Kino kiki bwe kitaba bulalu obw’ennaku? kubanga omuntu gy’akoma obutaba wa ddembe okuva mu nneewulira ng’ezo, gy’akoma okukwatibwako ebikolwa ebyo. Naye bw’abonaabona ye kennyini, ekyo kiyitibwa nnaku: bw’akwatirwa abalala ekisa, olwo kiyitibwa kusaasira. Naye okusaasira kuno kwa ngeri ki, okusaasira obulumi obw’okwefuula obw’oku siteegi? kubanga omuwulizi tayitibwa kuyamba, wabula okunakuwala kwokka: era gy’akoma okunakuwala, gy’akoma okukubira omuzannyi w’ebiyiiye ebyo mu ngalo. Era singa ebibonoobono by’abantu abo (oba ab’edda, oba ab’emboozi ezigunjiddwa obugunjibwa) bizannyibwa nga omulabi takulukusa maziga, avaawo ng’anyiize era ng’avumirira; naye bw’akwatibwako mu mutima, asigala ng’assaayo nnyo omwoyo, era akaaba olw’essanyu.

Kale n’ennaku nayo eyagalibwa? Mazima buli muntu ayagala essanyu. Oba, wadde nga tewali muntu ayagala kuba mu nnaku, naye asanyuka okuba omusaasizi? era olw’okuba okusaasira tekuyinza kubaawo awatali bulumi, kye kiva obulumi bwagalibwa olw’ensonga eyo yokka? Kino nakyo kiva mu kagga ako ak’omukwano. Naye akagga ako kagenda wa? kakulukutira wa? lwaki kayiika mu mugga ogwo ogwa kolaasi eyeesera, ogufukumula amayengo ag’entiisa ag’obukaba obucaafu, mwe kakyusibwa ne kafuulibwa ku bwagazi bwako, nga kagwa ne kayonooneka ku bwagazi bwako, ne kava mu butangaavu bwako obw’omu ggulu? Kale okusaasira kuggyibwewo? nedda n’akatono. Kale ennaku ziyinza okwagalibwa olumu. Naye weekuume obugwagwa, Ayi emmeeme yange, ng’oli wansi w’obukuumi bwa Katonda wange, Katonda wa bajjajjaffe, asaanira okutenderezebwa n’okugulumizibwa okusinga byonna emirembe gyonna, weekuume obugwagwa. Kubanga kaakano sirekeddaawo kusaasira; naye mu biseera ebyo, mu bifo eby’emizannyo, nnasanyukiranga wamu n’abaagalana bwe baasanyukiranga mu bubi, wadde nga kyali kya kwefuula bwefuuzi mu muzannyo. Era bwe baabuzanga buli omu ku munne, nnanakuwalanga wamu nabo ng’omusaasizi ennyo, naye nga nsanyukira byombi. Naye kaakano nsaasira nnyo okusingawo oyo asanyukira obubi bwe, okusinga oyo alowoozebwa okubonaabona olw’okufiirwa essanyu erizikiriza, n’okubulwa obusanyufu obw’ennaku. Kino mazima kwe kusaasira okw’amazima okusingawo, naye mu kwo ennaku tesanyusa. Kubanga wadde oyo anakuwalira abali mu nnaku atenderezebwa olw’omulimu gwe ogw’okwagala; naye oyo asaasira mu mazima yandisinze okwagala nti tewabaawo kintu kyonna kya kumunakuwaza. Kubanga singa omutima omulungi gwali gusobola okuba omubi (ekitayinza kubaawo n’akatono), olwo oyo asaasira mu mazima n’omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa yandyegombye wabeewo abali mu nnaku, alyoke abasaasire. Kale ennaku ezimu ziyinza okukkirizibwa, naye tewali n’emu esaanidde kwagalibwa. Kubanga bw’otyo bw’oli Ggwe, Ayi Mukama Katonda, ayagala emmeeme mu bulongoofu obusinga ennyo obwaffe, era azisaasira mu ngeri etavunda okutusinga, naye nga tolumizibwa nnaku yonna. Kale ebyo ani abisobola?

Naye nze, omunaku, mu biseera ebyo nnayagalanga okunakuwala, ne nnoonya eky’okunakuwalira; era mu nnaku ey’omuntu omulala, ate nga ya kwefuula na kuzannya buzannya, omuzannyo ogwasinganga okunsanyusa n’okunsikiriza n’amaanyi amangi gwe gwo ogwankulukusanga amaziga. Kiki ekyewuunyisa nti nze, endiga etali na ssanyu, ebuze okuva mu kisibo kyo, era etagumiikiriza kukuumibwa kwo, nnakwatibwa obulwadde obw’obucaafu? Era awo we wava okwagala ennaku; si ennaku eyandinnyingidde munda ennyo; kubanga saayagalanga kubonaabona mu bye nnayagalanga okutunuulira; wabula ennaku eyo, bwe nnawuliranga emboozi zaabwe ezigunjiddwa, yankunyuulanga kungulu bukunyuuzi; naye oluvannyuma, ng’ekikunyuulo ky’enjala ezirimu obusagwa, ne kuddirira okuzimba okw’omusujja, n’amayute, n’ekiwundu ekivunze. Obulamu bwange bwe bwali bwe butyo, obwo bwali bulamu, Ayi Katonda wange?

Essuula III

Era okusaasira kwo okwesigwa kwambuuyanga waggulu wange okuva ewala. Nga nneemalawo mu bubi obw’amaanyi bwenkana wa, nga ngoberera okwagala okumanya okw’obujeemu eri ebitukuvu, kulyoke, nga nkulese Ggwe, kuntwale mu bunnya obw’enkwe, ne mu buweereza obulimba obwa baddayimooni, be nnawangayo ebikolwa byange ebibi ng’ebiweebwayo, era mu ebyo byonna wankubanga! Era nneetantala, emikolo gyo emitukuvu nga gikwatibwa munda mu bisenge by’Ekkanisa yo, okwegomba n’okutegeka ensonga ebibala byayo ebyasaanira okufa, era ku lw’ekyo wankuba n’ebibonerezo ebizito, wadde nga tebyenkana nsobi yange, Ggwe ekisa kyange ekisukkiridde, Ayi Katonda wange, ekiddukiro kyange okuva eri abazikiriza abo ab’entiisa, be nnatambulanga nabo nga mbuze n’ensingo enkakanyavu, nga nneeyongera okukudduka, nga njagala amakubo gange so si gago; nga njagala eddembe ery’omutambuze atalina gy’alaga.

N’ebyo bye nnasomanga, ebyabalibwanga ng’ebisaanira okutenderezebwa, byali bigenderera kunfuula wa kitiibwa mu mbuga z’amateeka; gye wakomanga okuba omukujjukujju mu nkwe, gye wakomanga okutenderezebwa. Obuzibe bw’abantu bwe butyo, okwenyumiriza ne mu buzibe bwabwe bwennyini. Era kaakano nnali wa kusooka mu ssomero ly’okwogera obulungi, ne nsanyuka mu malala, ne nzimba olw’okwekulumbaza, wadde nga (Mukama, Ggwe omanyi) nnali mukkakkamu nnyo okusingawo era nga sirina kakwate n’akatono ku kutabangula kw’abo “Abatabanguzi” (kubanga erinnya lino ery’akabi era erya sitaani lye lyali akabonero k’obuzira) be nnabeeranga nabo, nga nnina ensonyi ezitaliimu nsonyi olw’obutaba nga bo. Nnabeeranga nabo, era olumu nnasanyukiranga omukwano gwabwe, wadde nga ebikolwa byabwe nnabikyawanga bulijjo—kwe kugamba, okwo “okutabangula,” kwe baayigganyanga mu bugwenyufu obwetoowaze bw’abagenyi, nga babutabangula n’okusekerera okutaliiko nsonga, ne baliisa ku ekyo essanyu lyabwe ery’ettima. Tewali kiyinza kufaanana bikolwa bya baddayimooni okusinga bino. Kale bandiyitiddwa batya mu mazima okusinga “Abatabanguzi”? bo bennyini nga be baasooka okutabangulwa n’okukyamizibwa ddala, emyoyo egy’obulimba nga gibasekerera era nga gibasendasenda mu kyama, mu ngeri y’emu bo gye basanyukiramu okusekerera n’okulimba abalala.

Essuula IV

Mu bantu ng’abo, mu myaka gyange egyo egitaali minywevu, nnasoma ebitabo eby’okwogera obulungi, mwe nnayagala okwatiikirira, olw’ekigendererwa ekivumirirwa eky’okwenyumiriza okutaliimu, essanyu mu butaliimu bw’abantu. Mu kusoma okwa bulijjo, ne ntuuka ku kitabo ekimu ekya Cicero, ng’olulimi lwe kumpi buli muntu alwewuunya, naye si mutima gwe. Ekitabo kye kino kirimu okukubiriza abantu okunoonya obufirosoofo, era kiyitibwa “Hortensius.” Naye ekitabo kino kyakyusa enneewulira yange, ne kizza essaala zange gy’Oli Ggwe wennyini, Ayi Mukama; ne kimpa ebigendererwa n’okwegomba ebirala. Buli ssuubi eritaliimu amangu ago ne liba lya bwereere gye ndi; ne nneegomba n’okwegomba okwaka ennyo mu ngeri etakkirizika obutafa bw’amagezi, ne ntandika okugolokoka, ndyoke nkomewo gy’Oli. Kubanga si lwa kuwagala lulimi lwange (ekyo kye nnali ndabika ng’agula n’ensimbi mmange ze yampanga, mu mwaka gwange ogwo ogw’ekkumi n’omwenda, nga kitange yali yafa emyaka ebiri emabega), si lwa kuwagala lulimi lwange kye nnakozesezza ekitabo ekyo; era tekyanzisaamu ngeri yaakyo ey’okwogera, wabula ebikirimu.

Nga nnaakanga nnyo mu kiseera ekyo, Ayi Katonda wange, nga nnaakanga okuva ku by’ensi okulinnya okudda gy’Oli, so nga simanyi ky’onookola nange? Kubanga amagezi gali gy’Oli. Naye okwagala amagezi mu Luyonaani kuyitibwa “bufirosoofo,” era ekitabo ekyo kye kyankoleezaamu omuliro ogwo. Waliwo abamu abasendasenda abantu nga bayita mu bufirosoofo, nga bakozesa erinnya eddene, eggonvu era ery’ekitiibwa okusiiga n’okubikka ensobi zaabwe: era kumpi bonna abaali bwe batyo mu mirembe egyo n’egyagisooka, ekitabo ekyo kibanenya era kibayanika: era omwo mwe mulabikira obulungi okubuulirira okwo okw’obulamu okw’Omwoyo wo, okwayita mu muddu wo omulungi era eyeewaayo eri Katonda: Mwekuumenga walemenga kubaawo n’omu ku mmwe abuzibwabuzibwa mu bufirosoofo ne mu by’obulimba ebitaliimu, okugobereranga obulombolombo obw’abantu n’ebiyigirizibwa abantu. Munywererenga ku biyigirizibwa ku Kristo. Kubanga mu Kristo okutuukiriza kwonna okw’Obwakabaka mwe kulabikira mu mubiri. Era olw’okuba mu kiseera ekyo (Ggwe omanyi, Ayi kitangaala ky’omutima gwange) nnali simanyi Byawandiikibwa by’Abatume, nnasanyukira okukubiriza okwo ku kigero kino kyokka, nti kyanzuukusa n’amaanyi, ne kinkoleezaamu omuliro, ne kinnyokya okwagala, n’okunoonya, n’okufuna, n’okukwata, n’okuwambaatira, si kibiina kino oba kiri, wabula amagezi gennyini, ka gabe ki; era kino kyokka kye kyanziyiza nga bwe nnali nnaaka bwe ntyo, nti erinnya lya Kristo teryalimu. Kubanga erinnya lino, ng’okusaasira kwo bwe kuli, Ayi Mukama, erinnya lino ery’Omulokozi wange, Omwana wo, omutima gwange omuto gwali gulinywedde n’okwewaayo wamu n’amabeere ga mmange, era nga gulitereka munda ennyo; era buli kintu ekyali kitaliimu linnya eryo, ne bwe kyandibadde kya magezi mangi, oba kirongoofu mu bigambo, oba kya mazima, tekyankwatanga ddala mu bujjuvu.

Essuula V

Awo ne nsalawo okussa ebirowoozo byange ku Byawandiikibwa ebitukuvu, ndabe bwe biri. Naye laba, ndaba ekintu ab’amalala kye batategeera, so nga tekibikkuliddwa baana bato, ekya wansi ku mulyango, naye munda waakyo nga kya waggulu nnyo, era nga kibikkiddwako ebyama; era nze saali wa ngeri esobola okukiyingiramu, oba okukutamya ensingo yange okugoberera ebigere byakyo. Kubanga bwe nnadda eri Ebyawandiikibwa ebyo, saawulira nga bwe njogera kaakano; wabula byandabikira nga tebisaanira kugeraageranyizibwa na kitiibwa ky’ebigambo bya Tully: kubanga amalala gange agazimba gaakyawa obwetoowaze bwabyo, so n’amagezi gange amasongovu tegaasobola kuyingira munda waabyo. Naye byali bya ngeri ekula wamu n’omwana omuto. Naye nze nnanyooma okuba omuto; era, nga nzimbye amalala, ne neerowooza okuba omukulu.

Essuula VI

Bwe ntyo ne ngwa mu bantu abaali basiru mu malala, ab’omubiri ennyo era ab’olulimi olutaliimu, abaalina mu kamwa kaabwe emitego gya Setaani, nga gisiigiddwa obulimbo obutabuddwamu ennukuta z’erinnya lyo, n’erya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, n’ery’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, Omuwolereza, Omubudaabudi waffe. Amannya gano tegaavanga mu kamwa kaabwe, naye nga gali ddoboozi lyokka n’okuyoogaana kw’olulimi, kubanga omutima gwali gwereere nga tegulimu mazima. Naye baaleekaananga nti “Amazima, Amazima,” ne bambuulira bingi ku go, naye nga tegaali mu bo: wabula baayogeranga eby’obulimba, si ku Ggwe wekka (Ggwe ali Amazima ddala), naye ne ku bintu ebisookerwako eby’ensi eno, ebitonde byo. Era nze mu butuufu nnandibadde nsaliza ne ku bafirosoofo abaayogeranga amazima ku bintu ebyo, olw’okukwagala Ggwe, Kitange, omulungi okusinga byonna, Obulungi bw’ebintu byonna ebirungi. Ayi Amazima, Amazima, obusomyo bw’emmeeme yange nga bwakwegombanga munda nnyo ne mu kiseera ekyo, bwe baakwogerangako gye ndi emirundi mingi era mu ngeri nnyingi, ne mu bitabo bingi era ebinene, wadde nga lyali ddoboozi eriddamu buddi bwokka? Era bino bye byali essowaani mwe bampeeranga, nze eyali alumwa enjala ku lwo, mu kifo kyo, enjuba n’omwezi, emirimu gyo emirungi, naye nga mirimu gyo, si Ggwe wennyini, era si n’emirimu gyo egyasooka. Kubanga emirimu gyo egy’omwoyo gisooka emirimu gino egy’omubiri, ne bwe giba gya mu ggulu era nga gyakaayakana. Naye nnali sirumwa njala na nnyonta wadde ku lw’emirimu gyo egyo egyasooka, wabula ku lwo Ggwe wennyini, Amazima, atakyukakyuka newaakubadde okwefuula ekirala: naye bo ne beeyongeranga okunteekera mu ssowaani ezo ebifaananyi ebitaliiwo ebimasamasa, nga kyandibadde kirungi okwagala enjuba eno yennyini (eya mazima eri amaaso gaffe waakiri), okusinga ebifaananyi ebyo ebitaliiwo ebirimba ebirowoozo byaffe nga biyita mu maaso gaffe. Naye olw’okuba nnalowooza nti ye Ggwe, ne mbiryako; si n’omululu, kubanga mu byo tewampoomera nga bw’oli; kubanga Ggwe tewali bintu ebyo ebitaliimu, era saaliisibwa nabyo, wabula byannafuya bunafuya. Emmere mu kirooto efaanana nnyo emmere yaffe nga tuzuukuse; naye abeebase tebaliisibwa nayo, kubanga beebase. Naye ebyo tebyakufaanana n’akatono, nga bw’oyogedde nange kaakano; kubanga byali bifaananyi bya mibiri ebitaliiwo, emibiri egy’obulimba, nga emibiri gino egy’amazima, egy’omu ggulu oba egy’oku nsi, gye tulaba n’amaaso gaffe ag’omubiri, gye gyesigika okusingira ddala: ebintu bino ensolo n’ebinyonyi bibiraba nga ffe bwe tubiraba, era byesigika okusinga bwe tubirowooza obulowooza. Era nate tubirowooza mu ngeri esinga okwesigika, okusinga bwe tubyesigamako okuteebereza emibiri emirala eminene ennyo egitaliiko kkomo egitaliiwo n’akatono. Ebikuta ebitaliimu nga ebyo bye nnaliisibwanga mu kiseera ekyo; era saakkusibwanga. Naye Ggwe, Ayi Kwagala kw’emmeeme yange, gwe nnafuwa nga nkunoonya, ndyoke mbe wa maanyi, toli mibiri egyo gye tulaba, ne bwe giba mu ggulu; so toli egyo gye tutalabayo; kubanga Ggwe wagitonda, era togibala mu mirimu gyo egisinga obukulu. Kale nga oli wala nnyo n’ebifaananyi byange ebyo ebitaliiwo, ebifaananyi by’emibiri egitaliiwo ddala, nga ebifaananyi by’emibiri egiriwo bye byesigika okusingira ddala, era n’emibiri gyennyini gye gyesigika okusingawo, kyokka nga Ggwe toli gyo; nedda, era toli wadde emmeeme, bwe bulamu bw’emibiri. Kale, obulamu bw’emibiri bulungi era bwesigika okusinga emibiri. Naye Ggwe oli bulamu bwa mmeeme, obulamu bw’obulamu, alina obulamu mu Ggwe wennyini; era tokyukakyuka, Ayi bulamu bw’emmeeme yange.

Kale mu kiseera ekyo wali ludda wa gye ndi, era wali wala nange kwenkana wa? Mazima nnali mbuze wala nnyo okuva gy’Oli, nga ngaaniddwa wadde ebikuta by’embizzi, ze nnaliisanga ebikuta. Kubanga enfumo z’abayiiya ebitontome n’abasomesa b’olulimi nga zisinga nnyo emitego gino? Kubanga ebitontome, n’ennyimba, ne “Medea abuuka,” mazima bigasa okusinga ebintu ebisookerwako ebitaano eby’abantu bano, ebyambaziddwa mu ngeri nnyingi, ebikwatagana n’empuku ttaano ez’ekizikiza, ezitaliiwo, naye nga zitta omukkiriza. Kubanga ebitontome n’ennyimba nsobola okubifuula emmere ey’amazima; ne “Medea abuuka,” wadde nga nnagiyimba, saagiwagira; wadde nga nnagiwulira ng’eyimbibwa, saagikkiriza: naye ebyo eby’abo nnabikkiriza. Zinsanze, zinsanze, nga nnaserengesebwa mu madaala ki okutuuka mu buziba obw’emagombe! nga nteganira era nga ntabuka olw’obutaba na Mazima, kubanga nnakunoonyanga, Ayi Katonda wange (gy’Oli kye nkyatula, Ggwe eyansaasira nga sinnaba kwatula), si ng’okutegeera kw’ebirowoozo bwe kuli, kwe wayagala ndyoke nsinge ensolo, wabula ng’okuwulira kw’omubiri bwe kuli. Naye Ggwe wali munda mu nze okusinga ekitundu kyange eky’omunda ennyo; era waggulu okusinga ekyange ekisinga obugulumivu. Ne nsisinkana omukazi oli ow’ekyejo, omusirusiru atamanyi kintu, ayogerwako mu bufaananyi mu Sulemaani, atuula mu mulyango, ng’agamba nti, Mulye n’essanyu emmere eriibwa mu kyama, era munywe amazzi amabbe agawooma: n’ansendasenda, kubanga yasanga emmeeme yange ng’ebeera ebweru mu liiso ly’omubiri gwange, ng’ezza mu kamwa emmere ng’eyo gye nnali mmize nga mpita mu lyo.

Essuula VII

Kubanga ng’oggyeko kino, ekiriwo ddala saakimanya; era, ng’olw’obusongovu bw’amagezi, ne nsendebwasendebwa okukkiriziganya n’abalimba abasirusiru, bwe bambuuzanga nti, “obubi buva wa?” “Katonda akomebwako ekifaananyi eky’omubiri, era alina enviiri n’enjala?” “abo abaalina abakazi abangi omulundi gumu, ne batta abantu, ne bawaayo ebiramu nga ssaddaaka, basaanidde okuyitibwa abatuukirivu?” Ebyo byanteganya nnyo mu butamanya bwange, era nga ndeka amazima, ne ndowooza nti nze nga ndaga gye gali; kubanga nnali sinnamanya nti obubi si kirala wabula okubulwa obulungi, okutuusa ekintu lwe kiggwaawo ddala obutabaawo; ekyo nnandikirabye ntya, nze amaaso gange ge gaakomanga ku kulaba emibiri gyokka, n’ebirowoozo byange ku bifaananyi ebitaliiwo? Era nnali simanyi nti Katonda Mwoyo, so si oyo alina ebitundu ebigaziye mu buwanvu ne mu bugazi, oba ng’obubeerawo bwe bwa bunene bwa mubiri; kubanga buli kintu ekirina obunene kitono mu kitundu kyakyo okusinga mu kyonna: era bwe kiba nga tekiriiko kkomo, kiteekwa okuba ekitono mu kitundu ekipimiddwa ebbanga erigere, okusinga mu butaba na kkomo bwakyo; bwe kityo tekiri wonna wonna mu bujjuvu, nga Omwoyo, nga Katonda. Era ekyo ekiri mu ffe ekitufaananya Katonda, era olw’ekyo kye tuyinza okwogerwako mu butuufu nti twatondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda, saakimanya n’akatono.

So saamanya obutuukirivu obwo obw’amazima obw’omunda, obutasala misango ng’empisa bwe ziri, wabula okuva mu tteeka ery’obutuukirivu ennyo erya Katonda Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna, eryategeka empisa z’ebifo n’ebiseera ng’ebiseera ebyo n’ebifo ebyo bwe biri; ate lyo lyennyini nga libeera lye limu bulijjo era wonna wonna, so si kintu kimu mu kifo kimu, n’ekirala mu kirala; nga ku lw’eryo Ibulayimu, ne Isaaka, ne Yakobo, ne Musa, ne Dawudi baali batuukirivu, n’abo bonna abaatenderezebwa akamwa ka Katonda; naye abantu abasirusiru ne babasalira omusango nti si batuukirivu, nga basala okusinziira ku kulamula kw’abantu, era nga bapima empisa z’olulyo lwonna olw’abantu n’empisa zaabwe entono. Kiringa omuntu mu ggwanika ly’ebyokulwanyisa, atamanyi kituukana na buli kitundu kya mubiri, n’abikka omutwe gwe n’ebikuuma amagulu, oba n’anoonya okwambala enkuufiira y’ekyuma ku bigere, ate ne yeemulugunya nti tebimugya: oba ng’omuntu, ku lunaku emirimu kwe giyimirizibwa mu lwatu olw’eggulo, n’asunguwala olw’obutakkirizibwa kuggulawo dduuka lye, kubanga yaliggudde ku makya; oba bw’alaba mu nnyumba emu omuweereza omu ng’akwata mu ngalo ze ekintu, omusenero ky’atakkirizibwa kukwatako; oba ekintu ekikkirizibwa ebweru, ate nga kiziyizibwa mu kisenge eky’okuliiramu; n’asunguwala nti mu nnyumba emu, ne mu maka gamu, ekintu kye kimu tekiweebwa buli wamu, ne buli muntu. Bwe batyo bwe bali abo abanyiiga okuwulira nti waliwo ekintu ekyali kikkirizibwa abatuukirivu edda, ekitakkirizibwa kaakano; oba nti Katonda, olw’ensonga ezimu ez’ebiseera, yalagira bo ekintu kimu, n’abano ekirala, ate bombi nga bagondera obutuukirivu bwe bumu: so nga balaba, mu muntu omu, ne mu lunaku lumu, ne mu nnyumba emu, ebintu eby’enjawulo nga bisaanira ebitundu eby’enjawulo, n’ekintu ekyali kikkirizibwa edda, oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera ekigere nga tekikyakkirizibwa; mu nsonda emu nga kikkirizibwa oba kiragiddwa, naye mu ndala nga kiziyizibwa mu butuufu era nga kibonerezebwa. Kale obwenkanya bwa ngeri nnyingi oba bukyukakyuka? Nedda, wabula ebiseera bwe bufuga tebiyita mu ngeri y’emu, kubanga biseera. Naye abantu, ennaku zaabwe ku nsi ezitali nnyingi, olw’okuba mu kuwulira kwabwe tebasobola kukwataganya nsonga za bintu eby’emirembe egyayita n’amawanga amalala, bye bataalabako, n’ebyo bye balabako, so nga mu mubiri gumu, oba mu lunaku lumu, oba mu maka gamu, balaba mangu ekisaanira buli kitundu, na buli kiseera, na buli kifo, na buli muntu; ebyo ebimu babiwakanya, ate ebirala babigondera.

Ebintu bino mu kiseera ekyo saabimanya, so saabyetegereza; byankubanga mu maaso enjuyi zonna, naye ne sibiraba. Nnawandiikanga ebitontome, nga sisobola kuteeka buli kigere kya luyimba buli wamu, wabula mu ngeri ya njawulo mu ntegeka ez’enjawulo; era wadde mu ntegeka emu, ekigere kye kimu mu bifo byonna. Naye amagezi gennyini ag’okuyiiya ge nnawandiikisanga tegaalina nnono za njawulo ku nsonga ezo ez’enjawulo, wabula gaagatta byonna mu kimu. Naye saalaba ngeri obutuukirivu obwo, abantu abalungi era abatukuvu bwe baagonderanga, bwe bwagatta mu kimu, mu ngeri esinga ennyo obulungi n’obugulumivu, ebintu byonna Katonda bye yalagira, era nga tebukyuka mu kitundu kyonna; wadde nga mu biseera ebikyukakyuka tebwalagira buli kintu omulundi gumu, wabula bwagabanya ne bulagira ekyo ekisaanira buli kiseera. Era nze mu buzibe bwange, ne nnenya Bajjajja abatukuvu, si mu ebyo byokka mwe baakozesezanga ebintu ebyaliwo nga Katonda bwe yabalagira era bwe yabaluŋŋamya, naye ne mu ebyo mwe baalagulira ebigenda okujja, nga Katonda bwe yabibikkulanga mu bo.

Essuula VIII

Kiyinza okuba nga si kya butuukirivu, mu kiseera kyonna oba mu kifo kyonna, omuntu okwagala Katonda n’omutima gwe gwonna, n’emmeeme ye yonna, n’amagezi ge gonna; ne muliraanwa we nga bwe yeeyagala yekka? N’olwekyo ebyonoono ebyo eby’obugwagwa ebikontana n’obutonde birina okukyayibwa n’okubonerezebwa wonna era mu biseera byonna; nga bwe byali ebyo eby’abasajja b’e Sodomu: singa amawanga gonna gabikola, gonna gandisingiddwa omusango gwe gumu, olw’etteeka lya Katonda, eritaakola bantu nti bakozesagane bubi bwe batyo. Kubanga n’enkolagana eyo eyandibaddewo wakati wa Katonda naffe eyonoonebwa, obutonde obwo bwennyini, Ye bwe yatonda, bwe bwonoonebwa n’obukyamu bw’okwegomba okubi. Naye ebikolwa ebyo ebisobya ku mpisa z’abantu birina okwewalibwa ng’empisa ezikola mu buli kifo bwe ziri; kale ekintu ekyakkiriziganyizibwako, era ekyanywezebwa, olw’empisa oba etteeka ly’ekibuga kyonna oba eggwanga lyonna, tekisaana kumenyebwa olw’okwegomba okutaliiko tteeka okw’omuntu yenna, oba nzaalwa oba mugwira. Kubanga buli kitundu ekitakwatagana na kyonna ekikirimu, kiba kya kwesittaza. Naye Katonda bw’alagira ekintu okukolebwa, ne bwe kiba kikontana n’empisa oba endagaano y’abantu bonna, ne bwe kiba nga tekyali kikoleddwa abo n’akatono emabega, kiteekwa okukolebwa; era bwe kiba kyalekebwa, kiteekwa okuzzibwawo; era bwe kiba nga tekyali kiragiddwa, kiteekwa okulagirwa kaakano. Kubanga bwe kiba nga kikkirizibwa kabaka, mu ggwanga ly’afuga, okulagira ekyo omuntu yenna eyamusooka ky’ataalagira, wadde ye yennyini emabega, era okumugondera tekiyinza kukontana na bulungi bwa ggwanga bwonna (nedda, wabula kyandikontanye nabwo singa tagonderwa, kubanga okugondera abafuzi ndagaano ya bonna mu bantu abali awamu); kale tusaanidde okugondera Katonda awatali kubuusabuusa okusingawo bwe kutyo, mu byonna by’alagira, Ye Mufuzi w’ebitonde bye byonna! Kubanga nga mu buyinza obuli mu bantu, obuyinza obusinga obukulu bwe bugonderwa okusinga obutono, bw’atyo ne Katonda bw’ateekwa okugonderwa okusinga byonna.
