Era kyangasa ki, nti nga nnaatera okuweza emyaka amakumi abiri, ekitabo kya Aristotle, kye bayita Ebika Ekkumi, bwe kyagwa mu mikono gyange (erinnya lyakyo lyokka lye nnawuniikiriranga, ng’ekintu ekinene era ekya Katonda, buli lwe nnawuliranga omusomesa wange ow’obwogezi e Carthage, n’abalala abaali batwalibwa ng’abayivu, nga balyatula ng’amatama gaabwe gazimbye olw’amalala), nnakisoma ne nkitegeera nga sirina anyamba? Era bwe nnakiteesaako n’abalala, abaagamba nti baakitegeera kizibu nnyo nga bayambibwa abasomesa abakugu ennyo, abataakinnyonnyola mu bigambo byokka, wabula nga bakuba n’ebifaananyi bingi mu musenyu, tebaasobola kumbuulira kisingawo ku kye nnali nnayize nga nkisoma nzekka. Era ekitabo kyandabikira nga kyogera mu ngeri etegeerekeka ennyo ku bintu ebiriwo ku bwabyo, nga “omuntu,” ne ku ngeri zaabyo, ng’ekifaananyi ky’omuntu, kya ngeri ki; n’obuwanvu bwe, aweza fuuti mmeka; n’oluganda lwe, muganda w’ani; oba gy’ali; oba lwe yazaalibwa; oba ng’ayimiridde oba atudde; oba ng’ayambadde engatto oba ng’alina eby’okulwanyisa; oba ng’alina ky’akola oba ky’akolebwa; n’ebintu byonna ebitabalika ebiyinza okuteekebwa wansi w’Ebika bino omwenda, bye mmaze okuwaako ebyokulabirako, oba wansi w’Ekika ekyo ekikulu eky’Ekintu Ekiriwo ku bwakyo.

Ebyo byonna byangasa ki, ng’ate byanziyiza? kubanga, nga ndowooza nti buli kiriwo kyali kizingirwa mu Bika ebyo ekkumi, nnagezaako okutegeera mu ngeri eyo, Ayi Katonda wange, n’Obumu bwo obw’ekitalo era obutakyukakyuka, ng’olinga naawe eyali afugibwa obukulu bwo oba obulungi bwo; ne kiba nti (nga bwe kiri mu mibiri) byandibadde mu Ggwe, nga Ggwe gwe bisinziirako: so nga Ggwe Wennyini gwe bukulu bwo n’obulungi bwo; naye omubiri si mukulu oba mulungi olw’okuba nti mubiri, kubanga newaakubadde nga gwandibadde mutono mu bukulu oba mu bulungi, gwandibadde mubiri bubeezi. Naye bwali bulimba bwe nnalowooza ku Ggwe, so si mazima, ebirowoozo ebiyiiye eby’obunaku bwange, so si bya nnamaddala eby’obulamu bwo obw’omukisa. Kubanga wali olagidde, era ne kituukirira mu nze, nti ensi enkumerezanga amaggwa n’amatovu, era nti mu ntuuyo z’ekyenyi kyange mwe nnaggyanga emmere yange.

Era kyangasa ki, nti ebitabo byonna bye nnasobola okufuna eby’ebyo ebiyitibwa amagezi ag’abantu ab’eddembe, nze omuddu omubi ow’okwegomba okubi, nnabisoma nzekka, ne mbitegeera? Era nnabisanyukiranga, naye nga simanyi gye byava byonna ebyalimu eby’amazima oba ebikakafu. Kubanga nnali nkubye omusana amabega, nga ntunudde eri ebintu ebyakirwa; n’olwekyo amaaso gange, ge nnalabisa ebintu ebyakirwa, go gennyini gaali tegaakirwa. Buli kyawandiikibwanga, oba ku bwogezi, oba ku nsonga z’okulowooza okutuufu, ku jjometule, ku nnyimba, ne ku kubala, nnakitegeeranga nzekka awatali buzibu bungi oba omusomesa yenna, Ggwe omanyi, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange; kubanga okwanguwa okutegeera n’obwogi mu kwawula birabo byo: kyokka saakuweerayo ssaddaaka okuva mu ebyo. Kale tebyangasa, wabula byantwala mu kuzikirira, kubanga nnafuba okufuna omugabo omulungi bwe gutyo ogw’ebintu byange ne ngukuuma nze kennyini; era amaanyi gange saagakuumira Ggwe, wabula ne nkuviira ne ŋŋenda mu nsi ey’ewala, okugamalira mu bwenzi. Kubanga obusobozi obulungi bwangasa ki, nga sibukozesa bulungi? Kubanga saategeera nti amagezi ago gafunibwa n’obuzibu bungi, ne bannyiikivu n’abalina ebitone, okutuusa lwe nnagezaako okugannyonnyola abantu ng’abo; ng’oyo eyasingangamu ye oyo eyangobereranga nga talwawo nnyo.

Naye kino kyangasa ki, nga ndowooza nti Ggwe, Ayi Mukama Katonda, Amazima, oli mubiri munene nnyo era ogwakaayakana, nange nga ndi kitundu kitono ku mubiri ogwo? Obukyamu obusukkiridde! Naye bwe ntyo bwe nnali. So sikwatibwa nsonyi, Ayi Katonda wange, okukwatulira okusaasira kwo gye ndi, n’okukukoowoola, nze ataakwatibwa nsonyi mu kiseera ekyo okulangirira mu bantu ebivume byange, n’okukuboggolera. Kale amagezi gange amangu mu by’okuyiga ebyo, n’ebitabo byonna ebyo ebisinga obuzibu, bye nnasumulula nzekka awatali buyambi bwa kuyigiriza kwa bantu, byangasa ki; ng’ate nnakyama bubi bwe ntyo, era n’obuswavu obw’obuvvoozi bwe butyo, mu kuyigiriza okw’okutya Katonda? Oba amagezi agasingako obulwa ennyo gaali kiziyiza ki eri abaana bo abato, okuva bwe kiri nti tebaakuvaako wala, balyoke mu kisu ky’Ekkanisa yo bamere ebyoya mu mirembe, era bakuze ebiwaawaatiro by’okwagala, nga balya emmere y’okukkiriza okulamu. Ayi Mukama Katonda waffe, tusuubirenga nga tuli mu kisiikirize ky’ebiwaawaatiro byo; tukuume, era otusitule. Ggwe olitusitula nga tukyali bato, era ne bwe tulimeramu envi olitusitulanga; kubanga obunywevu bwaffe, bwe buba Ggwe, olwo bwe bunywevu; naye bwe buba bwaffe ffekka, bunafu. Ekirungi kyaffe kibeera bulijjo gy’Oli; era bwe tukyuka ne tukivaako, tukyama. Ayi Mukama, kaakano tukomewo, tuleme kuvuunikibwa, kubanga gy’Oli ekirungi kyaffe kibeera nga tekiriiko kuvunda kwonna, era ekirungi ekyo ye Ggwe; so tetwetaaga kutya nti tewali we tunadda, kubanga twakiwanukako: kubanga olw’obutabaawo bwaffe, ennyumba yaffe teyagwa—obutaggwaawo bwo.
fields.body_text: Essuula I Mu bbanga lino ery’emyaka mwenda (okuva ku mwaka gwange ogw’ekkumi n’omwenda okutuuka ku gw’amakumi abiri mu munaana) twawangaala nga tusendebwasendebwa era nga tusendasenda abalala, nga tulimbibwa era nga tulimba, mu kwegomba okw’engeri nnyingi; mu lwatu, mu byenjigiriza bye bayita eby’abantu ab’eddembe; mu kyama, mu ddiini erina erinnya ery’obulimba; wano nga twegulumiza, wali nga tukkiririza mu by’obusamize, buli wamu nga tuli ba bwereere. Wano, nga tuyigga ettendo ery’obwereere eriva mu bantu, okutuuka n’okukubirwa mu ngalo mu bifo eby’emizannyo, n’ebirabo by’ebitontome, n’empaka olw’engule ez’omuddo, n’obusirusiru bw’ebivvulu, n’obutefuga mu kwegomba. Wali, nga twagala okutukuzibwa okuva mu bujama obwo, nga tutwalira emmere abo abaayitibwanga “abalonde” ne “abatukuvu,” bagiweese mu kkolero ly’embuto zaabwe, batukolere Bamalayika ne Bakatonda, abanditutukuzizza. Ebyo bye nagobereranga, era bye nakolanga wamu ne mikwano gyange, abaalimbibwa nze era abaalimbibwa wamu nange. Ab’amalala ka banjerege, n’abo abatakubwanga era abatasuulibwanga wansi Ggwe, Ayi Katonda wange, olw’obulamu bw’emmeeme zaabwe; naye nze nja kwongera okwatula gy’Oli ensonyi zange nga nkutendereza. Nzikiriza, nkwegayiridde, era ompe ekisa okuddamu okutambula, mu kujjukira kwange okwa kaakano, mu kubungeeta kwange okw’ebiro ebyayita, n’okuwaayo gy’Oli ekiweebwayo eky’okwebaza. Kubanga nze ndi ki eri nze kennyini nga Ggwe toliiwo, wabula omukulembeze antwala mu kuzikirira kwange? Oba ndi ki ne bwe mba mu mbeera esinga obulungi, wabula omwana omuwere anywa amata g’ompa, era alya Ggwe, emmere ebeerera? Naye omuntu yenna ali muntu wa ngeri ki, ng’ate muntu buntu? Kaakano ab’amaanyi n’ab’obuyinza ka batusekerere, naye ffe abaavu n’abeetaaga ka twatule gy’Oli. Essuula II Mu myaka egyo nayigirizanga eby’obwogezi, era, nga nnyiganyizibwa omululu, natundanga obwogezi obw’okuwangula nabwo abalala. Naye nayagalanga nnyo (Mukama, Ggwe omanyi) abayizi abeesigwa (nga bwe babalibwa), era abo, awatali lukujjukujju, nabayigirizanga enkwe z’ebigambo, si kuzikozesa ku bulamu bw’abatalina musango, wabula oluusi okutaasa obulamu bw’abalina omusango. Era Ggwe, Ayi Katonda, walaba okuva ewala nga nneesittala mu kkubo eryo eriseerera, era nga mu mukka omungi mwe mpulumya ensasi ntono ez’obwesigwa, bwe nalaganga mu kukulembera kwange abo abaanyumirwa okwagala ebitaliimu, n’okunoonya eby’obulimba, nga nange ndi munnaabwe. Mu myaka egyo nalina omukazi omu,—si mu ekyo ekiyitibwa obufumbo obukkirizibwa amateeka, wabula gwe nali nzudde mu kwegomba okwakyama, okutaliimu magezi; naye yali omu yekka, era namubeereranga mwesigwa; ku ye mwe nalabira nze kennyini enjawulo eri wakati w’okwefuga okw’endagaano y’obufumbo, olw’okuzaala abaana, n’endagaano y’okwagala okw’okwegomba, abaana mwe bazaalibwa nga bazadde baabwe tebaagala, wadde nga, bwe bamala okuzaalibwa, babawaliriza okubaagala. Era nzijukira nti bwe nali mmaliridde okuyingira empaka z’ekirabo eky’omu bifo eby’emizannyo, omulogo omu yambuuza kye nnandimuwadde nsobole okuwangula; naye nze, nga nkyawa era nga neetamwa ebyama ebyo ebivundu, ne mmuddamu nti, “Ne bwe gyandibadde engule ya zaabu etayonooneka, sandikkirizza nsowera kuttibwa ku lwange okugifuna.” Kubanga yali agenda kutta ebiramu ebimu mu ssaddaaka ze, era olw’ekitiibwa ekyo ayite baddayimooni bansiime. Naye n’obubi obwo nabugaana, si lwa kukwagala kulongoofu, Ayi Katonda w’omutima gwange; kubanga saamanya kukwagala, nze eyali tamanyi kulowooza ku kintu kyonna okusukka ekitangaala ekirabika n’amaaso. Era emmeeme, ng’esinda olw’ebirooto ng’ebyo, teyenda ng’ekuvaako, n’eyeesiga ebitaliiwo, n’erisa empewo? Kyokka, ddala, saayagala ssaddaaka ziweebweyo baddayimooni ku lwange, so nga nze kennyini nali nneewaayo gye bali ng’ekiweebwayo mu kukkiriza okwo okw’obusamize. Kubanga okulisa empewo kye ki ekirala, wabula okubalisa bo, kwe kugamba, okukyama ne tufuuka essanyu lyabwe n’eky’okusekererwa kwabwe? Essuula III Abalimba abo nno, be bayita Abakugu mu kubala, nabeebuuzangako awatali kwekengera; kubanga baalabikanga ng’abatakozesa ssaddaaka yonna, era nga tebasaba mwoyo gwonna mu bulaguzi bwabwe: naye obukugu obwo, okutya Katonda okw’Ekikristaayo era okw’amazima kubugaana bulijjo era kubusalira omusango. Kubanga kirungi okwatula gy’Oli, n’okugamba nti, onsaasire omponye; kubanga nnyonoonye mu maaso go; so si kukozesa bubi okusaasira kwo ng’olukusa okwonoona, wabula okujjukira ebigambo bya Mukama nti, Laba, kaakano oli mulamu, naye toddangamu okwonoona, akabi akasingawo kaleme okukutuukako. Okubuulirira okwo kwonna okulamu bafuba okukuzikiriza, nga bagamba nti, “Ensonga y’ekibi kyo yasalibwawo mu ggulu, tekyewalika”; ne, “Kino kyakolebwa Venus, oba Saturn, oba Mars”: omuntu, ddala, omubiri n’omusaayi, era obuvundu obw’amalala, abeere nga talina musango; ate Omutonzi era Omuteekateesi w’eggulu n’emmunyeenye y’abeera ow’okusibwako omusango. Era oyo y’ani wabula Katonda waffe? obuwoomi bwennyini era ensulo y’obutuukirivu, Ggwe asasula buli muntu ng’ebikolwa bye bwe biri: era omutima ogumenyese era oguboneredde toogugayenga. Mu nnaku ezo waaliwo omusajja omugezi, omukugu ennyo mu by’obusawo, era eyali amanyiddwa ennyo mu byo, eyali anteeseeko ku mutwe gwange ogwali omulwadde, n’omukono gwe yennyini ng’Omufuzi w’essaza, engule ey’empaka, naye si ng’omusawo: kubanga obulwadde buno Ggwe wekka gw’owonya, Ggwe alwana n’ab’amalala naye abawombeefu n’obawa ekisa. Naye wandeka, ne mu musajja oyo omukadde, oba walekayo okuwonya emmeeme yange? Kubanga bwe namumanya obulungi, ne mpuliriza nnyo era obutayosa ebigambo bye (kubanga newankubadde byali bya bigambo byangu, byali bya maanyi, birimu obulamu, era bya mazima), bwe yategeera mu bye nnyogera nti nali nneemalidde ku bitabo by’abalaguzi b’emmunyeenye, yambuulirira n’ekisa ng’omuzadde, okubisuula, n’obutamalira bwereere okwegendereza n’obunyiikivu, ebyetaagisa mu bintu eby’omugaso, ku bintu bino ebitaliimu; ng’agamba nti mu myaka gye egy’obuto yasoma obukugu obwo, ng’ayagala bufuuke omulimu gw’anaaliisanga obulamu bwe, era nti, nga bwe yategeera Hippocrates, yandisobodde mangu okutegeera okusoma ng’okwo; naye yabuvaako, n’adda mu by’obusawo, si lwa nsonga ndala yonna wabula nti yabusanga nga bwa bulimba ddala; era ye, omusajja ow’ekitiibwa, teyayagala kufuna bya kulya ng’alimba abantu. “Naye ggwe,” bw’atyo bwe yagamba, “olina eby’obwogezi by’oyinza okweyimirizaawo nabyo, n’olwekyo kino okigoberera lwa kweyagalira, so si lwa bwetaavu: kale osaanidde okunzikiriza ennyo mu kino, nze eyafuba okukiyiga mu bujjuvu, ndyoke ndiirenga mu kyo kyokka.” Bwe namubuuza nti kale ebintu bingi eby’amazima biyinza bitya okulagulwa nakyo, n’anziramu (nga bwe yasobola) “nti amaanyi g’obutanwa, agasaasaanidde mu ntegeka yonna ey’ebintu, ge gaaleetanga ekyo. Kubanga oba omuntu bw’ayasamya mu butanwa empapula z’omutontomi omu, eyayimba era eyalowooza ku kintu kirala ddala, olunyiriri lutera okuvaamu, nga lukwatagana nnyo mu ngeri ey’ekitalo n’ensonga eriwo: tekyandyewuunyisizza, singa okuva mu mmeeme y’omuntu, etamanyi bigirimu, olw’ekirowoozo ekisingako waggulu, okuddamu kwandiweereddwa, lwa butanwa, so si lwa bukugu, nga kukwatagana n’ensonga n’ebikolwa by’oyo abuuza.” Era ebyo, oba nga biva gy’ali oba nga biyita mu ye, wabimpa, n’obiwandiika mu kujjukira kwange, bye nnandyekebedde nze kennyini oluvannyuma. Naye mu kiseera ekyo ye, newakubadde Nebridius wange omwagalwa ennyo, omuvubuka omulungi ennyo mu ngeri ey’enjawulo era eyalina okutya okutukuvu, eyanyoomanga obulaguzi bwonna, tebaasobola kunsendasenda kubusuula, kubanga obuyinza bw’abawandiisi bwansikirizanga nnyo okusingawo, era nga sinnaba kuzuula bukakafu bwonna (nga bwe nnali nnoonya) obwandiraze awatali kubuusabuusa kwonna, nti ebyo ebyalagulwa mu mazima abo abaabuuzibwa byava mu butanwa, so si mu bukugu bw’abalaguzi b’emmunyeenye. Essuula IV Mu myaka egyo bwe natandika okuyigiriza eby’obwogezi mu kibuga kye nazaalibwamu, nalina omuntu gwe nafuula mukwano gwange, naye gwe nayagala ennyo okusukkiridde, olw’okuba twanoonyanga ebintu bye bimu, ow’emyaka gyange, era, nga nze, ng’ali mu kumulisa okusooka okw’obuvubuka. Twakulira wamu okuva mu buto, era twali bayizi banne era banne ab’okuzannya. Naye yali tannaba kufuuka mukwano gwange nga bwe yafuuka oluvannyuma, era ne mu kiseera ekyo omukwano gwaffe gwali si nga omukwano ogw’amazima bwe guli; kubanga tegusobola kuba gwa mazima, wabula mu abo b’ogatta wamu, abakwekwatako Ggwe, olw’okwagala okufukiddwa mu mitima gyaffe Omwoyo Omutukuvu, gwe twaweebwa. Naye gwali muwoomu nnyo okusukkiridde, nga gwengeddwa ebbugumu ly’okusoma kwe kumu: kubanga, okuva mu kukkiriza okw’amazima (kwe yali, ng’akyali muvubuka, tannakunywerezaamu bulungi era mu bujjuvu), namukyamya naye n’adda mu nfumo ezo ez’obusamize era ezizikiriza, maama wange ze yankaabiranga. Kaakano yali akyama mu birowoozo wamu nange, era emmeeme yange teyasobolanga kubeerawo nga ye taliiwo. Naye laba Ggwe wali kumpi ddala n’ebigere by’abo abakudduka, Ggwe mu kiseera kye kimu Katonda awalana eggwanga era Ensulo y’okusaasira, ng’otukomyawo gy’Oli mu ngeri ez’ekitalo; omuntu oyo wamuggya mu bulamu buno, nga yali tannatuukiriza mwaka mulamba gumu ogw’omukwano gwange, ogwali omuwoomu gye ndi okusinga obuwoomu bwonna obw’obulamu bwange obwo. Ani ayinza okwogera ettendo lyo lyonna n’alimalayo, ekyo omuntu oyo ky’awulidde mu ye yekka? Kiki kye wakola olwo, Katonda wange, era obuziba bw’ensala yo ey’emisango nga tebukeberekeka! Kubanga okumala ebbanga ddene, ng’alwadde nnyo omusujja, yagalamira nga tategeera, ng’ajjudde entuuyo z’okufa; era bwe baali tebakyasuubira nti aliwona, yabatizibwa, nga tamanyi; nze mu kiseera ekyo ne sikifaako nnyo, nga ndowooza nti emmeeme ye yandisigazza ekyo kye yali efunye okuva gye ndi, so si ekyo ekyakolebwa ku mubiri gwe ogwali tegutegeera. Naye kyali kirala ddala: kubanga yaddamu amaanyi, n’awona. Amangu ddala, nga nsobodde okwogera naye (era nasobola, amangu ddala nga naye asobodde, kubanga saamuvangako, era twali twesibaganye nnyo okusukkiridde), nagezaako okumusaagirako, nga ndowooza nti naye yandisaaze nange ku batismu eyo gye yali afunye, ng’ebirowoozo bye n’okuwulira kwe tebiriiwo n’akatono, naye kaakano yali ategedde nti yagifuna. Naye yanneewala nnyo, ng’eyeewala omulabe; era n’obuvumu obw’ekitalo era obw’amangu n’ankuutira nti, bwe njagala okusigala nga ndi mukwano gwe, ndekere awo okumwogerako ebigambo ng’ebyo. Nze, nga nneewuunyizza nnyo era nga nsamaaliridde, nakweka okuwulira kwange kwonna okutuusa lw’anaawona, n’obulamu bwe ne bunywera ekimala nsobole okumukola nga bwe njagala. Naye yaggibwa ku bulalu bwange, alyoke akuumirwe gy’Oli olw’okubudaabudibwa kwange; oluvannyuma lw’ennaku ntono, nga siriiwo, omusujja ne gumukwata nate, n’afa. Olw’ennaku eno omutima gwange gwaddugala ddala; era buli kye nalabanga kyali kufa. Ensi gye nazaalibwamu yali kibonyoobonyo gye ndi, n’ennyumba ya kitange yali nnaku eyeewuunyisa; era buli kye nagabananga naye, nga taliiwo, kyafuuka ekibonyoobonyo ekinsalaasala. Amaaso gange gaamunoonyanga buli wamu, naye tegaamuweebwa; era nakyawa ebifo byonna, kubanga ye yali talimu; era kaakano tebyasobola kuŋŋamba nti, “ajja,” nga bwe kyali ng’akyali mulamu naye nga taliiwo. Nafuuka ekikoikoi ekinene gye ndi nze kennyini, era ne mbuuza emmeeme yange, lwaki yali ennyise bw’etyo, era lwaki yali etabusetabuse mu nda yange ennyo: naye teyamanya ky’enanziramu. Era bwe nagambanga nti, Weesigenga Katonda, teyampuliranga, era kino kyali kituufu ddala; kubanga mukwano gwe ow’omuwendo ennyo gwe yali afiiriddwa, olw’okuba yali muntu, yali wa mazima era mulungi okusinga ekifaananyi ekyo eky’ekirooto kye yalagirwa okwesiga. Amaziga gokka ge gaali amawoomu gye ndi, kubanga ge gaadda mu kifo kya mukwano gwange, mu kifo ekisinga okuba eky’omuwendo mu mutima gwange. Essuula V Era kaakano, Mukama, ebyo biyise, era ekiseera kikkakkanyizza ekiwundu kyange. Nnyinza okuyiga okuva gy’Oli, Ggwe Mazima, ne nsembeza okutu kw’omutima gwange ku kamwa ko, ondyoke ombuulire lwaki okukaaba kuwooma eri abali mu nnaku? Ggwe, newakubadde ng’oli buli wamu, wasuula ennaku yaffe ewala okuva gy’Oli? Era Ggwe obeera mu Ggwe wennyini, naye ffe tusuukundibwa mu kugezesebwa okw’engeri nnyingi. Era kyokka singa tetwakungubaga mu matu go, tetwandibadde na ssuubi lyonna erisigaddewo. Kale ebibala ebiwoomu bikungulwa wa okuva mu bukaawu bw’obulamu, mu kukaaba olw’obulumi, mu maziga, mu kussa ebikkowe, ne mu kwemulugunya? Kino kye kibiwoomya, nti tusuubira nti Ggwe owulira? Kino kya mazima ku kusaba, kubanga omwo mulimu okwegomba okusemberera gy’Oli. Naye bwe kiri ne mu nnaku olw’ekintu ekibuze, n’obuyinike bwe nali nzitoowereddwa nabwo mu kiseera ekyo? Kubanga saasuubira nti alikomawo mu bulamu, era saakyegomba n’amaziga gange; naye nakaabanga kyokka era ne nnakuwala. Kubanga nali mu nnaku, era nali nfiiriddwa essanyu lyange. Oba okukaaba ddala kintu kikaawu, era olw’okwetamwa ennyo ebintu bye twanyumirwanga edda, kye kiva kitusanyusa, bwe tubyewala? Essuula VI Naye lwaki njogera ku bino? kubanga kaakano si kiseera kya kubuuza, wabula kya kwatula gy’Oli. Nali mu nnaku; era buli mmeeme esibiddwa omukwano gw’ebintu ebiggwaawo eri mu nnaku; eyuzibwayuzibwa bw’ebifiirwa, era olwo n’ewulira ennaku gye yalina na mu kiseera nga tennabifiirwa. Bwe kyali bwe kityo gye ndi mu kiseera ekyo; nakaaba nnyo n’obulumi obungi, era ne nzuula ekiwummulo kyange mu bukaawu. Bwe ntyo nali mu nnaku, era obulamu obwo obw’ennaku nabutwala nga bwa muwendo okusinga mukwano gwange. Kubanga newankubadde nandyagadde okubukyusa, naye saayagala kwawukana nabwo okusinga bwe saayagala kwawukana naye; weewaawo, simanyi oba nandibuvuddeko wadde ku lulwe, nga bwe kyogerwa (bwe kiba nga si kya kugunjibwa) ku Pylades ne Orestes, nti bandifudde n’essanyu omu ku lw’omunne oba bombi wamu, kubanga obutabeerera wamu kyali gye bali kibi okusinga okufa. Naye mu nze mwali mumaze okuvaamu okuwulira okumu okutannyonnyolekeka, okukontana ennyo n’ekyo, kubanga mu kiseera kye kimu nali neetamiddwa nnyo okuba omulamu era nga ntya okufa. Ndowooza nti, gye nakoma okumwagala, gye nakoma okukyawa, n’okutya (ng’omulabe asinga obukambwe) okufa, okwamunzigyako: era nalowooza nti kwandimazeewo mangu abantu bonna, okuva bwe kwalina obuyinza ku ye. Bwe kyali bwe kityo gye ndi, nzijukira. Laba omutima gwange, Ayi Katonda wange, laba era otunule munda mu nze; kubanga nkijjukira bulungi, Ayi Ssuubi lyange, Ggwe ontukuza okuva mu bujama bw’okwagala okw’engeri eyo, ng’oluŋŋamya amaaso gange gy’Oli, era ng’onzigya ebigere byange mu kitego. Kubanga neewuunya nti abalala, abali wansi w’okufa, baali balamu, so nga oyo gwe nayagala, ng’alinga atalifa, yali afudde; era neewuunya nnyo okusingawo nti nze kennyini, eyali gy’ali nga ye yennyini ow’okubiri, nali nsobola okuba omulamu, nga ye afudde. Omu yayogera bulungi ku mukwano gwe nti, “ggwe ekitundu ky’emmeeme yange”; kubanga nawulira nti emmeeme yange n’emmeeme ye zaali “emmeeme emu mu mibiri ebiri”: era kyekyava obulamu bwange bufuuka ekintiisa gye ndi, kubanga saayagala kubeera mulamu nga ndi kitundu. Era kyekyava oboolyawo ntya okufa, oyo gwe nayagala ennyo aleme okufiira ddala. Essuula VII Wamma obulalu, obutamanyi kwagala bantu nga bantu! Wamma omuntu omusirusiru nze gwe nnali olwo, eyagumiikirizanga n’obutagumiikiriza omugabo gw’omuntu! Olwo neeraliikiriranga, nassanga ebikkowe, nakaabanga, nasoberwanga; saalina kiwummulo wadde amagezi. Kubanga neetikkanga emmeeme eyabetentebwa era ng’eyiwa omusaayi, eyali tekkiriza kwetikkibwa nze, naye we nnandigiwummuzza, saalaba. Teyafuna kiwummulo mu bibira ebiteefu, wadde mu mizannyo n’ennyimba, wadde mu bifo ebiwunya akawoowo, wadde mu bijjulo eby’ekitalo, wadde mu masanyu ag’ekitanda n’entebe ey’okwesemba; wadde (ekisembayo) mu bitabo oba mu bitontome. Ebintu byonna byalabikanga bya ntiisa, weewaawo, n’ekitangaala kyennyini; buli ekitaali ekyo ye kye yali, kyali kyenyinyalwa era kikyayibwa, okuggyako okusinda n’amaziga. Kubanga mu ebyo byokka mwe nafuniranga okuwummulamu akatono. Naye emmeeme yange bwe yabiggibwangako, omugugu omunene ogw’ennaku gwanzitoowereranga. Gwali gusaanidde okusitulibwa eri Ggwe, Ayi Mukama, Ggwe ogwanguyize; nakimanya; naye saasobola era saayagala; n’okusingawo, kubanga, bwe nakulowoozangako, tewali gye ndi kintu kinywevu oba ekiriko ddala. Kubanga tewali Ggwe wennyini, wabula ekifaananyi eky’ekirooto kyokka, era ensobi yange ye yali katonda wange. Bwe nagezangako okussa omugugu gwange ku kyo, gulyoke guwummule, gwaseerereranga mu bwereere, ne gukka nate ku nze n’amaanyi; era nasigala gye ndi nze kennyini ekifo ekitalina mukisa, mwe saasobola kubeera, wadde okukivaamu. Kubanga omutima gwange gwandiddukidde wa okuva ku mutima gwange? Nnandiddukidde wa okuva ku nze kennyini? Wa we sandyegoberedde? Kyokka nadduka mu nsi y’ewaffe; kubanga bwe ntyo amaaso gange gandimunoonyezza katono, mu kifo we gaali tegamanyidde kumulaba. Era bwe ntyo okuva e Thagaste, najja e Carthage. Essuula VIII Ebiseera tebifiirwa kiseera; era tebiyitawo bwereere; nga biyita mu by’okuwulira byaffe bikola emirimu egy’ekitalo ku birowoozo. Laba, byagendanga ne bijja buli lunaku, era mu kujja n’okugenda, byaleeta mu birowoozo byange ebirowoozo ebirala n’okujjukira okulala; era mpolampola ne binzizzaawo nate n’amasanyu gange ag’edda, ennaku yange eyo n’egaddira emabega. Era kyokka ne biddirira, si nnaku endala ddala, naye ensibuko z’ennaku endala. Kubanga ennaku eyo eyasooka yatuuka etya mangu bw’etyo munda ddala mu mmeeme yange, wabula kubanga nali nfuse emmeeme yange ku nfuufu, mu kwagala omuntu ow’okufa, ng’alinga atalifa? Kubanga ekyasinga okunzizaamu amaanyi n’okumbudaabuda kwe kubudaabudibwa mikwano gyange emirala, be nayagala nabo kye nayagalanga mu kifo kyo; era kino kyali lufumo lunene, era bulimba bwa bbanga ddene, olw’okusikiriza kwalwo okw’obwenzi, emmeeme yaffe, eyali eyenja mu matu gaffe, yali eyonoonebwa. Naye olufumo olwo terwafanga gye ndi, buli omu ku mikwano gyange lwe yafanga. Waaliwo ebirala mu bo ebyasinganga okusikiriza ebirowoozo byange; okunyumya n’okusaaga wamu, okukolagana eby’ekisa nga tuddiriŋŋana; okusomera wamu ebitabo ebiwoomu ng’omubisi gw’enjuki; okukola eby’obusirusiru oba okuba ab’amazima wamu; okukaayana oluusi awatali kunyiiga, ng’omuntu bw’ayinza okukaayana ne yennyini; era n’olw’obutatera kukaayana okwo, okuwoomya okukkiriziganya kwaffe okwali okungi; oluusi okuyigiriza, oluusi okuyiga; okwegomba abatali wamu naffe nga tetugumiikiriza; n’okwaniriza abajja n’essanyu. Ebyo n’ebirala ebifaanana bwe bityo, nga biva mu mitima gy’abo abaagala era abaagalibwa nabo, nga biyita mu ndabika y’obwenyi, mu lulimi, mu maaso, ne mu bikolwa ebisanyusa enkumi n’enkumi, byali ng’enku ezisaanuusa emmeeme zaffe ne zigattibwa wamu, ne zifuula ennyingi emu yokka. Essuula IX Kino kye kyagalibwa mu mikwano; era kyagalibwa nnyo, nti omutima gw’omuntu ogumulumiriza gwesalira omusango, bw’ataagala oyo amwagala nate, oba bw’atazzaamu kwagala oyo amwagala, nga tanoonya kirala kyonna okuva ku muntu we wabula obubonero bw’okwagala kwe. Kye kiva wabaawo okukungubaga okwo, omu bw’afa, n’ekizikiza ky’ennaku, omutima okunnyikibwa mu maziga, obuwoomu bwonna nga bufuuse obukaawu; era olw’okufiirwa obulamu kw’oyo afudde, okufa kw’abo abalamu. Alina omukisa oyo akwagala Ggwe, n’ayagala mukwano gwe mu Ggwe, n’ayagala omulabe we ku lulwo. Kubanga oyo yekka y’atafiirwa n’omu gw’ayagala, oyo bonna be yagala mu Oyo atayinza kubula. Era oyo y’ani wabula Katonda waffe, Katonda eyakola eggulu n’ensi, era abijjuza, kubanga mu kubijjuza mwe yabitondera? Tewali akufiirwa, wabula oyo akuleka. Era oyo akuleka, agenda wa oba addukira wa, wabula okuva gy’Oli ng’osanyuse, okudda gy’Oli ng’onyiize? Kubanga wa we atasanga mateeka go mu kubonerezebwa kwe? Era amateeka go ga mazima, era amazima ye Ggwe. Essuula X Tukomyewo gy’oli, Ayi Katonda ow’Eggye, otutunuulize amaaso go ag’ekisa, tulokolebwe. Kubanga buli gye yeekyusiza emmeeme y’omuntu, okuggyako gy’Oli, ekomererwa ku nnaku, weewaawo newankubadde nga ekomererwa ku bintu ebirungi. Era kyokka ebyo, ebiri ebweru wo, era ebweru w’emmeeme, tebyandibaddewo, singa tebyava gy’Oli. Bivaayo, ne bigwa; era mu kuvaayo, bitandika ng’okubaawo; bikula, bituukirire; era bwe bimala okutuukirira, bikaddiwa ne biwotoka; era si byonna nti bikaddiwa, naye byonna bizikirira. Kale bwe bivaayo nga bigenda okubaawo, gye bikoma okukula amangu bibeerewo, gye bikoma okwanguwa obutabaawo. Lino lye tteeka lyabyo. Ekyo kyokka kye wabigabira, kubanga bitundu bya bintu, ebitabeerawo byonna omulundi gumu, naye mu kuggwaawo n’okuddiriŋŋana, byonna awamu bituukiriza obutonde bwonna, bwe biri ebitundu byabwo. Era bwe kityo n’okwogera kwaffe bwe kutuukirizibwa olw’obubonero obuvaamu eddoboozi: naye era kino tekutuukirira okuggyako ekigambo ekimu nga kiyiseewo bwe kimala okuvuga ekitundu kyakyo, ekirala kiryoke kiddirire. Olw’ebintu bino byonna emmeeme yange ka ekutendereze, Ayi Katonda, Omutonzi wa byonna; naye emmeeme yange ereme okukomererwa ku bintu bino n’obulimbo bw’okwagala, nga biyita mu by’okuwulira by’omubiri. Kubanga bigenda gye byali bigenda, bireme okubaawo; era bigiyuzaayuza n’okwegomba okulwaza, kubanga yo yeegomba okubaawo, kyokka yagala okuwummulira mu ebyo by’eyagala. Naye mu bintu bino temuli kifo kya kiwummulo; tebibeerera, bidduka; era ani ayinza okubigoberera n’ebyokuwulira by’omubiri? weewaawo, ani ayinza okubikwata, ne bwe biba kumpi? Kubanga okuwulira kw’omubiri kugayaavu, kubanga kwe kuwulira kw’omubiri; era kye kiva kukomebwa. Kumala ku ekyo kye kwatonderwa; naye tekumala kuyimiriza bintu ebiddukira mu kkubo lyabyo okuva we byalagirwa okutandikira okutuuka ku nkomerero eyalagirwa. Kubanga mu Kigambo kyo, mwe bitonderwa, mwe biwulirira etteeka lyabyo, “okuva wano, okutuuka wano.” Essuula XI Toba musirusiru, Ayi ggwe emmeeme yange, era tofuuka kiggala mu kutu kw’omutima gwo olw’oluyoogaano lw’obusirusiru bwo. Naawe wuliriza. Ekigambo kyennyini kikuyita okudda: era eyo ye kifo eky’ekiwummulo ekitatabulwatabulwa, okwagala gye kutalekebwa, bwe kuba nga kwo kwennyini tekuleka. Laba, bino biggwaawo, ebirala bidde mu kifo kyabyo, era bwe butyo obutonde buno obwa wansi butuukirizibwe n’ebitundu byabwo byonna. Naye Nze nva ne ŋŋenda wonna? bwe kityo bwe kyogera Ekigambo kya Katonda. Eyo zimbayo ekisulo kyo, eyo teresaayo buli ky’olina ekyava eyo, Ayi ggwe emmeeme yange, waakiri kaakano ng’okooye ebitaliimu. Kwasa Amazima buli ky’olina ekyava mu Mazima, era tolifiirwa kintu; n’okuvunda kwo kulimulisa nate, ne endwadde zo zonna ziriwonyezebwa, n’ebitundu byo ebifa birikolebwa buggya ne bizzibwa obuggya, ne bisibibwa okukwetooloola: so tebirikuteeka gye bikka byo; naye biriyimirira wamu naawe nga binywevu, era biribeerera emirembe gyonna mu maaso ga Katonda, Abeerera era Ayimirira nga munywevu emirembe gyonna. Kale lwaki okyama n’ogoberera omubiri gwo? Gwo ka gukyuke gukugoberere ggwe. Buli ky’owulira nga kiyita mu gwo, kya kitundu; n’ekyo ekijjuvu, ebyo bye bitundu byakyo, tokimanyi; era kyokka bikusanyusa. Naye singa okuwulira kw’omubiri gwo kwalina obusobozi okutegeera ekijjuvu, era singa nakwo tekwakomebwa mu bwenkanya ku kitundu ky’ekijjuvu, olw’okubonerezebwa kwo, wandyagadde buli ekiriwo mu kiseera kino kiyiteewo, ekijjuvu kiryoke kikusanyuse okusingawo. Kubanga n’ebyo bye twogera, obiwulira olw’okuwulira kw’omubiri okwo kwe kumu; naye toyagala bitundu by’ebigambo bisigale, wabula bibuuke bigende, ebirala bijje, olyoke owulire ekijjuvu. Era bwe kityo bulijjo, ekintu kyonna bwe kiba nga kikolebwa mu bintu bingi, ebitabeerawo byonna omulundi gumu, byonna awamu byandisanyusizza okusinga bwe bisanyusa nga biri kinnakimu, singa byonna bisobola okutegeerebwa awamu. Naye asinga ebyo wala nnyo Oyo eyakola byonna; era Ye Katonda waffe, era tayitawo, kubanga tewali kimuddirira. Essuula XII Emibiri bwe gikusanyusa, tendereza Katonda ku lwagyo, era okwagala kwo kuzzeeyo eri Oyo eyagikola; sikulwa ng’olw’ebintu bino ebikusanyusa, ggwe n’otamusanyusa. Emmeeme bwe zikusanyusa, ziyagalibwe mu Katonda: kubanga nazo zikyukakyuka, naye mu Ye mwe zinywerera ddala; bwe zitandibadde bwe zityo, zandiyiseewo ne ziggwaawo. Kale ziyagalibwenga mu Ye; era twala gy’ali emmeeme zonna z’osobola wamu naawe, ozigambe nti, “Tumwagale Ye, tumwagale Ye: Ye yakola bino, era tali wala. Kubanga teyabikola n’oluvannyuma n’abiviira, wabula biva gy’ali, era biri mu Ye. Laba, ali awo, amazima we gaagalibwa. Ali munda ddala mu mutima, naye omutima gwamuvaako ne guwaba. Muddeyo mu mitima gyammwe, mmwe abajeemu, mwekwate nnyo ku Oyo eyabakola. Muyimirire naye, mujja kuyimirira nga muli banywevu. Muwummulire mu Ye, mujja kuba n’ekiwummulo. Mulaga wa mu makubo amazibu? Mulaga wa? Ekirungi kye mwagala kiva gy’ali; naye kirungi era kisanyusa olw’okuba nti kimutunuulira Ye, era kya nsonga kirifuuka ekikaawa, kubanga si kya butuukirivu okwagala ekintu kyonna ekiva gy’ali, ate Ye n’alekebwa olw’ekyo. Kale lwaki mwagala okweyongera bweyongezi okutambulira mu makubo gano amazibu era agakooya? Tewali kiwummulo eyo gye mukinoonyeza. Munoonye kye munoonya; naye tekiri eyo gye mukinoonyeza. Munoonya obulamu obw’omukisa mu nsi y’okufa; tebuliiyo. Kubanga obulamu obw’omukisa bwandibaddewo butya awatali bulamu bwennyini? “Naye Obulamu bwaffe obwa nnamaddala yakka wano, n’asitula okufa kwaffe, n’akutta olw’obungi bw’obulamu bwe yennyini: era n’abwatuka, ng’atukoowoola n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka tuve wano tudde gy’ali mu kifo ekyo eky’ekyama, mwe yava okujja gye tuli, okusooka mu lubuto lw’Omuwala Embeerera, mwe yeegattira n’ekitonde eky’obuntu, omubiri gwaffe ogufa, guleme kufanga emirembe gyonna, era okuva awo, ng’awasa omugole bw’ava mu nju ye, n’ajjula essanyu ng’omuzira agenda okudduka olugendo lwe. Kubanga teyalwa, wabula yadduka, ng’akoowoola n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka mu bigambo, mu bikolwa, mu kufa, mu bulamu, mu kukka, ne mu kulinnya; ng’atukaabirira n’eddoboozi ddene tudde gy’ali. Era n’ava mu maaso gaffe, tulyoke tudde mu mutima gwaffe, tumusange eyo. Kubanga yagenda, era laba, ali wano. Teyayagala kumala naffe kiseera kiwanvu, naye tatulekanga; kubanga yagenda eyo gy’atavangako n’akatono, kubanga ye yatonda ensi. Era mu nsi eno mwe yali, era yajja mu nsi okulokola aboonoonyi, Ye emmeeme yange gw’eyatulira, era Ye agiwonya, kubanga yamwonoona. Mmwe abaana b’abantu, mulituusa wa okuba n’emitima eminafu bwe mutyo? Ne kaakano, Obulamu nga bumaze okukka gye muli, temugenda kulinnya mube balamu? Naye mulinnya wa, nga muli waggulu dda, era nga mwolekeza emimwa gyammwe okulwanyisa eggulu? Mukke, mulyoke mulinnye, era mulinnye eri Katonda. Kubanga mwagwa, olw’okulinnya nga mumwolekera okumulwanyisa.” Bagambe bino, balyoke bakaabire mu kiwonvu ky’amaziga, era bw’otyo obatwale naawe waggulu eri Katonda; kubanga oyogera nabo bw’otyo ng’oyita mu Mwoyo gwe, bw’oba ng’oyogera, ng’oyaka omuliro gw’okwagala. Essuula XIII Ebyo mu kiseera ekyo saabimanya, era nayagalanga obulungi buno obwa wansi, era nali nnabbira okutuuka wansi ddala, ne ŋŋamba mikwano gyange nti, “Waliwo kye twagala okuggyako eky’obulungi? Kale eky’obulungi kye kiki? era obulungi bwe buli ki? Kiki ekitusikiriza ne kitusembeza ku bintu bye twagala? kubanga singa tebyalimu kisikiriza na bulungi, tebyandisobodde n’akatono kutusika gye biri.” Ne nneetegereza ne ntegeera nti mu mibiri gyennyini mulimu obulungi obuva mu kuba nti gikola ekintu ekimu ekijjuvu, era waliwo n’obulala obuva mu kukwatagana obulungi n’okusaanirana kw’ebintu, ng’ekitundu ky’omubiri bwe kikwatagana n’omubiri gwonna, oba engatto n’ekigere, n’ebirala ebiringa ebyo. Era ekirowoozo kino kyamera mu magezi gange, nga kiva munda ddala mu mutima gwange, ne mpandiika “ku kirungi n’ekisaanidde,” ndowooza, ebitabo bibiri oba bisatu. Ggwe omanyi, Ayi Mukama, kubanga nze byanvaako; kubanga sikyabirina, wabula byambulako, simanyi ngeri. Essuula XIV Naye kiki ekyankubiriza, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, okuwaayo ebitabo bino eri Hierius, omwogezi w’e Rooma, gwe saali mmanyi mu maaso, naye nga mmwagala olw’ettutumu ly’obuyivu bwe obwali bumwatiikiriza ennyo, n’ebigambo bye ebimu bye nnali mpulidde ne bimpoomera? Naye yansanyusa n’okusingawo, kubanga yasanyusa abalala, abaamutenderezanga ennyo, nga beewuunya nti Omusuuli, eyasooka okuyigirizibwa obwogezi obw’Oluyonaani, oluvannyuma yafuulibwa omwogezi w’Olulattini ow’ekitalo, era omuyivu ddala mu bintu ebikwata ku bufirosoofo. Omuntu atenderezebwa, era newaakubadde nga talabiddwangako, n’ayagalibwa: okwagala kuno kuyingira mu mutima gw’awulira nga kuva mu kamwa k’oyo atendereza? Si bwe kiri. Wabula oyo ayagala y’akoleeza munne. Kubanga oyo atenderezebwa ayagalibwa olw’ensonga eno: oyo amutendereza bw’akkirizibwa okuba nti amugulumiza n’omutima ogutaliimu bukuusa; kwe kugamba, oyo amwagala bw’amutendereza. Kubanga bwe ntyo bwe nnayagalanga abantu mu biro ebyo, nga nsinziira ku ndowooza y’abantu, so si ku yiyo, Ayi Katonda wange, Ggwe mu ggwe omuntu yenna mw’atalimbibwa. Naye era lwaki si olw’ebirungi ng’eby’omuvuzi w’amagaali omututumufu, oba omulwanyi w’ensolo mu kisaawe ky’emizannyo, amanyiddwa wonna olw’ettutumu ery’abantu ba bulijjo, wabula mu ngeri ndala nnyo, era n’obunyiikivu, era nga bwe nnandyagadde nze kennyini okutenderezebwa? Kubanga saayagala kutenderezebwa oba kwagalibwa nga bannakatemba bwe bali (newaakubadde nga nze kennyini nnabatenderezanga era nnabaagalanga), wabula nnandisinze okwagala obutamanyibwa okusinga okumanyibwa bwe ntyo; era n’okukyayibwa okusinga okwagalibwa bwe ntyo. Kale okusikirizibwa okw’engeri z’okwagala ezenjawulo bwe zityo, era ezitafaanagana, kuterekebwa wa mu mmeeme emu? Lwaki, ng’ate ffenna tuli bantu kyenkanyi, njagala mu muntu omulala ekyo kye nneesamba ne nkyeggyako, so nga sandikyesambye singa saali nkikyawa? Kubanga tekituukirira nti, nga embalaasi ennungi bw’eyagalibwa omuntu atandyagadde kufuuka mbalaasi eyo newaakubadde nga yandisobodde, n’olwekyo bwe kityo bwe kiyinza okwogerwa ku munnakatemba, alina obutonde bwe bumu naffe. Kale njagala mu muntu ekyo kye nkyawa okuba, nze ate omuntu? Omuntu yennyini buziba bunene, ng’enviiri ze ddala Ggwe ozibala, Ayi Mukama, era tezigwa wansi awatali Ggwe. Era naye enviiri z’oku mutwe gwe nnyangu okubala okusinga enneewulira ze, n’okukuba kw’omutima gwe. Naye omwogezi oyo yali w’engeri gye nnayagalanga, nga nneegomba nze kennyini okuba bwe ntyo; ne nkyama olw’amalala ageezimbulukusa, ne nnyuguumizibwa nga ntwalibwa buli muyaga, naye era nga Ggwe ondung’amya, newaakubadde mu kyama ennyo. Era mmanyi ntya, era nkwatulira ntya n’obuvumu, nti nnamwagala nnyo olw’okwagala kw’abaamutenderezanga okusinga olw’ebyo byennyini bye yatenderezebwanga? Kubanga singa teyatenderezebwa, era abantu abo bennyini ne bamuvumirira, ne boogera ku ye ebintu bye bimu ddala nga bamuvumirira era nga bamunyooma, sandikoleezeddwa wadde okukubirizibwa bwe ntyo okumwagala. Era naye ebintu tebyandibadde birala, wadde ye kennyini okuba omulala; wabula enneewulira z’abo abaabyogera zokka. Laba emmeeme ennafu gy’egalamidde, etannaba kuwaniriddwa bunywevu bwa mazima! Nga empewo z’ennimi bwe zifuuwa okuva mu bifuba by’abeemanyi, bw’etyo bw’etwalibwa eruuyi n’eruuyi, ng’esindikibwa mu maaso n’emabega, era omusana ne gugibikkibwako ebire, n’amazima ne gatalabika. Era laba, gali mu maaso gaffe. Era kyali kikulu nnyo gye ndi, okwogera kwange n’emirimu gyange okumanyibwa omuntu oyo: bwe yandibisiimye, nandyeyongedde okukoleezebwa; naye bwe yandibinenye, omutima gwange omwereere, ogutaliimu bunywevu bwo, gwandifumitiddwa. Era naye “ekirungi n’ekisaanidde,” kye nnamuwandiikirako, nnakirowoozangako n’essanyu, ne nkyetegereza, ne nkyewuunya, newaakubadde nga tewali yanneegattako mu ekyo. Essuula XV Naye nali sinnalaba ensonga enkulu eno kw’esinziira mu magezi go, Ayi Ggwe Ayinzabyonna, Ggwe wekka akola ebyewuunyisa; era ebirowoozo byange ne bitambulatambula mu bifaananyi by’ebintu eby’omubiri; ne nnyinnyonnyola era ne njawula “ekirungi,” nga kye kyo ekiri bwe kityo ku bwakyo, n’“ekisaanidde,” obulungi bwakyo nga buli mu kukwatagana n’ekintu ekirala: era kino ne nkinyweza n’ebyokulabirako eby’ebintu eby’omubiri. Ne nkyukira obutonde bw’amagezi, naye endowooza ey’obulimba gye nnali nnina ku bintu eby’omwoyo teyandeka kulaba mazima. Era naye amaanyi g’amazima gaamyansa gokka mu maaso gange, ne nzza emmeeme yange eyali ewejjawejja okuva ku kintu ekitali kya mubiri, ne ngitunuza ku nnyiriri, ne ku langi, ne ku bunene obw’ebintu ebizito. Era bwe nnalemwa okulaba ebyo mu magezi, ne ndowooza nti siyinza kulaba magezi gange. Era nga mu mpisa ennungi nnayagalanga emirembe, ate mu mpisa embi ne nkyawa obukuubagano; mu ky’olubereberye ne ndabamu obumu, naye mu kirala, ekika ky’okwawukana. Era mu bumu obwo ne ndowooza nti mwe muli emmeeme etegeera, n’obutonde bw’amazima n’obw’ekirungi ekisingayo; naye mu kwawukana kuno, mu bunaku bwange, ne ndowooza nti mulimu ekintu ekitamanyiddwa eky’obulamu obutategeera, n’obutonde bw’obubi obusingayo, obutandibadde kintu kyokka, wabula n’obulamu obwa nnamaddala, kyokka nga tebuva gy’Oli, Ayi Katonda wange, Ggwe ebintu byonna mwe biva. Era naye ekyo eky’olubereberye ne nkiyita Monadi, ng’emmeeme etaliiko kikula kya musajja wadde mukazi; naye ekyo eky’okubiri ne nkiyita Duadi;—obusungu, mu bikolwa eby’obukambwe, ne mu bugwenyufu, okwegomba okubi; nga simanyi kye njogerako. Kubanga nnali sinnamanya wadde okuyiga nti obubi si kintu ekiriwo ku bwakyo, era nti emmeeme yaffe si kye kirungi ekyo ekisingayo era ekitakyukakyuka. Kubanga ng’ebikolwa eby’obukambwe bwe bijja, singa enneewulira eyo ey’emmeeme eyonooneka, mw’eva ebikolwa eby’amaanyi, nga byesiikuula mu kwekulumbaza n’obutafugika; n’okwegomba okubi, enneewulira eyo ey’emmeeme, essanyu ly’omubiri mwe linywerwa, bw’eba nga tefugibwa, bwe kityo n’ensobi n’endowooza ez’obulimba bwe zoonoona empisa, singa emmeeme etegeera yennyini eyonooneka; nga bwe kyali mu nze mu kiseera ekyo, nze eyali simanyi nti eteekwa okwakirwa omusana omulala, eryoke egabane ku mazima, okuva bwe kiri nti yo yennyini si gwe butonde bw’amazima. Kubanga Ggwe olikoleeza ettaala yange, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, Ggwe olimulisa ekizikiza kyange: era ku kujjula kwo ffenna kwe twagabana, kubanga Ggwe omusana ogw’amazima, ogujja mu nsi okwakira buli muntu; kubanga mu Ggwe temuli kukyukakyuka, newaakubadde ekisiikirize eky’okwefuula ekirala. Naye nnafubanga okujja gy’Oli, ne nsindikibwa okuva gy’Oli, nnege ku kufa: kubanga Ggwe olwana n’ab’amalala. Naye kiki ekisinga amalala, okusinga nze, mu bulalu obw’ekyewuunyo, okwerumiriza nti mu butonde ndi ekyo Ggwe ky’oli? Kubanga newaakubadde nga nnali nkyukakyuka (ekyo nga kyeyoleka gye ndi, kubanga okwegomba kwange kwennyini okufuuka ow’amagezi kwali kwagala kuva mu bubi okudda mu kisingako obulungi), naye ne nsalawo okusinga okulowooza nti Ggwe okyukakyuka, okusinga nze obutaba ekyo Ggwe ky’oli. Noolwekyo ne nsindikibwa Ggwe, era Ggwe n’olwanyisa obukakanyavu bwange obw’ensingo obutaliimu, ne ndowooza ebifaananyi by’ebintu eby’omubiri, era nze omubiri, ne nnenya omubiri; era nga ndi empewo egenda n’etedda, saakomawo gy’Oli, wabula ne nneeyongera bweyongezi okugenda eri ebintu ebitaliiwo n’akatono, wadde mu Ggwe, wadde mu nze, wadde mu mubiri. So tebyantonderwa mazima go, wabula byayiiyizibwa obutaliimu bwange okuva mu bintu eby’omubiri. Era nnabuuzanga abaana bo abato abeesigwa, bannange ab’ekibuga kimu (abo be nnali nnawukanyiziddwako ng’omuwaŋŋanguse, nga simanyi), nnabuuzanga, nga njogera ebitaliimu era mu busirusiru, nga mbabuuza nti, “Kale lwaki emmeeme Katonda gye yatonda ekyama?” Naye saayagalanga kubuuzibwa nti, “Kale lwaki Katonda akyama?” Era nnalumirizanga nti obutonde bwo obutakyukakyuka bwakyamanga nga bukakiddwa, okusinga okwatula nti obutonde bwange obukyukakyuka bwali bukyamye ku bwagazi bwabwo, era kaakano, nga bubonerezebwa, bwali bugalamidde mu nsobi. Mu kiseera ekyo nnali nnaatera okuweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu mukaaga oba amakumi abiri mu musanvu bwe nnawandiika ebitabo ebyo; nga nfumiitiriza munda yange ebirowoozo ebiyiiye eby’ebintu eby’omubiri, nga bivuuvuumira mu matu g’omutima gwange, ge nnatunuzanga, Ayi amazima amawoomu, eri oluyimba lwo olw’omunda, nga nfumiitiriza ku “kirungi n’ekisaanidde,” era nga nneegomba okuyimirira nkuwulirize, n’okusanyukira ennyo eddoboozi lya Nannyini Mugole, naye ne sisobola; kubanga amaloboozi g’ensobi zange ganfulumyanga ebweru mu bwangu, era olw’obuzito bw’amalala gange ne nnabbira mu kinnya ekisinga obuwanvu. Kubanga tewandeetera kuwulira ssanyu na kwesiima, so n’amagumba agaali tegannaba kutoowazibwa tegaasanyuka. Essuula XVI Era kyangasa ki, nti nga nnaatera okuweza emyaka amakumi abiri, ekitabo kya Aristotle, kye bayita Ebika Ekkumi, bwe kyagwa mu mikono gyange (erinnya lyakyo lyokka lye nnawuniikiriranga, ng’ekintu ekinene era ekya Katonda, buli lwe nnawuliranga omusomesa wange ow’obwogezi e Carthage, n’abalala abaali batwalibwa ng’abayivu, nga balyatula ng’amatama gaabwe gazimbye olw’amalala), nnakisoma ne nkitegeera nga sirina anyamba? Era bwe nnakiteesaako n’abalala, abaagamba nti baakitegeera kizibu nnyo nga bayambibwa abasomesa abakugu ennyo, abataakinnyonnyola mu bigambo byokka, wabula nga bakuba n’ebifaananyi bingi mu musenyu, tebaasobola kumbuulira kisingawo ku kye nnali nnayize nga nkisoma nzekka. Era ekitabo kyandabikira nga kyogera mu ngeri etegeerekeka ennyo ku bintu ebiriwo ku bwabyo, nga “omuntu,” ne ku ngeri zaabyo, ng’ekifaananyi ky’omuntu, kya ngeri ki; n’obuwanvu bwe, aweza fuuti mmeka; n’oluganda lwe, muganda w’ani; oba gy’ali; oba lwe yazaalibwa; oba ng’ayimiridde oba atudde; oba ng’ayambadde engatto oba ng’alina eby’okulwanyisa; oba ng’alina ky’akola oba ky’akolebwa; n’ebintu byonna ebitabalika ebiyinza okuteekebwa wansi w’Ebika bino omwenda, bye mmaze okuwaako ebyokulabirako, oba wansi w’Ekika ekyo ekikulu eky’Ekintu Ekiriwo ku bwakyo. Ebyo byonna byangasa ki, ng’ate byanziyiza? kubanga, nga ndowooza nti buli kiriwo kyali kizingirwa mu Bika ebyo ekkumi, nnagezaako okutegeera mu ngeri eyo, Ayi Katonda wange, n’Obumu bwo obw’ekitalo era obutakyukakyuka, ng’olinga naawe eyali afugibwa obukulu bwo oba obulungi bwo; ne kiba nti (nga bwe kiri mu mibiri) byandibadde mu Ggwe, nga Ggwe gwe bisinziirako: so nga Ggwe Wennyini gwe bukulu bwo n’obulungi bwo; naye omubiri si mukulu oba mulungi olw’okuba nti mubiri, kubanga newaakubadde nga gwandibadde mutono mu bukulu oba mu bulungi, gwandibadde mubiri bubeezi. Naye bwali bulimba bwe nnalowooza ku Ggwe, so si mazima, ebirowoozo ebiyiiye eby’obunaku bwange, so si bya nnamaddala eby’obulamu bwo obw’omukisa. Kubanga wali olagidde, era ne kituukirira mu nze, nti ensi enkumerezanga amaggwa n’amatovu, era nti mu ntuuyo z’ekyenyi kyange mwe nnaggyanga emmere yange. Era kyangasa ki, nti ebitabo byonna bye nnasobola okufuna eby’ebyo ebiyitibwa amagezi ag’abantu ab’eddembe, nze omuddu omubi ow’okwegomba okubi, nnabisoma nzekka, ne mbitegeera? Era nnabisanyukiranga, naye nga simanyi gye byava byonna ebyalimu eby’amazima oba ebikakafu. Kubanga nnali nkubye omusana amabega, nga ntunudde eri ebintu ebyakirwa; n’olwekyo amaaso gange, ge nnalabisa ebintu ebyakirwa, go gennyini gaali tegaakirwa. Buli kyawandiikibwanga, oba ku bwogezi, oba ku nsonga z’okulowooza okutuufu, ku jjometule, ku nnyimba, ne ku kubala, nnakitegeeranga nzekka awatali buzibu bungi oba omusomesa yenna, Ggwe omanyi, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange; kubanga okwanguwa okutegeera n’obwogi mu kwawula birabo byo: kyokka saakuweerayo ssaddaaka okuva mu ebyo. Kale tebyangasa, wabula byantwala mu kuzikirira, kubanga nnafuba okufuna omugabo omulungi bwe gutyo ogw’ebintu byange ne ngukuuma nze kennyini; era amaanyi gange saagakuumira Ggwe, wabula ne nkuviira ne ŋŋenda mu nsi ey’ewala, okugamalira mu bwenzi. Kubanga obusobozi obulungi bwangasa ki, nga sibukozesa bulungi? Kubanga saategeera nti amagezi ago gafunibwa n’obuzibu bungi, ne bannyiikivu n’abalina ebitone, okutuusa lwe nnagezaako okugannyonnyola abantu ng’abo; ng’oyo eyasingangamu ye oyo eyangobereranga nga talwawo nnyo. Naye kino kyangasa ki, nga ndowooza nti Ggwe, Ayi Mukama Katonda, Amazima, oli mubiri munene nnyo era ogwakaayakana, nange nga ndi kitundu kitono ku mubiri ogwo? Obukyamu obusukkiridde! Naye bwe ntyo bwe nnali. So sikwatibwa nsonyi, Ayi Katonda wange, okukwatulira okusaasira kwo gye ndi, n’okukukoowoola, nze ataakwatibwa nsonyi mu kiseera ekyo okulangirira mu bantu ebivume byange, n’okukuboggolera. Kale amagezi gange amangu mu by’okuyiga ebyo, n’ebitabo byonna ebyo ebisinga obuzibu, bye nnasumulula nzekka awatali buyambi bwa kuyigiriza kwa bantu, byangasa ki; ng’ate nnakyama bubi bwe ntyo, era n’obuswavu obw’obuvvoozi bwe butyo, mu kuyigiriza okw’okutya Katonda? Oba amagezi agasingako obulwa ennyo gaali kiziyiza ki eri abaana bo abato, okuva bwe kiri nti tebaakuvaako wala, balyoke mu kisu ky’Ekkanisa yo bamere ebyoya mu mirembe, era bakuze ebiwaawaatiro by’okwagala, nga balya emmere y’okukkiriza okulamu. Ayi Mukama Katonda waffe, tusuubirenga nga tuli mu kisiikirize ky’ebiwaawaatiro byo; tukuume, era otusitule. Ggwe olitusitula nga tukyali bato, era ne bwe tulimeramu envi olitusitulanga; kubanga obunywevu bwaffe, bwe buba Ggwe, olwo bwe bunywevu; naye bwe buba bwaffe ffekka, bunafu. Ekirungi kyaffe kibeera bulijjo gy’Oli; era bwe tukyuka ne tukivaako, tukyama. Ayi Mukama, kaakano tukomewo, tuleme kuvuunikibwa, kubanga gy’Oli ekirungi kyaffe kibeera nga tekiriiko kuvunda kwonna, era ekirungi ekyo ye Ggwe; so tetwetaaga kutya nti tewali we tunadda, kubanga twakiwanukako: kubanga olw’obutabaawo bwaffe, ennyumba yaffe teyagwa—obutaggwaawo bwo.

fields.title: Ekitabo V
fields.body_html:
Essuula I

Kkiriza ssaddaaka ey’okwatula kwange evudde mu buweereza bw’olulimi lwange, lwe Wabumba era lwe Wakubiriza okwatula erinnya lyo. Wonya amagumba gange gonna, era gagambe nti, Ani afaanana nga ggwe, Ayi Mukama? Kubanga oyo akwatulira takuyigiriza ebibeera munda mu ye; kubanga omutima oguggaddwa tegusiba liiso lyo, era n’obukakanyavu bw’omutima gw’omuntu tebusobola kuzza mukono gwo mabega: kubanga obusaanuusa nga bw’oyagala, mu kusaasira oba mu kuwoolera eggwanga, era tewali kiyinza kwekweka bbugumu lyo. Naye emmeeme yange ekutendereze, ekwagale; era ekwatulire okusaasira kwo Ggwe kennyini, ekutendereze. Ebitonde byo byonna tebirekeraawo era tebisirika kukutendereza; omwoyo gw’omuntu tegusirika, nga gukozesa eddoboozi eryolekedde Ggwe, era n’ebitonde ebiramu n’ebitali biramu tebisirika, nga biyita mu ddoboozi ly’abo ababifumiitirizaako: emmeeme zaffe zisobole okusituka okuva mu bukoowu bwazo zijje gy’Oli, nga zeesigama ku bintu bye Watonda, era nga ziyitamu okutuuka gy’Oli Ggwe, eyabikola mu ngeri ey’ekitalo; era eyo gye kuli okuwummulibwa n’amaanyi ag’amazima.

Essuula II

Abatateredde, abatatya Katonda, bagende badduke bave gy’Oli; naye Ggwe obalaba, era oyawula ekizikiza. Era laba, ensi yonna wamu nabo nnungi, newakubadde nga bo bacaafu. Era bakukoze ki ekibi? Oba bawemudde batya obufuzi bwo, obutuukirivu era obutuukiridde okuva mu ggulu okutuuka ku nsi eno eya wansi ddala? Kubanga baddukira wa, bwe badduka okuva mu maaso go? Oba wa gy’otobasanga? Naye baadduka, baleme kukulaba ng’Obalaba, era nga bazibye amaaso, bakwesittaleko (kubanga toleka kintu na kimu ku bye Watonda); abatali batuukirivu, nkyogera, bakwesittaleko, balumizibwe mu bwenkanya; nga beggya mu bukkakkamu bwo, nga beesittala ku bugolokofu bwo, era nga bagwa ku bukakanyavu bwabwe bo bennyini. Mu mazima tebamanyi nti oli buli wantu, Ggwe atazingizibwa kifo kyonna! Era Ggwe wekka oli kumpi, ne eri abo abeesenza ewala naawe. Kale bakyuke, bakunoonye; kubanga nga bo bwe baleka Omutonzi waabwe, Ggwe toleka bitonde byo bw’otyo. Bakyuke bakunoonye; era laba, oli eyo mu mutima gwabwe, mu mutima gw’abo abakwatulira, abeesuula ku Ggwe, abakaabira mu kifuba kyo, oluvannyuma lw’amakubo gaabwe gonna amakakanyavu. Olwo Ggwe n’obasangula amaziga gaabwe mpola, ne beeyongera okukaaba, ne basanyukira mu kukaaba; kubanga Ggwe, Mukama,—si muntu wa mubiri na musaayi, wabula—Ggwe, Mukama, eyabakola, obaddamu okubakola era obabudaabuda. Naye nze nnali wa, bwe nnali nkunoonya? Ggwe wali mu maaso gange, naye nze nnali nvudde gy’Oli; era sasobola na kwesanga nzekka, kale nandikusanze ntya Ggwe!

Essuula III

Njagala okwanjulira Katonda wange omwaka ogwo ogw’amakumi abiri mu omwenda ogw’obukulu bwange. Mu kiseera ekyo yali azze e Carthage Omulabirizi omu ow’Abamanikaya, erinnya lye Faustus, omutego omunene ogwa Setaani, era bangi baagwa mu mutego gwe olw’ekisikiriza ky’ebigambo bye ebiweweevu: bye nnatenderezanga, naye nga nsobola okubyawula ku mazima g’ebintu bye nnali njagala ennyo okuyiga: era saafaayo nnyo ku buweereza bw’obwogezi ng’okumanya Faustus ono, eyatenderezebwa ennyo mu bo, kwe yanteekera mu maaso okulya. Ettutumu lyali limwogeddeko edda nti amanyi nnyo mu buli kuyiga okw’omuwendo, era nti mukugu nnyo mu masomo ag’obuyigirize. Era olw’okuba nnali nsomye era nga nzijukira bulungi bingi ku bafirosoofo, nnageraageranya ebimu ku byabwe n’engero z’Abamanikaya empanvu ezo, ne nsanga nga ebyabwe bye bisinga okuba eby’okukkirizibwa; newakubadde nga amaanyi gaabwe gaakoma ku kusalira ensi eno eya wansi omusango kyokka, naye Mukama waayo tebaasobola kumuzuula n’akatono. Kubanga oli mukulu, Ayi Mukama, era ofaayo eri abeetoowaza, naye ab’amalala obalaba ng’oli wala. Era tosemberera wabula abo abalina emitima egimenyese, era ab’amalala tebakuzuula, nedda, newakubadde nga mu bukugu bwabwe obw’okwekeneenya basobola okubala emmunyeenye n’omusenyu, n’okupima eggulu ery’emmunyeenye, n’okugoberera amakubo g’emmunyeenye ezitambula.

Kubanga n’okutegeera kwabwe n’amagezi gaabwe, bye Wabawa, banoonyereza ku bintu bino; era bingi bye bazudde; era baalanga, emyaka mingi emabega, okuziba kw’ebitangaala ebyo, enjuba n’omwezi,—ku lunaku ki ne ku ssaawa ki, n’ebitundu bimeka,—era okubala kwabwe tekwasobya; era ne kibaawo nga bwe baalanga; era ne bawandiika amateeka ge baazuula, era gasomebwa n’aleero, era okuva mu go abalala balanga mu mwaka ki ne mu mwezi ki ogw’omwaka, ne ku lunaku ki olw’omwezi, ne ku ssaawa ki ey’olunaku, n’ekitundu ki eky’ekitangaala kyagwo, omwezi oba enjuba bwe biriziba, era kiriba bwe kityo, nga bwe kiraguddwa. Ku bintu bino abantu abatamanyi magezi gano beewuunya era basamaalirira, n’abo abagamanyi bajaguza era beegulumiza; era olw’amalala agatatya Katonda, nga bava gy’Oli era nga bajula ekitangaala kyo, balaba nga bukyali okuziba kw’ekitangaala ky’enjuba okujja okubaawo, naye tebalaba kuziba kwabwe, okuliwo kaakano. Kubanga tebanoonya mu kutya Katonda gye baggya amagezi ge banoonyerezaamu bino. Era bwe bazuula nti Ggwe wabakola, tebeewaayo gy’Oli, okukuuma kye Wakola, era tebakuwaayo ssaddaaka ebyo bye beekoze bo bennyini; era tebatta birowoozo byabwe ebyebuuka waggulu, ng’ennyonyi ez’omu bbanga, newakubadde okwagala kwabwe okumanya okubbira wansi (kwe batambuliramu, ng’ebyennyanja eby’omu nnyanja, mu makubo agatamanyiddwa ag’obuziba), newakubadde obwagazi bwabwe obw’okwejalabya, ng’ensolo ez’omu nsiko, Ggwe, Mukama, omuliro ogwokya, osobole okwokya ebyeraliikiriza byabwe ebyo ebifu, n’okubatonda obuggya babeere abatafa.

Naye tebaamanya kkubo, Kigambo kyo, oyo gwe Wakozesa okukola ebintu bino bye babala, nabo bennyini ababala, n’okuwulira kwe bategeeramu bye babala, n’okutegeera kwe babaliramu; oba nti amagezi go tegaliiko muwendo. Naye Omwana omu yekka eyazaalibwa ye yennyini eyafuuka amagezi gye tuli, n’obutuukirivu, n’okutukuzibwa, era n’abalirwa wamu naffe, era n’asasula omusolo eri Kayisaali. Tebaamanya kkubo lino mwe bandiyise okukka okuva mu bo bennyini okutuuka gy’Ali, era okuyita mu Ye okulinnya gy’Ali. Tebaamanya kkubo lino, ne beerowooza nti bagulumiziddwa mu mmunyeenye era nti bamasamasa; era laba, ne bagwa ku ttaka, era omutima gwabwe omusirusiru ne gujjuzibwa ekizikiza. Boogera bingi mu mazima ku bitonde; naye Amazima, Omuzimbi w’ebitonde, tebamunoonya mu kutya Katonda, n’olwekyo tebamulaba; oba bwe bamulaba, nga bamanyi nti ye Katonda, tebaamugulumiza nga Katonda wadde okumwebazanga, naye ne bagobereranga ebitaliimu mu birowoozo byabwe, ne beeyita ab’amagezi, nga beetwalira ebibyo; era olw’ekyo, mu buzibe obusingira ddala okukyama, bafuba okukuteekako ebyabwe, nga bakulimbirira Ggwe ali Amazima, era ne bawanyisa ekitiibwa kya Katonda ataggwaawo okukifaananyiriza ekifaananyi ky’omuntu aggwaawo, n’eky’ebinyonyi, n’eky’ebirina amagulu ana n’eky’ebyewalula, nga bafuula amazima go okuba obulimba, era ne basinza era ne baweereza ebitonde, mu kifo ky’okusinza eyabitonda.

Naye amazima mangi agakwata ku bitonde nnagafuna okuva ku bantu bano, era ne ndaba ensonga yaago okuva mu kubala, mu kuddiriŋŋana kw’ebiseera, ne mu bujulizi obulabika obw’emmunyeenye; ne mbigeraageranya n’ebigambo bya Manichaeus, bye yawandiika mu bulalu bwe ennyo ku nsonga zino; naye saasangamu kunnyonnyola kwonna ku biseera enjuba w’ekoma ku njuyi zombi, oba ennaku ekiro n’emisana lwe byenkanankana, oba okuziba kw’ebitangaala ebisinga obunene, newakubadde ekintu kyonna eky’engeri eyo kye nnali nsomye mu bitabo by’amagezi ag’ensi. Naye nnalagirwa okukkiriza; so nga tekyakwatagana na bye nnali nkakasizza mu kubala n’amaaso gange, wabula kyali kikontana nabyo ddala.

Essuula IV

Kale, Ayi Mukama Katonda ow’amazima, buli amanyi ebintu bino, kyava akusanyusa? Mazima omuntu oyo wa nnaku amanyi bino byonna, naye nga takumanyi Ggwe: naye wa mukisa oyo akumanyi Ggwe, newakubadde nga tamanyi bino. Era oyo amanyi Ggwe n’ebyo byombi, tafuuka wa mukisa okusingawo ku lw’ebyo, wabula ku lulwo Ggwe wekka, bw’aba, ng’akumanyi, akugulumiza nga Katonda, n’akwebaza, era n’atagoberera bitaliimu mu birowoozo bye. Kubanga nga bwe kiri nti omuntu amanyi okubeera n’omuti, n’akwebaza olw’okugukozesa, newakubadde nga tamanyi bwe guli obuwanvu mu mikono emeka, oba bwe gubunye obugazi, ali bulungi okusinga oyo asobola okugupima, n’okubala amatabi gaagwo gonna, naye nga si gugwe, era nga tamanyi wadde okwagala Omutonzi waagwo: bw’atyo omukkiriza, nnannyini bugagga bw’ensi eno yonna, era atalina kintu naye ate ng’alina byonna, olw’okwegatta naawe, Ggwe gwe biweereza byonna, newakubadde nga tamanyi wadde enkulungo z’emmunyeenye ez’Eddubu Ennene, busirusiru okubuusabuusa nti ali mu mbeera esinga obulungi okusinga oyo asobola okupima eggulu, n’okubala emmunyeenye, n’okupima obuzito bw’ebintu ebisookerwako, naye n’akulagajjalira Ggwe, eyakola ebintu byonna mu muwendo, mu buzito, ne mu kigera.

Essuula V

Naye ani eyalagira Manichaeus okuwandiika ne ku bintu bino, nga obukugu mu byo si kitundu kya kutya Katonda? Kubanga wagamba omuntu nti, Laba, okutya Katonda n’amagezi; by’ayinza obutabimanya, newakubadde nga yandibadde amanyi bulungi ddala ebintu bino; naye ebintu bino, olw’okuba yayaŋŋanga n’obuswavu bungi okubiyigiriza nga tabimanyi, kyeyoleka bulungi nti teyalina kumanya kwonna ku kutya Katonda. Kubanga butaliimu okwenyumiriza mu bintu bino eby’ensi ne bwe biba nga bimanyiddwa; naye okwatula gy’Oli kwe kutya Katonda. Kyeyava, omubuze ono, ayogera nnyo ku bintu bino, abo abaabiyiga mu mazima bwe bamusinga, kiryoke kyeyoleke amagezi ge yalina mu bintu ebirala ebisingako obuzibu okutegeera. Kubanga teyayagala bantu kumulowoozaako kitono, wabula yagezaako okumatiza abantu nti, “Omwoyo Omutukuvu, Omubeezi era Omugaggawaza w’abeesigwa bo, yali mu ye yennyini ng’alina obuyinza bwonna.” Kale bwe yazuulibwa nti yayigiriza eby’obulimba ku ggulu n’emmunyeenye, ne ku ntambula y’enjuba n’omwezi (newakubadde nga ebintu bino tebikwata ku njigiriza y’eddiini), okwekulumbaza kwe okuvvoola Katonda kwandyeyolese bulungi ddala, kubanga yayigiriza ebintu by’atamanyi kyokka, wabula ebyali eby’obulimba, n’obutaliimu bw’amalala obw’obulalu bungi bwe butyo, n’ayagala okubyetwalira, ng’ali omuntu ow’obwakatonda.

Kubanga bwe mpulira ow’oluganda yenna mu Kristo atamanyi bintu bino, era akyamye ku byo, nsobola okumugumiikiriza ng’akwatirira endowooza ye; era sirowooza nti obutamanya bwonna ku kifo oba ku mbeera y’ebitonde eby’omubiri buyinza kumukolako kabi, kasita aba nga takkiriza kintu kyonna ekitakugwanira Ggwe, Ayi Mukama, Omutonzi wa byonna. Naye kimukolako akabi, bw’alowooza nti kikwatagana n’ekifaananyi ky’enjigiriza y’okutya Katonda, n’akyalemera nnyo ng’akakasa ekyo ky’atamanyi. Era naye obunafu ng’obwo, mu buwere bw’okukkiriza, bugumiikirizibwa maama waffe Okwagala, okutuusa omuzaalibwa omuggya lw’alikula n’atuuka ku muntu omukulu atuukiridde, aleme kutwalibwanga na buli muyaga ogw’okuyigiriza. Naye mu oyo eyeegulumiza okuba omusomesa, ensibuko, omukulembeze, omukulu w’abo bonna be yasobola okumatiza, ne kiba nti buli eyamugoberera yalowooza nti agoberera, si muntu buntu, wabula Omwoyo wo Omutukuvu; ani ataasalewo nti obulalu obunene bwe butyo, bwe bumala okukakasibwa nti bwayigiriza ekintu kyonna eky’obulimba, bwandikyayiddwa ne bugobwa ddala? Naye nnali sinnakakasa bulungi oba enkyukakyuka z’ennaku empanvu n’ennyimpi n’ebiro, n’emisana n’ekiro byennyini, n’okuziba kw’ebitangaala ebisinga obunene, na buli kirala eky’engeri eyo kye nnasoma mu bitabo ebirala, byandinnyonnyoddwa mu ngeri ekwatagana n’ebigambo bye; bwe kityo, singa byali bisobola mu ngeri yonna, ekibuuzo kyandisigaddewo gye ndi oba bwe kiri bwe kityo oba nedda; naye nandisobodde, olw’obutukuvu bwe obwali bumanyiddwa, okwesigamya okukkiriza kwange ku buyinza bwe.

Essuula VI

Era kumpi emyaka egyo gyonna omwenda, mwe nnali omuyigirizwa waabwe n’ebirowoozo ebitateredde, nnalindirira nnyo ddala okujja kwa Faustus ono. Kubanga abalala ab’ekibiina ekyo, be nnasisinkananga, bwe baalemwanga okuddamu ebibuuzo byange ku bintu bino, baansuubizanga okujja kwa Faustus ono, nti bwe nnandyogedde naye, ebizibu bino n’ebisingako obunene, singa nnali nabyo, byandinnyonnyoddwa mangu era mu bujjuvu. Kale bwe yajja, ne mmusanga nga muntu w’ebigambo ebisanyusa, era ayogera bulungi era mu bigambo ebirungi okusingawo, naye nga by’ayogera bye bimu ddala bye baali bakwatanga okwogera. Naye obuyonjo obw’enkomeredde obw’omugabi w’ebyokunywa bwangasa ki, nze eyalumwa ennyonta y’ekyokunywa eky’omuwendo omungi okusingawo? Amatu gange gaali gamaze okukkuta ebiri ng’ebyo, era tegandabikidde nti birungi okusingawo olw’okuba byogeddwa bulungi; wadde nti bya mazima olw’okuba byogerwa n’obwogezi; wadde nti emmeeme ya magezi olw’okuba amaaso malungi, n’olulimi lunyuma. Naye abo abaamunsuubiza tebaali basazi balungi ba bintu; n’olwekyo gye bali yalabika ng’omutegeevu era ow’amagezi, olw’okuba ebigambo bye byali bisanyusa. Kyokka nnawulira nti abantu ab’engeri endala babuusabuusa n’amazima gennyini, era ne bagaana okugakkiriza, singa gayigirizibwa mu bigambo ebiweweevu era ebingi. Naye Ggwe, Ayi Katonda wange, wali omaze okunjigiriza mu makubo ag’ekitalo era ag’ekyama, era kyenva nzikiriza nti Ggwe wanjigiriza, kubanga gano ge mazima, era tewali musomesa wa mazima omulala okuggyako Ggwe, wonna wonna oba okuva wonna wonna gye gayinza okutwakira. Ku bubwo Ggwe kale nnali nnyize kaakano nti tewali kintu kirina kulabika nga kyogeddwa mu mazima olw’okuba kyogeddwa n’obwogezi; wadde nga kya bulimba olw’okuba ebigambo by’emimwa tebiwulikika bulungi; wadde, nate, nga kya mazima olw’okuba kyogeddwa mu ngeri enkakali; wadde nga kya bulimba olw’okuba olulimi lugagga; wabula nti amagezi n’obusirusiru biri ng’emmere ennungi n’emmere embi; n’ebigambo ebiyooyooteddwa n’ebitayooyooteddwa biri ng’ebibya eby’omu lubiri n’eby’omu kyalo; era emmere ey’engeri zombi eyinza okugabulirwa mu bibya eby’engeri zombi.

Okululunkana okwo kale, kwe nnali nnindiridde omuntu oyo ebbanga eddene bwe lityo, kwasanyukiranga ddala engeri gye yeeyisangamu n’okuwulira kwe ng’awakana, n’okulonda kwe n’obwangu bw’ebigambo bye yayambazanga ebirowoozo bye. Ne nsanyuka, era wamu n’abalala bangi n’okusinga bo, ne mmutendereza era ne mmugulumiza. Naye kyanneeraliikiriza nti mu kibiina ky’abaali bamuwuliriza, saakkirizibwa kuyingiza n’okumutegeeza ebibuuzo ebyo ebyanteganya, mu kunyumya naye ng’ab’omukwano. Bwe nnafuna akakisa, ne ntandika, wamu ne mikwano gyange, okumusaba atuwulirize mu biseera bwe kyali tekimuswaza kukubaganya nange birowoozo, ne mmwanjulira ebintu ebyo ebyantawaanya; ne mmusanga okusooka nga tamanyi n’akatono masomo ag’obuyigirize, okuggyako amateeka g’olulimi, era nago mu ngeri ya bulijjo. Naye olw’okuba yali asomye ezimu ku mboozi za Tully, ebitabo bitono ddala ebya Seneca, ebimu ku by’abayiiya ennyimba, n’ebitabo bitono eby’ekibiina kye ebyawandiikibwa mu Lulattini era obulungi, era nga buli lunaku yeegezangamu okwogera, yafuna obwogezi obumu, obwalabika nga bunyuma era busikiriza nnyo, kubanga bwaluŋŋamizibwa amagezi amalungi, era nga bulimu obulungi obw’obutonde. Ekyo si bwe kiri, nga bwe nkijjukira, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, Ggwe omulamuzi w’omwoyo gwange? Mu maaso go mwe muli omutima gwange n’okujjukira kwange, Ggwe eyannuŋŋamyanga mu kiseera ekyo mu kyama ekikusike eky’okulabirira kwo, n’oteeka ensobi zange ezo ez’ensonyi mu maaso gange, ndyoke nzirabe era nzikyaawe.

Essuula VII

Kubanga bwe kyamala okweyoleka nti tamanyi masomo ago gye nnalowooza nti yali asinga, ne ntandika okuggwamu essuubi nti alinzigulira n’okunnyonnyola ebizibu ebyantabula (newakubadde nga yali tabimanyi, yandisobodde okukwata amazima g’okutya Katonda, singa teyali Mumanikaya). Kubanga ebitabo byabwe bijjudde engero empanvu, ku ggulu, n’emmunyeenye, enjuba, n’omwezi, era kaakano nnali sikyamulowooza nti asobola okusalawo mu ngeri ematiza ekyo kye nnali njagala ennyo, oba, bwe ngeraageranya ebintu bino n’okubala kwe nnali nsomye awalala, ebinnyonnyolwa mu bitabo bya Manichaeus byali bisinga, oba waakiri nga byenkanankana. Ekyo bwe nnakireeta kirowoozebweko era kikubaganyizibweko ebirowoozo, ye, mu buwombeefu, n’ayewala omugugu ogwo. Kubanga yali amanyi nti tamanyi bintu ebyo, era teyakwatibwa nsonyi kukyatula. Kubanga teyali omu ku bantu abo aboogezi, bangi ku bo be nnagumiikiriza, abeewaayo okunjigiriza ebintu bino, ne batalina kye boogera. Naye omuntu ono yalina omutima, newakubadde nga tegwali mulongoofu eri Ggwe, naye era nga si gwa bukuusa ddala eri ye yennyini. Kubanga teyali nga tamanyi n’akatono obutamanya bwe, era teyayagala kwesiba mangu mu mpaka mwe yandibadde talina kudda mabega wadde okwejjamu obulungi. Ne ku lw’ekyo nnamwagala okusingawo. Kubanga obwetoowaze bw’omutima omwesimbu bulungi okusinga okumanya ebintu bye nnali njagala; era bw’atyo bwe nnamusanga, mu bibuuzo byonna ebisingako obuzibu era ebyetaaga amagezi amayitirivu.

Obunyiikivu bwange mu biwandiiko bya Manichaeus bwe bwakendeera bwe butyo, era nga n’essuubi lyange eri abasomesa baabwe abalala ligenda liggwaawo nnyo, kubanga mu bintu bingi ebyantabula, ye, eyali omututumufu ennyo mu bo, yali avuddemu bw’atyo; ne ntandika okwegatta naye mu kusoma ebiwandiiko ebyo, bye yali naye ayagala ennyo (era bye nnali nsomesa mu kiseera ekyo abavubuka e Carthage, nga ndi omusomesa w’obwogezi), n’okusoma naye, oba ebyo bye yali ayagala okuwulira, oba ebyo bye nnalaba nga bisaanira amagezi ge. Naye okufuba kwange kwonna kwe nnali nteeseteese okweyongerayo mu kibiina ekyo, bwe nnamala okutegeera omuntu oyo, ne kukoma ddala; si nti nneeyawula ku bo ddala, wabula ng’omuntu atalabye kisinga, nnali mmaliridde okumatira mu kiseera ekyo n’ekyo kye nnalina, mu ngeri yonna gye nnakigwako, okuggyako nga ku bw’omukisa ekintu ekisinga okusaanira kinjakidde. Bwe kityo, Faustus oyo, eyali omutego gw’okufa eri bangi, yali atandise, nga tayagala era nga tamanyi, okusumulula ekyo kye nnali nkwatiddwamu. Kubanga emikono gyo, Ayi Katonda wange, mu kigendererwa eky’ekyama eky’okulabirira kwo, tegyaleka mmeeme yange; era okuva mu musaayi gw’omutima gwa maama wange, mu maziga ge ge yafukanga ekiro n’emisana, ssaddaaka yaweebwayo ku lwange gy’Oli; era wakola nange mu makubo ag’ekitalo. Ggwe wakikola, Ayi Katonda wange: kubanga Mukama aluŋŋamya entambula y’omuntu, era y’alirongoosa ekkubo lye. Oba tunaafuna tutya obulokozi, okuggyako okuva mu mukono gwo, ogukola obuggya kye gwakola?

Essuula VIII

Wakola nange, ndyoke mmatizibwe okugenda e Rooma, nsomeseeyo ebyo bye nnali nsomesa e Carthage. Era engeri gye nnamatizibwamu okukola kino, sijja kulagajjalira kukyatula gy’Oli; kubanga ne mu kino ebifo ebisingayo obuziba eby’amagezi go, n’okusaasira kwo okutuli okumpi ennyo, birina okulowoozebwako n’okwatulwa. Saayagala kugenda Rooma olw’okuba mikwano gyange abaammatiza bansuubiza amagoba amangi n’ebitiibwa ebisingawo (newakubadde nga n’ebintu bino mu kiseera ekyo byalina amaanyi ku birowoozo byange), naye ensonga yange enkulu era kumpi yokka yali nti nnawulira nti abavubuka baayo basoma mu mirembe okusingawo, era bakuumibwa nga basirise wansi w’empisa ez’obukwakkulizo ezisingako okutegekeka; ne kiba nti tebaafubutukanga, nga bwe baagala, mu ssomero ly’omusomesa atali waabwe, wadde okukkirizibwa okuyingira nga tabakkirizza. Naye e Carthage mu bayizi mulimu obujeemu obw’ensonyi ennyo era obutafugika. Bafubutuka mu ssomero n’obuvumu, era n’ebikolwa kumpi eby’obulalu, ne batabangula enteekateeka yonna omuntu gy’aba ataddewo olw’obulungi bw’abayizi be. Bakola ebikolwa ebyonoonefu eby’enjawulo, n’obusirusiru obw’ekitalo, ebyandibonereddwa amateeka, singa empisa teyabikuumanga; empisa eyo ng’eraga nti bo bakyali ba nnaku okusingawo, kubanga kaakano bakola ng’ekikkirizibwa ekyo ekitalikkirizibwa emirembe gyonna mu mateeka go ag’olubeerera; era balowooza nti bakikola nga tebabonerezebwa, so nga babonerezebwa n’obuzibe bwennyini bwe bakikozesa, era babonaabona mu ngeri embi ennyo okusinga bye bakola. Empisa ezo kale, ze saayagala kufuula zange nga ndi muyizi, nnawalirizibwa okuzigumiikiriza mu balala nga ndi musomesa: era bwe ntyo nnasanyuka okugenda gye, abo bonna abaamanya ekifo ekyo, gye bankakasa nti ebintu ng’ebyo tebikolebwa. Naye Ggwe, kiddukiro kyange, ggwe mugabo gwange mu nsi y’abalamu; ndyoke nkyuse ekifo kyange eky’oku nsi olw’obulokozi bw’emmeeme yange, e Carthage wansindiikiriza, ndyoke nzigibweyo; ate e Rooma n’ompa ebisikiriza, ebyandinsembezezza eyo, okuyita mu bantu abaagala obulamu obufa, abamu nga bakola eby’obulalu, abalala nga basuubiza ebitaliimu; era, okutereeza amagenda gange, n’okozesa mu kyama obukyamu bwabwe n’obwange. Kubanga abo abaatabangula emirembe gyange baali bazibye amaaso olw’obulalu obw’ensonyi, n’abo abampita okugenda awalala baawunya eby’ensi. Ate nze, eyakyawa wano obunaku obwa nnamaddala, nnali nnoonya eyo essanyu eritali lya nnamaddala.

Naye ensonga lwaki nnava wano ne ŋŋenda eyo, Ggwe wagimanya, Ayi Katonda, naye n’otogiraga nze, newakubadde maama wange, eyakaabira ennyo olugendo lwange, n’angoberera okutuuka ku nnyanja. Naye ne mmulimba, bwe yali ankutte n’amaanyi, alyoke anziyize oba agende nange, ne nneefuula nga nnina mukwano gwange gwe siyinza kuleka okutuusa ng’afunye empewo ennungi okusaabala. Ne nnimba maama wange, era maama ow’engeri eyo, ne nzira: kubanga kino nakyo wakinsonyiwa mu kusaasira kwo, ng’onkuuma, nga nzijudde obucaafu obw’omuzizo bwe butyo, okuva mu mazzi g’ennyanja, olw’amazzi g’Ekisa kyo; mwe nnandinaazibwa, emigga gy’amaaso ga maama wange ne gikalira, gye yafukiriranga ettaka wansi w’amaaso ge buli lunaku ku lwange. Kyokka bwe yagaana okuddayo awatali nze, nnamumatiza n’obuzibu bungi okusigala ekiro ekyo mu kifo ekiriraanye eryato lyaffe, awaali ekkanisa entono ey’okusabiramu mu kijjukizo ky’omutukuvu Cyprian. Ekiro ekyo ne nzira mu kyama, naye ye teyasigala mabega mu kukaaba n’okusaba. Era kiki, Ayi Mukama, kye yali akusaba n’amaziga amangi bwe gatyo, okuggyako nti tondeka kusaabala? Naye Ggwe, mu buziba bw’ebiteeso byo, ng’owulira ensonga enkulu ey’ekyo kye yali ayagala, n’otafaayo ku kye yali asaba mu kiseera ekyo, olyoke onfuule ekyo kye yasabanga bulijjo. Empewo n’ekunta n’ejjuza amatanga gaffe, n’eggya olubalama mu maaso gaffe; era ye enkeera n’abeerawo, ng’ali mu bulalu olw’ennaku, era n’okwemulugunya n’okusinda n’ajjuza amatu go, Ggwe eyabibuusa amaaso mu kiseera ekyo; nga Ggwe, okuyita mu kwegomba kwange, wali onnyanguya okutuuka ku nkomerero y’okwegomba kwonna, n’ekitundu eky’ensi eky’okwagala kwe gye ndi ne kibonerezebwa n’embooko y’ennaku eyamugerekerwa. Kubanga yayagala okubeera nange, nga bamaama bwe bakola, naye okusinga ennyo bangi; era teyamanya ssanyu lingi nnyo ly’ogenda kumukolera okuva mu kubeera kwange ewala. Teyamanya; kyeyava akaaba era n’akuba ebiwoobe, era mu bulumi buno ne mweyoleka mu ye obusika bwa Kaawa, ng’anoonya mu bulumi ekyo kye yazaala mu bulumi. Kyokka, bwe yamala okunenya obulimba bwange n’obukakanyavu bw’omutima gwange, n’addamu nate okukwegayirira ku lwange, n’agenda mu kifo kye ekya bulijjo, nange ne ŋŋenda e Rooma.

Essuula IX

Era laba, eyo ne nkwatibwa omuggo gw’obulwadde bw’omubiri, ne nzika okugenda mu ggeyeena, nga nsitudde ebibi byonna bye nnali nkoze, ebingi era ebizito, ebyo bye nnakola eri Ggwe, n’eri nze nzennyini, n’eri abalala, okwongereza ku kisiba ekyo eky’ekibi eky’olubereberye, ffenna mwe tufiira mu Adamu. Kubanga tewali na kimu ku ebyo kye wali onsonyiye mu Kristo, era Ye yali tannaggyawo, olw’Omusaalaba gwe, obulabe bwe nnali nneereeseeko naawe olw’ebibi byange. Kale yandibuggyeewo atya ng’akomererwa nga kisiikirize obusiikirize, nga bwe nnali nzikiriza nti bw’ali? Bwe kityo okufa kw’emmeeme yange kwali kwa mazima nga bwe nnalaba okufa kw’omubiri gwe nga kwa bulimba; era nga okufa kw’omubiri gwe bwe kwali okw’amazima, bwe butyo obulamu bw’emmeeme yange, eyali tekukkiriza, bwe bwali obw’obulimba. Ate omusujja bwe gweyongera, nnali nva ku nsi, nga ŋŋenda emirembe gyonna. Kubanga singa nnava wano mu kiseera ekyo, nnandigenze wa, okuggyako mu muliro ne mu kubonaabona, ng’ebikolwa byange ebibi bwe byali bisaanidde mu mazima g’ekiragiro kyo? Era kino ye teyakimanya, naye newankubadde nga yali wala, yansabiranga. Naye Ggwe, abeera buli wantu, wamuwulira gy’ali, era gye nnali n’onsaasira; ndyoke nzijjibwe obulamu bw’omubiri gwange, newankubadde nga nnali nkyali mulalu mu mutima gwange ogwanyoomanga ebitukuvu. Kubanga mu kabi ako konna saayagala kubatiza kwo; era nnali mulungi nga ndi mwana omuto, bwe nnasaba okubatizibwa okuva eri maama wange omutya Katonda, nga bwe nnasooka okunyumya n’okwatula. Naye nnali nkuze okutuuka ku nsonyi zange, era ne nsekerera mu bulalu ebiragiro by’eddagala lyo, Ggwe ataandikkiriza nze, nga bwe nnali, okufa okufa okw’emirundi ebiri. Singa omutima gwa maama wange gwafumitibwa ekiwundu ekyo, tegwandiwonye emirembe gyonna. Kubanga siyinza kwogera kwagala kwe yalina gye ndi, n’obulumi obusingako obungi bwe yalina kaakano ng’alumwa okunzaala mu mwoyo, okusinga bwe yalumwa ng’anzaala mu mubiri.

Kale sirabye bwe yandiwonye, singa okufa kwange okw’engeri eyo kwafumita omunda mu kwagala kwe. Era essaala ze ezo ez’amaanyi ennyo era ezitaggwaawo, ze yawangayo eri Ggwe wekka obutayosa, zandibadde wa? Naye wandinyoomye, Ayi Katonda ow’okusaasira, omutima ogumenyese era ogwetoowaze ogwa nnamwandu oyo omulongoofu era omutegeevu, eyagabanga ennyo eby’ekisa, eyali ajjudde okuweereza n’okuyamba abatukuvu bo, ataayosanga lunaku na lumu okuleeta ekiweebwayo ku kyoto kyo, eyajjanga mu kkanisa yo emirundi ebiri buli lunaku, ku makya ne akawungeezi, awatali kuyosa, si lwa lugambo olutaliimu n’enfumo z’abakadde abakazi; wabula alyoke akuwulire Ggwe mu bigambo byo, naawe omuwulire mu ssaala ze. Wandinyoomye era n’ogaana okuyamba amaziga g’omuntu ow’engeri eyo, ge yakwegayiririzanga, nga takusaba zaabu wadde ffeeza, wadde ekirungi kyonna ekikyuka oba ekiyitawo, wabula obulokozi bw’emmeeme y’omwana we? Ggwe eyamufuula bw’atyo olw’ekirabo kyo? Nedda, Ayi Mukama. Weewaawo, wali kumpi, ng’owulira era ng’okola, mu ntegeka gye wali wasalawo edda nti bw’etyo bwe kirikolebwa. Kikafuuwe Ggwe okumulimba mu kwolesebwa kwo ne mu by’wamuddamu, ebimu bye njogeddeko, ebirala bye sinnaba kwogerako, bye yaterekanga mu mutima gwe omwesigwa, era bulijjo ng’asaba, ng’abikukwanjulira ng’ebiwandiiko by’omukono gwo Ggwe kennyini. Kubanga Ggwe, olw’okuba okwagala kwo kubeerera emirembe gyonna, osiima, eri abo b’osonyiwa amabanja gaabwe gonna, okufuuka naawe abanjibwa olw’ebisuubizo byo.

Essuula X

Awo n’ompoonya obulwadde obwo, n’owonya omwana w’omuzaana wo, mu kiseera ekyo mu mubiri, alyoke abeere omulamu, Ggwe olyoke omuwe obulamu obulungi era obw’olubeerera okusingawo. Ne mu kiseera ekyo, mu Rooma, ne neegatta ku “batukuvu” abo abalimba era abalimbibwa; si ku bayigirizwa baabwe bokka (mu bo mwe mwali oyo, mu nnyumba ye mwe nnalwalira ne mpona), naye era ne ku abo be bayita “Abalonde.” Kubanga nnali nkyalowooza “nti si ffe abakola ekibi, wabula nti obutonde obulala bwe simanyi bwe bwonoona mu ffe”; era kyasanyusanga amalala gange, okuba nga sirina musango; era bwe nnakolanga ekibi kyonna, obutakkiriza nti nkikoze, olyoke owonye emmeeme yange kubanga yakwonoona: naye nnayagalanga okukyewolereza, n’okulumiriza ekintu ekirala kye simanyi, ekyali nange, naye nze kye sali. Naye mu mazima nze nzenna nze nnali, era obutatya Katonda bwange bwanjawulamu nze kennyini: era ekibi ekyo kyali kizibu nnyo okuwonyezebwa, kubanga saayeerowooza nti ndi mwonoonyi; era bwali bubi bwa kivve, nti nnandyagadde Ggwe, Ggwe, Ayi Katonda Ayinza byonna, owangulibwe mu nze ne nzikirira, okusinga nze okuwangulibwa Ggwe ne ndokolebwa. Kale wali tonnateeka mukuumi ku kamwa kange, n’oluggi olukuuma emimwa gyange, omutima gwange guleme kukyamira mu bigambo ebibi, okwekwasa ensonga ku bibi, wamu n’abantu abakola ebitali bya butuukirivu; era kyennava nkyegatta n’Abalonde baabwe.

Naye kaakano bwe nnali nzigiddwamu essuubi ery’okukulaakulana mu njigiriza eyo ey’obulimba, n’ebyo byennyini (bye nnali nsazeewo okumatira nabyo singa sizuula birungi okusingawo) nnali kaakano mbikwata mu bunafu era mu bulagajjavu. Kubanga waaliwo ekirowoozo ekyali kitandise okumbuukamu kitundu nti abafirosoofo abo, be bayita Abakadeemiya, baali ba magezi okusinga abalala, kubanga baali bagamba nti abantu basaana okubuusabuusa buli kintu, era nga bassaawo nti tewali mazima muntu g’ayinza kutegeera: kubanga bwe ntyo, nga sinnategeera wadde amakulu gaabwe, nange nnali nzikirizza ddala nti bwe baalowooza, nga bwe boogerwako bulijjo. Kyokka nnamuziyizanga lwatu era mu lwatu oyo eyali ansuza ewuwe okwekakasa okuyitiridde kwe nnalaba ng’alina mu nfumo ezo, ebitabo bya Manichaeus ze bijjudde. Naye nnali mu mukwano ogw’oku lusegere nabo okusinga abalala abataali mu bukyamu buno. Era saabukuumanga n’obunyiikivu bwange obw’edda; naye okwegatta kwange n’ekibiina ekyo (Rooma ng’ekweka bangi ku bo mu kyama) kwandeetera okulwawo okunoonya ekkubo eddala lyonna: okusingira ddala kubanga nnali nzigiddwamu essuubi ery’okuzuula amazima, ge baali banzigyako, mu Kkanisa yo, Ayi Mukama w’eggulu n’ensi, Omutonzi w’ebintu byonna ebirabika n’ebitalabika: era nnalaba nga si kisaana n’akamu okukkiriza nti olina ekifaananyi ky’omubiri gw’omuntu, era nti oli mukoma mu nsalo ez’omubiri ez’ebitundu byaffe. Era kubanga, bwe nnayagalanga okulowooza ku Katonda wange, saamanya kye nnyinza kulowooza, okuggyako ekikuŋŋaanyo ky’emibiri (kubanga ekitaali bwe kityo tekyandabikira nga kintu n’akatono), kino kye kyali ekisinga obukulu, era kumpi ensonga yokka ey’ensobi yange gye saasobola kwewala.

Kubanga eyo gye nnava okukkiriza nti n’Obubi nabwo kikula kya ngeri eyo, era nti bulina obunene bwabwo obw’obugwagwa era obw’entiisa; oba obukwafu, bwe baayitanga ettaka, oba obugonvu era obutalabika (ng’omubiri gw’empewo), bwe balowooza nti ge magezi amabi, agewalula mu ttaka eryo. Era kubanga okutya Katonda kwe nnalina, nga bwe kwali, kwankaka okukkiriza nti Katonda omulungi teyatonda butonde bubi bwonna, nnalowooza nti waliwo ebikuŋŋaanyo bibiri, nga bikontana, byombi nga tebirina nkomerero, naye ekibi nga kifunda, ate ekirungi nga kigazi. Era okuva ku ntandikwa eyo ey’olumbe, endowooza endala ez’okuvvoola ebitukuvu ne zingoberera. Kubanga amagezi gange bwe gaagezaako okudda ku kukkiriza kw’Ekkanisa Katoliki, ne ngobebwa emabega, kubanga ekyo kye nnalowooza nti kwe kukkiriza kw’Ekkanisa Katoliki, tekwali kwo. Era nnalaba nga nkuwa ekitiibwa okusingawo, singa nkukkiriza Ggwe, Katonda wange (okwagala kwo okutaggwaawo kukwebaza nga kuyita mu kamwa kange), okuba atalina nkomerero, waakiri ku njuyi endala, wadde nga ku ludda olwo olumu ekikuŋŋaanyo ky’obubi we kyakwolekera nnakakibwa okwatula nti olina enkomerero; okusinga okulowooza nti ku njuyi zonna oli mukoma mu kifaananyi ky’omubiri gw’omuntu. Era nnalaba nga kisinga okukkiriza nti tewatonda kibi kyonna (ekyo nze atamanyi kye nnalowooza nti si kintu kyokka, naye kikula kya mubiri, kubanga saasobola kulowooza ku magezi okuggyako ng’omubiri ogutalabika, nga gwanjadde mu bifo ebigere), okusinga okukkiriza nti obutonde bw’ekibi, nga bwe nnabulowooza, buyinza okuva gy’Oli. Weewaawo, n’Omulokozi waffe yennyini, Omwana wo omu yekka, nnakkiriza nti yagololwa (ng’okugamba) ku lw’obulokozi bwaffe okuva mu kikuŋŋaanyo ky’ekikula kyo ekisinga okumasamasa, ne sikkiriza kintu kyonna ku Ye, okuggyako kye nnayinza okulowooza mu butaliimu bwange. Kale Obutonde bwe, nga bwe butyo, nnalowooza nti tebwandisobodde kuzaalibwa Omuwala Embeerera Maliyamu, nga tebutabuddwa na mubiri: era engeri ekyo kye nnali nneefaananyiriza bwe kyandisobodde okutabulwa ne kitayonoonebwa, saakiraba. Kyennava ntya okukkiriza nti yazaalibwa mu mubiri, nneme okuwalirizibwa okukkiriza nti yayonoonebwa omubiri. Kaakano abantu bo ab’omwoyo banaamwenyamwenya gye ndi mu bukkakkamu n’okwagala, bwe banaasoma okwatula kwange kuno. Naye bwe ntyo bwe nnali.

Essuula XI

Ate era, Abamanikaya bye baali bavumirira mu Byawandiikibwa byo, nnalowooza nti tebiyinza kuwolerezebwa; naye oluusi mu mazima nnayagalanga okwogera ku nsonga ezo kinnoomu n’omuntu omukugu ennyo mu bitabo ebyo, ne mmanya kye yandibirowoozezzaako; kubanga ebigambo by’omusajja omu Helpidius, bwe yayogeranga n’okuwakana nga batunuuliganye n’Abamanikaya abo, byali bitandise okunkwatako ne mu Carthage: kubanga yali aleese ebintu okuva mu Byawandiikibwa ebitaali byangu kuwakanya, era okuddamu kw’Abamanikaya nnakulaba nga kunafu. Era okuddamu kuno tebaayagalanga kukwogera mu lwatu, wabula gye tuli ffekka mu kyama. Kwali nti Ebyawandiikibwa by’Endagaano Empya byali byonooneddwa omuntu gwe simanyi, eyayagala okugattika amateeka g’Abayudaaya ku kukkiriza kw’Abakristaayo: kyokka bo bennyini tebaaleetanga kopi zonna ezitaayonoonebwa. Naye nze, nga ndowooza ku bintu eby’omubiri byokka, nnali nnyigiriziddwa wansi nnyo, nga nzitoowereddwa nnyo era kumpi okuziyira, “ebikuŋŋaanyo” ebyo; era nga ntawaana wansi waabyo nga nneegomba omukka gw’amazima go, saasobola kugussa nga mulongoofu era nga tegwonoonese.

Essuula XII

Awo ne ntandika okukola n’obunyiikivu ekyo kye nnajjira e Rooma, okusomesa obwogezi; era okusooka, okukuŋŋaanya abamu mu nnyumba yange, abo be nnali ntandise okumanyibwa, era abaali bammanyisa; awo, laba, ne nzuula ebikolwa ebirala ebibi ebikolebwa mu Rooma, bye saasanganga mu Afirika. Mazima, “okutabangula” okwo okw’abavubuka abatalina mpisa tekwakolebwanga wano, nga bwe bambuulira: naye bagamba nti, amangu ago, okwewala okusasula omusomesa waabwe empeera ye, abavubuka bangi beekobaana, ne bagenda eri omusomesa omulala;—abamenya obwesigwa, abanyooma obwenkanya olw’okwagala ensimbi.
