Era Ggwe mu ngeri esinga byonna Ggwe Atakyukakyuka, Ggwe atakyuka; era mu Ggwe mwe muli ekiwummulo ekyerabiza okutegana kwonna, kubanga tewali mulala wamu naawe, so tetulina kunoonya bintu ebirala ebingi, ebitali ekyo ky’oli: naye ggwe wekka, Ayi Mukama, wantuuza mu ssuubi. Ne nsoma, ne nkoleezebwa; naye saalaba kya kukola abo abaggavu b’amatu era abafu, nze kennyini be nnali omu ku bo, omuntu ow’obulabe, omuleekaanyi omukaawu era omuzibe w’amaaso ng’alwanyisa ebiwandiiko ebyo, ebiwoomerezeddwa n’omubisi gw’enjuki ogw’omu ggulu, era ebyakaayakana n’ekitangaala kyo Ggwe kennyini: era ne nnyiikaala nnyo munda yange olw’abalabe b’Ekyawandiikibwa kino. Ndijjukira ddi byonna ebyabaawo mu nnaku ezo entukuvu? Kyokka sinneerabira, era sijja kubuuka bukambwe bw’omuggo gwo, n’obwangu obw’ekitalo obw’okusaasira kwo. Olwo wambonyaabonya n’obulumi bw’amannyo; era bwe bwatuuka ku ddaala nga sikyasobola kwogera, ne kinzijira mu mutima okusaba mikwano gyange gyonna abaaliwo bansabire gy’oli, Ggwe Katonda ow’obulamu obw’engeri zonna. Kino ne nkiwandiika ku kipande ky’envumbo, ne mbawa bakisome. Amangu ddala nga tumaze okufukamira n’okwewombeeka mu kwewaayo, obulumi obwo ne bugenda. Naye bulumi ki? Oba bwagenda butya? Ne ntya nnyo, Ayi Mukama wange, Katonda wange; kubanga okuva mu buto bwange saali nfunye kintu bwe kityo. Amaanyi g’Okulagira kwo ne gantuukamu nnyo munda, era nga nsanyuka mu kukkiriza, ne ntendereza Erinnya lyo. Era okukkiriza okwo tekwanzikiriza kuwummula olw’ebibi byange eby’emabega, ebyali tebinnansonyiyibwa mu kubatiza kwo. Essuula V Oluwummula lw’amakungula g’emizabbibu bwe lwaggwa, ne ntegeeza abantu b’e Milan banoonyeze abayizi baabwe omusomesa omulala abatundire ebigambo; kubanga nnali nsazeewo okukuweereza Ggwe, era olw’okussa omukka obubi n’obulumi mu kifuba kyange nnali sikyasobola mulimu gwa busomesa obwo. Era mu bbaluwa ne mmanyisa Omulabirizi wo, omusajja omutukuvu Ambrose, ensobi zange ez’edda n’okwegomba kwange okwa kaakano, nga mmusaba ambuulire ki ku Byawandiikibwa byo kye nnandisinzizza okusoma, ndyoke mbe omwetegefu era asaanira okufuna ekisa ekinene bwe kityo. N’ankubiriza nnabbi Isaaya: nzikiriza, kubanga ye asinga abalala bonna okulanga mu bulambulukufu Enjiri n’okuyitibwa kw’Abamawanga. Naye nze, bwe saategeera ssomo lisooka mu ye, ne ndowooza nti ekitabo kyonna kiri bwe kityo, ne nkiteeka ku bbali, okukiddamu nga mmaze okumanyiira ebigambo bya Mukama waffe. Essuula VI Awo, ekiseera bwe kyatuuka nga nnina okuwaayo erinnya lyange, ne tuva mu kyalo ne tuddayo e Milan. Ne Alypius naye n’asiima okuzaalibwa obuggya wamu nange mu Ggwe, ng’amaze okwambala obwetoowaze obusaanira Ssakramentu zo; era ng’afuga omubiri gwe n’amaanyi mangi nnyo, n’atuuka n’okutambuza ebigere bye ebyereere ku ttaka ery’omuzira erya Italy, ekintu ekitaakolwanga. Ne twegatta n’omulenzi Adeodatus, eyazaalibwa mu mubiri, okuva mu kibi kyange. Wamutonda bulungi nnyo. Yali tannaweza myaka kkumi na etaano, era mu magezi yasinga abasajja bangi abakulu era abayivu. Nkwatulira ebirabo byo, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, Omutonzi wa byonna, era asobola nnyo okutereeza obulema bwaffe: kubanga nze saalina mugabo mu mulenzi oyo, okuggyako ekibi. Kubanga okuba nti twamukuliza mu kuyigiriza kwo, Ggwe, so si mulala yenna, eyakituteeka ku mutima. Nkwatulira ebirabo byo. Waliwo ekitabo kyaffe ekiyitibwa Omusomesa; kwe kwogeraganya wakati we nange. Ggwe omanyi nti byonna ebyogerwa omuntu ayogera nange omwo byali birowoozo bye ye, mu mwaka gwe ogw’ekkumi n’omukaaga. Ne nsanga mu ye ebirala bingi, era eby’ekitalo n’okusingawo. Amagezi ago gansamaaliriza. Era ani okuggyako Ggwe ayinza okuba omukozi w’eby’amagero ng’ebyo? Mangu ddala n’omuggya ku nsi: era kaakano mmujjukira nga sirina kweraliikirira, nga sitya kintu kyonna ku lw’obuto bwe oba obuvubuka bwe, oba ku lulwe yonna. Ne tumwegattako, nga wa mulembe gwaffe mu kisa, okukuzibwa mu kuyigiriza kwo: ne tubatizibwa, n’okweraliikirira olw’obulamu bwaffe obw’emabega ne kutuggwaako. So mu nnaku ezo saakoowa buwoomi obw’ekitalo obw’okufumiitiriza ku buziba bw’entegeka zo ku bikwata ku bulokozi bw’abantu. Nga nnakaaba nnyo, mu Nnyimba zo n’Ebiyimbo byo, nga nkwatibwako nnyo munda olw’amaloboozi g’Ekkanisa yo eyimba obulungi! Amaloboozi ne gakulukutira mu matu gange, n’Amazima ne gatonnya mu mutima gwange, okwagala kwange okw’okwewaayo ne kwanjaala, amaziga ne gakulukuta, era nze nnali musanyufu mu ekyo. Essuula VII Kyali tekinnaba kiseera kiwanvu bukya Ekkanisa ey’e Milan etandika okukozesa engeri eno ey’okubudaabuda n’okukubiriza, ab’oluganda nga beegatta n’obunyiikivu mu ddoboozi limu n’emitima. Kubanga waali wayise omwaka gumu, oba tegusukka nnyo, Justina, nnyina wa Kabaka Valentinian, eyali akyali omwana, bwe yayigganya omuddu wo Ambrose, olw’enjigiriza ye ey’obukyamu, gye yasendebwasendebwamu abagoberezi ba Arius. Abantu abeewaddeyo ne batuula nga bakuuma mu Kkanisa, nga beetegefu okufiira wamu n’Omulabirizi waabwe, omuddu wo. Eyo maama wange, omuzaana wo, ng’asitudde ekitundu ekinene eky’okweraliikirira n’okutunula okwo, yabeeranga mu kusaba. Ffe, abaali tetunnabuguumizibwa bbugumu lya Mwoyo wo, kyokka twakubirizibwa olw’okulaba ekibuga nga kisamaaliridde era nga kitabuse. Awo lwe kyasooka okuteekebwawo, mu ngeri y’Amakanisa ag’Ebuvanjuba, Ennyimba ne Zabbuli biyimbibwenga, abantu baleme okuddirira olw’obukoowu bw’ennaku: era okuva ku lunaku olwo okutuusa leero empisa eyo ekyakuumibwa, ebibiina byo bingi (weewaawo, kumpi byonna), mu bitundu by’ensi ebirala, nga bigoberera kino. Awo n’obikkulira mu kwolesebwa Omulabirizi wo gwe njogeddeko, emirambo gy’abajulizi Gervasius ne Protasius we gyali gyekwese (gye wali otereka mu ggwanika lyo ery’ekyama nga tegivunze emyaka gyonna egyo), okuva gye wandigiggye mu kiseera ekituufu okuziyiza obukambwe bw’omukazi, naye nga Kabaka omukazi. Kubanga bwe gyazuulibwa ne gisimibwa, ne gitwalibwa n’ekitiibwa ekisaanidde mu Kkanisa ennene eya Ambrose, si abo bokka abaali babonyaabonyezebwa emyoyo emibi (baddayimooni nga bo bennyini beekkiriza) abaawonyezebwa, naye n’omusajja omu eyali amaze emyaka mingi nga muzibe w’amaaso, omutuuze, era amanyiddwa ennyo mu kibuga, bwe yabuuza n’awulira ensonga y’essanyu ery’oluyoogaano ery’abantu, n’abuuka n’asaba amukulembera amutwaleyo. Bwe yatwalibwayo, ne yeegayirira bamukkirize okukoma n’akatambaala ke ku kitanda ky’abafu eky’abatukuvu bo, okufa kwabwe kwe kuli okw’omuwendo ennyo mu maaso go. Bwe yamala okukikola, n’akateeka ku maaso ge, amangu ago ne gazibuka. Awo ettutumu ne libuna, awo ettendo lyo ne lyaka, ne lyakaayakana; awo omwoyo gw’omulabe oyo, wadde tegwakyuka kufuna bulamu bwa kukkiriza, ne gukyuka okuva ku busungu bwe obw’okuyigganya. Webale, Ayi Katonda wange. Okujjukira kwange okuggye wa era okutuusizza wa, ndyoke nkwatulire n’ebyo? Wadde nga bikulu, nnali mbibuuse nga mbyerabidde. Kyokka olwo, akaloosa k’amafuta go bwe kaali kawunya obulungi bwe kityo, tetwakugoberera nga tudduka. Kyennava nkaaba nnyo okusingawo wakati mu kuyimba Ennyimba zo, ng’edda nkussiza ebikkowe, era oluvannyuma ne nkussa mu Ggwe, nga bwe kisoboka omukka okuyingira mu nnyumba yaffe eno ey’omuddo. Essuula VIII Ggwe atuuza abantu ab’omwoyo gumu mu nnyumba emu, wagatta naffe ne Euodius, omuvubuka ow’omu kibuga kyaffe. Ye, bwe yali omukungu mu lubiri lw’omufuzi, yatusooka okukyukira Gy’Oli n’okubatizibwa; n’alekayo obuserikale obw’ensi, ne yeesiba olw’obuserikale bwo. Twali wamu, nga twagala okubeera awamu mu kigendererwa kyaffe eky’okukutya. Twanoonya gye twandikuweerezza mu ngeri esinga okugasa, era twali tuddayo ffenna e Afirika: naye bwe twatuuka e Ostia mu lugendo olwo, maama wange n’ava mu bulamu buno. Bingi mbireka, kubanga nnyanguwa nnyo. Kkiriza okwatula kwange n’okwebaza kwange, Ayi Katonda wange, olw’ebintu ebitabalika bye nsirikiddeko. Naye sijja kulekayo kyonna emmeeme yange ky’eyagala okuzaala ku lw’omuzaana wo oyo, eyanzaala, mu mubiri, ndyoke nzalibwe mu musana guno ogw’akaseera, era ne mu mutima, ndyoke nzalibwe mu Musana ogutaggwaawo. Si birabo bye, wabula ebibyo ebyali mu ye, bye njagala okwogerako; kubanga si ye yeekola, era si ye yeekuza. Ggwe wamutonda; era kitaawe ne nnyina tebaamanya muntu ki eyali agenda okuva mu bo. Era omuggo gw’obwakabaka gwa Kristo wo, okukangavvula kw’Omwana wo omu yekka, mu nnyumba ey’Ekikristaayo, ekitundu ekirungi eky’Ekkanisa yo, kye kyamukuza mu kukutya. Naye olw’okukangavvulwa kwe okulungi, yali atera okutendereza, si nnyo obunyiikivu bwa nnyina, ng’obw’omuzaana omu omukadde ennyo, eyali asitula kitaawe ng’akyali mwana muto, ng’abaana abato bwe baasitulwanga ku migongo gy’abawala abakulu. Olw’ensonga eyo, n’olw’obukadde bwe obungi, n’empisa ze ennungi ennyo, yali assibwamu nnyo ekitiibwa abakulu b’amaka ago ag’Ekikristaayo. Era kyeyava akwasibwa okulabirira bawala ba mukama we; n’akikola n’obunyiikivu, ng’abakomako n’amaanyi bwe kyabanga kyetaagisa, n’obukakali obutukuvu, era ng’abayigiriza n’amagezi ag’obuzito. Kubanga, okuggyako mu biseera mwe baaliiranga ku mmeeza ya bazadde baabwe nga balya mu kigero ekisaanidde ddala, teyabakkirizanga, ne bwe baabanga bayonta nnyo, kunywa wadde amazzi; ng’aziyiza empisa embi, era ng’agattako okubuulirira kuno okw’omugaso: “Kaakano munywa amazzi kubanga omwenge temugulina mu buyinza bwammwe; naye bwe mulifumbirwa, ne mufuuka bakyala b’amaterekero n’ebifo by’emmere, mulinyooma amazzi, naye empisa ey’okunywa erisigala.” Mu ngeri eyo ey’okuyigiriza, n’obuyinza bwe yalina, yaziyiza omululu ogw’obuto, n’abumba ennyonta yaabwe yennyini mu kwefuga okulungi ennyo, ne kiba nti kye baali tebasaanidde kukola, baali tebakyagala. Era naye (ng’omuzaana wo bwe yambuulira, nze omwana we) yali yeekwatiddwamu mpola okwagala omwenge. Kubanga bwe baamutumanga bazadde be (nga bwe kyalinga empisa), ng’omuwala omukkakkamu, okusena omwenge mu ppipa ennene, ng’akutte ekibya wansi w’omumwa gwayo, nga tannaba kufuka mwenge mu ccupa, yaguwoomerezangako katono n’akasongezo k’emimwa gye; kubanga okusingawo, obutonde bwe bwagaananga. Kino yakikolanga, si lwa kwegomba kunywa, wabula olw’amaanyi g’obuvubuka agabimba ne gavaamu emizannyo egy’essanyu, agatera okukkakkanyizibwa mu myoyo gy’abavubuka obuzito bw’abakulu baabwe. Bw’atyo, ng’agattako ku katono ako obutono bwa buli lunaku (kubanga anyooma ebintu ebitono aligwa mpola mpola), yali agudde mu mpisa bw’etyo, n’aba ng’anywa n’omululu akakopo ke akatono nga kajjudde kumpi okubooga omwenge. Omukadde oyo ow’amagezi yali ludda wa awo, n’okugaana kwe okw’amaanyi? Waliwo ekyandiyinzizza okulwanyisa obulwadde obw’ekyama, singa omukono gwo oguwonya, Ayi Mukama, tegwali gutukuuma? Nga kitaawe, nnyina, n’abalabirizi tebaliiwo, Ggwe ng’oliwo, Ggwe eyatonda, ayita, era akola ekintu olw’obulokozi bw’emmeeme zaffe ng’oyita ne mu abo abatulabirira, kiki kye wakola olwo, Ayi Katonda wange? Wamuwonya otya? Wamujjanjaba otya? Tewaggya mu mmeeme endala ekigambo eky’okuvuma ekikakali era ekisongovu, ng’akambe k’omusawo okuva mu tterekero lyo ery’ekyama, n’oggyawo obucaafu obwo bwonna n’okukwata kumu? Kubanga omuzaana gwe yagendanga naye mu tterekero ly’omwenge, bwe yayombagana (nga bwe kitera okubaawo) ne mukama we omuto, nga bali bokka, yamuvuma olw’ensobi eyo, n’okujooga okukambwe ennyo, ng’amuyita omutamiivu. Olw’ekivume ekyo, ye, ng’alumiddwa ddala mu mutima, n’alaba obucaafu bw’ensobi ye, amangu ago n’agisalira omusango n’agireka. Nga mikwano egiwaanawaana bwe gyonoona, bwe batyo abalabe abavuma emirundi mingi bwe batereeza. Naye si ekyo ky’okola ng’oyita mu bo, wabula kye baali bagenderera bo bennyini, ky’obasasula. Kubanga ye mu busungu bwe yali ayagala kunyiiza mukama we omuto, so si kumutereeza; era yakikola mu kyama, oba kubanga ekiseera n’ekifo eky’okuyomba kwabwe bwe byabasanga bwe bityo; oba aleme naye okunenyezebwa olw’okukyasanguza ekikeerezi bwe kityo. Naye Ggwe, Mukama, Omufuzi wa byonna mu ggulu ne ku nsi, akyusa amazzi agakulukuta ag’ebuziba okutuukiriza ebigendererwa byo, era afuga akakyankalano k’amayengo g’ebiseera, wawonya emmeeme emu olw’obulwadde bw’endala yennyini; waleme kubaawo muntu, bw’alaba kino, akiteeka ku maanyi ge ye, ne bwe kiba nti omulala gw’ayagala okutereera atereezebwa olw’ebigambo bye. Essuula IX Bwe yakuzibwa bw’atyo mu buwombeefu ne mu kwefuga, era ng’agonzebwa Ggwe okugondera bazadde be, okusinga bazadde be okumugonza Gy’Oli, amangu ddala nga yaakatuuka mu myaka egy’okufumbirwa, n’aweebwa omusajja, n’amuweereza nga mukama we; era n’afuba okumukuleetera, ng’akubuulira gy’ali mu mpisa ze; ze wamuyooyoozesa, n’omufuula ow’okwagalibwa n’okussibwamu ekitiibwa, era ow’okwewuunyibwa eri bba. Era n’agumiikiriza okumusobya kwe ku kitanda kyabwe, n’atayomba na bba n’akatono ku nsonga eyo. Kubanga yalindirira okusaasira kwo kumutuukeko, alyoke akukkirize, afuuke omulongoofu. Naye ng’oggyeko ekyo, yali wa bbugumu lingi, mu kwagala kwe ne mu busungu bwe: naye ye yali ayize obutawakanya bba ng’ali mu busungu, si mu bikolwa byokka, wabula wadde mu bigambo. Bwe yabanga akkakkanye era ng’atereddwa, nga mwetegefu okuwuliriza, n’alyoka amunnyonnyola ebikolwa bye, bwe kyabanga nti yali anyiize mangu nnyo nga tasaanidde. Mu bufunze, abakyala bangi ab’ebitiibwa, abaalina babbaabwe abakkakkamu okusingawo, ne bwe baabanga n’enkovu ez’okuswazibwa ku maaso gaabwe, bwe baanyumyanga mu mukwano baavumanga obulamu bwa babbaabwe; ye n’avuma ennimi zaabwe, ng’abawa, nga mu kusaaga, okubuulirira okw’amazima: “Nti okuva ku lunaku lwe baawulira ebiwandiiko by’obufumbo nga bisomebwa gye bali, baali basaanidde okubitwala ng’endagaano ezibafuula abaweereza; era bwe batyo, nga bajjukira embeera yaabwe, tebaali basaanidde kwegulumiza ku bakama baabwe.” Era bwe baamanya bba omusunguwavu gwe yali agumiikiriza, ne beewuunya nti tekyali kiwuliddwako, newakubadde okulabika mu kabonero konna, nti Patricius yali akubye mukazi we, oba nti waaliwo obutakkaanya mu maka gaabwe, wadde olunaku lumu, ne bamubuuza ensonga mu kyama, n’abayigiriza empisa ye gye nnyonnyodde waggulu. Abakyala abaagigobereranga baalaba obulungi, ne beebaza; abo abataagigoberera tebaafuna buweerero, ne babonaabona. Ne nnyazaala we, eyasooka okumunyiigira olw’okwogeraganya mu kyama okw’abaweereza ababi, n’amuwangula bw’atyo olw’okumussaamu ekitiibwa, n’okugumiikiriza okutaggwaawo, n’obuwombeefu, nti ye yennyini, ku bubwe, n’abikkulira mutabani we ennimi ezeeyingiza mu bitali byazo ezaali zitabudde emirembe mu maka wakati we ne muka mwana we, n’amusaba azikangavvule. Awo, bwe yamala okugondera nnyina, era olw’okulongoosa empisa mu maka, n’akangavvula n’emiggo abo abaabikkulwa, nga nnyina eyababikkula bw’ayagala, n’asuubiza empeera efaanana bw’etyo eri buli muntu yenna eyandyogedde obubi ku muka mwana we gy’ali, ng’ayagala okumusanyusa; era bwe watabaawo n’omu eyagezaako nate, ne babeera wamu mu kisa eky’okwagalana ekyewuunyisa ennyo. Era ekirabo kino ekinene wakiwa, Ayi Katonda wange, ekisa kyange, omuzaana wo oyo omulungi, mu lubuto lwe mwe wantondera, nti wakati w’abantu abatakkaanya era abaawukanye, buli we yasobolanga, yeeragiranga nga mutabaganya, ne kiba nti ne bwe yawuliranga ku njuyi zombi ebigambo ebikaawa ennyo, ng’ebyo obusungu obuzimbye obutagaaya bwe butera okufulumya, ng’obukyayi obutannaba kugonda bufukumulibwa mu bigambo ebikaawa eri mukwano ali awo ku mulabe atali awo, teyabikkulanga kintu kyonna eky’omu eri omulala, okuggyako ekyo ekyandibatabaganyizza. Kino kyandimbeeredde ekirungi ekitono, singa saali mmanyi, ne kinnakuwaza, abantu abatabalika, abo, olw’obulwadde bw’ekibi obw’entiisa obusaasaanidde ennyo, tebakoma ku kubikkulira bantu abanyiigaganye ebigambo ebyayogerwa mu busungu, wabula bongerako n’ebitaayogerwangako; so nga eri omuntu alina obuntubulamu, kyandibadde kirabika nga kitono nnyo obutabonyaabonya oba obutongera bukyayi n’ebigambo ebibi, okuggyako ng’omuntu afuba n’okubuzikiza n’ebigambo ebirungi. Bw’atyo bwe yali, nga Ggwe kennyini, Omuyigiriza we ow’omunda ennyo, omuyigiriza mu ssomero ly’omutima. Ku nkomerero, ne bba yennyini, ng’obulamu bwe obw’oku nsi bunaatera okuggwaako, yamukuleetera; era teyalina kye yeemulugunyaako mu ye ng’amaze okukkiriza, ku ebyo bye yagumiikirizanga gy’ali nga tannakkiriza. Era yali muweereza w’abaweereza bo; buli eyamumanyanga ku bo, yakutenderezanga nnyo, n’akussaamu ekitiibwa era n’akwagala mu ye; kubanga olw’obujulirwa bw’ebibala by’empisa entukuvu, baategeeranga nti oli mu mutima gwe. Kubanga yali yafumbirwa omusajja omu, yali asasudde bazadde be, yali afuze ennyumba ye mu kutya Katonda, yali ayogerwako bulungi olw’ebikolwa ebirungi, yali aleze abaana, ng’alumwa okubazaala emirundi mingi, buli lwe yalabanga nga bakuwaba. Ku nkomerero, ffenna abaweereza bo, Ayi Mukama (b’okkiriza okwogera olw’ekirabo kyo), ffe abaali tubeera awamu nga tuli bumu nga tannagenda kwebaka mu Ggwe, nga tumaze okufuna ekisa ky’okubatizibwa kwo, yatulabiriranga ng’abadde maama waffe ffenna; n’atuweereza ng’abadde mwana waffe ffenna. Essuula X Olunaku bwe lwali lusembera lwe yali agenda okuva mu bulamu buno (olunaku lwe wali omanyi bulungi, ffe nga tetulumanyi), kyabaawo, nga Ggwe kennyini, bwe nzikiriza, okitegeka bw’otyo mu makubo go ag’ekyama, nze naye ne tuyimirira ffekka, nga twesigamye ku ddirisa erimu, eryali litunuulira ennimiro y’ennyumba mwe twali tusula, e Ostia; gye twali, nga tuli wala n’oluyoogaano lw’abantu, tuwummulamu okukoowa kw’olugendo oluwanvu, nga twetegekera okusaabala ku nnyanja. Awo twali twogera ffembi, ffekka, mu ssanyu lingi; era nga twerabira ebyo ebiri emabega, ne tuluubirira ebyo ebiri mu maaso, twali tubuuzaganya ffekka mu maaso g’Amazima, gwe Ggwe, obulamu obutaggwaawo obw’abatukuvu bwe bunaaba: ebyo eriiso bye litalabangako, n’okutu bye kutawulirangako, n’omutima gw’omuntu kye gutalowoozangako. Naye era twayasamya akamwa k’omutima gwaffe, nga twegomba emigga egy’omu ggulu egy’ensulo yo, ensulo ey’obulamu, gy’olina; tulyoke, nga tufukiddwa okuva awo ng’obusobozi bwaffe bwe bwenkana, tufumiitirize mu ngeri emu ku kyama ekigulumivu bwe kityo. Era emboozi yaffe bwe yatuuka ku kino, nti essanyu erisingirayo ddala ery’obusimu bw’omubiri, mu kitangaala ekisingayo obulongoofu eky’ensi, bwe kigeraageranyizibwa n’obuwoomi bw’obulamu obwo, teryali lisaanira kugeraageranyizibwa, wadde okwogerwako; ne twegulumiza n’okwagala okwaka ennyo eri “Oyo Ali Bw’Ali,” mpola mpola ne tuyita mu bintu byonna eby’omubiri, ne mu ggulu lyennyini enjuba n’omwezi n’emmunyeenye mwe byakira ku nsi; weewaawo, twali tweyongera okubuuka waggulu, nga tufumiitiriza munda, nga twogera, era nga twewuunya emirimu gyo; ne tutuuka ku birowoozo byaffe ffennyini, ne tubisukka, tulyoke tutuuke mu kitundu ekyo eky’obugagga obutaggwaawo, gy’oliisiza Isirayiri emirembe gyonna n’emmere ey’amazima, era obulamu gye buli Amagezi ago agaakola ebintu bino byonna, ebyaliwo n’ebiribaawo; era go tegaakolebwa, wabula gali, nga bwe gabadde, era bwe galibeera bwe gatyo emirembe gyonna; weewaawo, wabula “okubaawo edda,” ne “okubaawo oluvannyuma,” tebiri mu go, wabula “okubaawo” kwokka, kubanga ga lubeerera. Kubanga “okubaawo edda,” ne “okubaawo oluvannyuma,” si bya lubeerera. Era bwe twali twogera ku go era nga tugeegomba, twagakwatako katono n’amaanyi gonna ag’omutima gwaffe; ne tussa ekikkowe, ne tuleka eyo nga bisibiddwa ebibala ebibereberye eby’Omwoyo; ne tuddayo mu bigambo by’akamwa kaffe, ekigambo ekyogerwa mwe kirina entandikwa n’enkomerero. Era kiki ekifaanana Kigambo kyo, Mukama waffe, abeerera mu ye yennyini nga takaddiwa, era azza ebintu byonna obuggya? Awo ne twogera nti: Singa eri omuntu yenna oluyoogaano lw’omubiri lusirika, ne bisirika ebifaananyi by’ensi, n’eby’amazzi, n’eby’empewo, ne lisirika n’eggulu lyennyini, weewaawo, n’emmeeme yennyini n’esirika mu yo yokka, n’olw’obutalowooza ku yo yennyini n’esukka yo yennyini, ne bisirika ebirooto byonna n’okubikkulirwa okw’omu birowoozo, buli lulimi na buli kabonero, ne buli kintu kyonna ekibaawo nga kiyitawo bwokka—kubanga omuntu yenna bwe yandiwulidde, ebyo byonna byogera nti: Si ffe twetonda, wabula yatutonda Oyo abeerera emirembe gyonna—Singa, nga bimaze okwogera kino, nabyo ne bisirika, nga bimaze okuzuukusa amatu gaffe eri Oyo eyabitonda, era Ye yekka n’ayogera, si ng’ayita mu byo wabula ku bubwe yekka, tulyoke tuwulire Ekigambo kye, si nga kiyita mu lulimi lwonna olw’omubiri, newakubadde eddoboozi lya malayika, newakubadde okubwatuka kw’eggulu, newakubadde mu kifaananyi ekitategeerekeka ng’olugero olw’ekizikiza, wabula tuwulire Oyo gwe twagala mu bintu bino, tumuwulire Ye kennyini awatali bino (nga ffembi bwe twegolola kaakano, ne tukwatako mu kirowoozo ekyanguwa ku Magezi ago ag’Olubeerera agabeerera okusinga byonna);—singa kino kyeyongera mu maaso, n’okwolesebwa okulala okw’engeri eteefaananya ne kuggibwawo, n’okwo kwokka ne kukwata, ne kumira, ne kubikka oyo akulaba mu ssanyu lino ery’omunda, obulamu ne bubeera emirembe gyonna nga akaseera ako akamu ak’okutegeera kwe twegombedde kaakano; kino si kye kyandibadde ekyo nti: Yingira sanyukira wamu ne mukama wo? Era ekyo kiribaawo ddi? Bwe tulizuukira ffenna, wadde nga si ffenna abalifuusibwa? Ebyo bye nnali njogera, era ne bwe kiba nti si mu ngeri eno ddala, na mu bigambo bino byennyini, naye, Mukama, Ggwe omanyi nti ku lunaku olwo bwe twali twogera ku bintu bino, era ensi eno n’essanyu lyayo lyonna bwe yafuuka, nga bwe twali twogera, ey’okunyoomebwa gye tuli, maama wange n’agamba nti, “Mwana wange, nze ku lwange sikyalina kinsanyusa mu kintu kyonna mu bulamu buno. Kye nkyakola wano, era lwaki nkyali wano, simanyi, kubanga essuubi lyange mu nsi eno lituukiridde. Waaliwo ekintu kimu kyokka kye nnali njagala okulwa katono mu bulamu buno, ndabe nga oli Mukristaayo Omukatoliki nga sinnafa. Katonda wange ankoledde kino okusingawo, kubanga kaakano nkulaba, era, ng’onyooma essanyu ery’ensi, ng’ofuuse omuweereza we: kiki kye nkyakola wano?” Essuula XI Kye nnamuddamu ku bintu bino, sikijjukira. Kubanga ennaku ezitasukka ttaano, oba ezitali nnyingi okusingawo, n’alwala omusujja; era mu bulwadde obwo, lumu n’azirika, n’aggibwa katono ku bintu bino ebirabika. Ne tumwetooloola mangu; naye amangu ago n’addamu okutegeera; era bwe yatunuulira nze ne muganda wange nga tuyimiridde w’ali, n’atugamba ng’abuuza nti, “Nnali ludda wa?” Awo n’atutunuulira enkaliriza, ng’awuniikiridde olw’ennaku: “Wano,” bw’ayogera, “we mujja okuziika nnyammwe.” Nze ne nsirika ne nziyiza okukaaba; naye muganda wange n’ayogera ekintu, ng’amwagaliza, ng’omukisa omulungi okusingawo, afiire, si mu nsi ya bannaggwanga, wabula mu nsi y’ewaabwe. Awo, ye ng’atunuza amaaso ag’okweraliikirira, ng’amukoma n’amaaso ge, kubanga yali akyalowooza ku bintu ng’ebyo, n’alyoka antunuulira: “Laba,” bw’ayogera, “ky’ayogera”: era amangu ago n’atugamba ffembi, “Muteekenga,” bw’ayogera, “omubiri guno wonna wonna; obweraliikirivu ku gwo bulemenga okubateganya n’akatono: kino kyokka kye mbasaba, munjijukirenga ku kyoto kya Mukama, wonna wonna gye munaabeeranga.” Era bwe yamala okwogera ekirowoozo kino mu bigambo bye yasobola, n’asirika, ng’abonyaabonyezebwa obulwadde bwe obweyongera. Naye nze, bwe nnalowooza ku birabo byo, Ggwe Katonda atalabika, by’ofuka mu mitima gy’abeesigwa bo, ebibala eby’ekitalo mwe bimerukira, ne nsanyuka era ne nkwebaza, nga nzijukira kye nnali mmanyi edda, engeri gye yali yeeraliikirira era gye yali afaayo bulijjo ku kifo w’aliziikibwa, kye yali yeefunira era yeetegekera okumpi n’omubiri gwa bba. Kubanga olw’okuba nti baali babeera wamu mu kukwatagana okungi, naye yali ayagala (omutima gw’omuntu bwe gutasobola kutegeera bulungi bintu bya Katonda) okugattibwa ku ssanyu eryo ekirala kino, era kijjukirwenga mu bantu, nti oluvannyuma lw’okutambula kwe emitala w’ennyanja, ekyali eky’ensi eky’abafumbo bano abaali bagattiddwa kyakkirizibwa okugattibwa wansi w’ettaka lye limu. Naye obutaliimu buno bwe bwatandika okuggwaawo mu mutima gwe olw’obujjuvu bw’obulungi bwo, saamanya, ne nsanyuka nga nneewuunya kye yali ambikkulidde bw’atyo; wadde nga mu mboozi yaffe eyo ku ddirisa, bwe yagamba nti, “Kiki kye nkyakola wano?” teyalaga kwegomba kwonna kufiira mu nsi y’ewaabwe. Era nnawulira oluvannyuma nti, bwe twali e Ostia, ye n’obwesige bwa maama, nga nze siriiwo, lumu yanyumya n’abamu ku mikwano gyange ku kunyooma obulamu buno, n’omukisa gw’okufa: era bwe beewuunya obuvumu obwo bwe wali owadde omukazi, ne bamubuuza, “Oba nga tatya kulekera mubiri gwe wala bw’atyo okuva mu kibuga ky’ewaabwe?” n’addamu nti, “Tewali kiri wala eri Katonda; so tekyali kya kutya nti ku nkomerero y’ensi, alemwa okutegeera gy’alinzuukiriza.” Awo ku lunaku olw’omwenda olw’obulwadde bwe, mu mwaka gwe ogw’ataano mu mukaaga, nange mu gwange ogw’amakumi asatu mu esatu, emmeeme eyo ey’okutya Katonda era entukuvu n’esumululwa okuva mu mubiri. Essuula XII Nnamuziba amaaso; era ennaku ey’amaanyi n’ekulukutira mu mutima gwange, nga yali egenda kubooga n’efuuka amaziga; naye amaaso gange mu kiseera kye kimu, olw’ekiragiro eky’amaanyi eky’ebirowoozo byange, ne ganywa ensulo yaago, ne gakalira ddala; era nga nnali mu buyinike mu kulwana okw’engeri eyo! Naye bwe yamala okussa omukka ogw’enkomerero, omulenzi Adeodatus n’atulikamu okukaaba n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka; awo, bwe twamukoma ffenna, n’asirika. Mu ngeri y’emu n’enneewulira ey’obwana munda mu nze, eyali, olw’eddoboozi ery’obuvubuka ery’omutima gwange, egenda kufulumira mu kukaaba, n’ekomebwa n’esirisibwa. Kubanga twalowooza nti tekisaanira kukuza kuziika okwo n’okukaaba n’amaziga, n’okusinda; kubanga emirundi mingi abantu mwe balagira ennaku yaabwe olw’abafudde, nga gy’obeera nti bali mu nnaku, oba nga baafiiridde ddala; so nga ye teyali mu nnaku mu kufa kwe, era teyali afiiridde ddala. Kino twali tukikakasa olw’ensonga ennungi, obujulirwa bw’empisa ze ennungi n’okukkiriza okutaliimu bukuusa kwe. Kale kiki ekyandinnumya ennyo munda, wabula ekiwundu ekipya ekyava mu kukutulwa okw’amangu okw’empisa eyo ennungi ennyo era ey’omuwendo ey’okubeera awamu? Nnasanyuka ddala olw’obujulirwa bwe, kubanga mu bulwadde bwe obwo obw’enkomerero, ng’agatta ebigambo bye eby’okwagala ku mirimu gyange egy’obuvunaanyizibwa, yampita “omwana omuwulize,” n’ayogera, n’okwagala kungi, nti teyawulirangako ddoboozi lyonna ekkakali oba ery’okunenya nga liva mu kamwa kange eri ye. Naye era, Ayi Katonda wange, Ggwe eyatutonda, kugeraageranya ki okuli wakati w’ekitiibwa kye nnamuwa, n’obuddu bwe yakola ku lwange? Bwe nnali nsigadde nga mpeddwako ekisanyusa ekinene bwe kityo mu ye, emmeeme yange n’efuna ekiwundu, n’obulamu obwo ne buyuzibwamu wakati, obwali bufuuse obumu, nga bwa bwe n’obwange. Awo omulenzi bwe yamala okusirisibwa n’alekayo okukaaba, Euodius n’akwata ekitabo kya Zabbuli, n’atandika okuyimba, ennyumba yaffe yonna ng’emwanukula, Zabbuli eyo: Nnaayimbanga ku kwagala kwo n’obutuukirivu bwo; nnaayimbiranga ggwe, Ayi Mukama. Naye bwe baawulira kye twali tukola, ab’oluganda bangi n’abakazi abeewaayo eri Katonda ne bakuŋŋaana; era nga bo (abaali n’omulimu ogwo) bwe baali bategeka okuziika, nga bwe kiri empisa, nze (mu kitundu ky’ennyumba, gye nnali nsobola okubeera nga kisaanidde), wamu n’abo abaalowooza nti tekisaanira kundeka, ne twogera ku kintu ekisaanira ekiseera ekyo; era olw’eddagala lino ery’amazima ne nkkakkanya obulumi obwo, bw’omanyi, bo nga tebabumanyi, era nga bawuliriza n’obwegendereza, nga balowooza nti sirina nnaku yonna. Naye mu matu go, gye wataali n’omu ku bo awulira, nnanenya obunafu bw’enneewulira zange, ne nziyiza amataba g’ennaku yange, ne gandekera katono; naye ne gakomawo nate, ng’amayengo, wabula si nga bwe gandibaluseemu amaziga, wadde okukyusa endabika y’amaaso gange; naye nnali mmanyi kye nnali nziyiza mu mutima gwange. Era bwe nnali sisanyukidde ddala nti ebintu bino eby’obuntu birina obuyinza obwenkanidde awo ku nze, ebiteekwa okubaawo mu nteekateeka n’ensengeka ey’embeera yaffe ey’obutonde, ne nnakuwala n’ennaku empya olw’ennaku yange, ne nkoozebwa bwe ntyo ennaku ey’emirundi ebiri. Era laba, omulambo ne gutwalibwa okuziikibwa; ne tugenda ne tukomawo nga tetukaaba. Kubanga ne mu kusaba kwe twakufukira, Ssaddaaka ey’okununulibwa kwaffe bwe yaweebwayo ku lulwe, omulambo nga guli ku mabbali g’entaana, nga bwe kiri empisa eyo, nga tegunnateekebwamu, saakaaba wadde mu kusaba okwo; naye olunaku lwonna nnali mu nnaku ey’amaanyi mu kyama, era n’omutima ogweraliikirivu nnakusaba, nga bwe nnasobola, ompooze ennaku yange, naye tewakikola; ng’onyweza, bwe ndowooza, mu kujjukira kwange olw’ekyokulabirako kino kimu, obusibe bw’empisa yonna bwe buli obw’amaanyi, ne ku mmeeme eriisibwa Ekigambo ekitalimba. Era kyandabikira kirungi okugenda okunaaba, bwe nnali mpulidde nti ekinaabiro kyafuna erinnya lyakyo (balneum) okuva mu Luyonaani Balaneion kubanga kigoba ennaku mu birowoozo. Era kino nakyo nkyatula eri okusaasira kwo, Ggwe Kitaabwe w’abataliiko bakitaabwe, nti nnanaaba, ne mbeera nga bwe nnali nga sinnaba kunaaba. Kubanga obukaawu bw’ennaku tebwasobola kukulukuta kuva mu mutima gwange. Awo ne nneebaka, ne nzuukuka nate, ne nsanga ennaku yange ng’ekkakkanye si katono; era bwe nnali nzekka ku kitanda kyange, ne nzijukira ennyiriri ezo ez’amazima eza Ambrose wo. Kubanga Ggwe oli “Mutonzi wa byonna, Mukama, Era Omufuzi w’ebya waggulu, Ggwe, ayambaza emisana ekitangaala, afuse Otulo otuwooma ku kiro, Emikono n’amagulu gyaffe giryoke Gizzibwemu amaanyi g’okukola, N’emitima egigwa n’egitya giyimusibwe, N’ennaku zikkakkanyizibwe.” Awo mpola mpola ne nzijukira nate ebirowoozo byange ebyasooka ku muzaana wo, empisa ze entukuvu gy’Oli, okufaayo kwe okutukuvu n’okutussaamu ekitiibwa, bye nnali naggiddwako amangu ago: ne njagala okukaaba mu maaso go, ku lulwe ne ku lwange, okumukaabira n’okwekaabira. Ne ndeka amaziga ge nnali nziyizza edda gakulukute nga bwe gaali gaagala; nga nnwummuza omutima gwange ku go; ne gufuna ekiwummulo mu go, kubanga gwali mu matu go, so si mu g’omuntu, eyandivvunuddemu okukaaba kwange n’okunyooma. Era kaakano, Mukama, mu kuwandiika nkyatula gy’Oli. Asome, oyo ayagala, era akitegeere, nga bw’ayagala: era bw’asangamu ekibi, nti nnakaabira maama wange okumala ekitundu ekitono eky’essaawa (maama oyo eyali afudde mu maaso gange okumala ekiseera, eyali ankaabidde emyaka emingi ndyoke mbeere mulamu mu maaso go), aleme kunsekerera; wabula, bw’aba omuntu ow’okwagala okungi, yeekaabire yennyini olw’ebibi byange gy’Oli, Kitaabwe w’ab’oluganda bonna aba Kristo wo. Essuula XIII Naye kaakano, omutima gwange nga guwonye ekiwundu ekyo, mwe gwandirabise ng’ogusaanidde okunenyezebwa olw’okuwulira okw’ensi, nkufukira Ggwe, Katonda waffe, ku lw’omuweereza wo oyo omukazi, amaziga ag’engeri endala ennyo, agakulukuta okuva mu mwoyo ogukankanyizibwa okulowooza ku kabi akali ku buli mmeeme efiira mu Adamu. Era newakubadde nga ye, bwe yali amaze okufuulibwa omulamu mu Kristo, ne bwe yali nga tannasumululwa mu mubiri, yali abadde mulamu olw’ettendo ly’erinnya lyo olw’okukkiriza kwe n’empisa ze; naye sirina buvumu kugamba nti okuva lwe wamuzaala omulundi ogwokubiri mu kubatizibwa, tewali kigambo kyava mu kamwa ke ekyali kikontana n’Ekiragiro kyo. Omwana wo, Amazima, yagamba nti Buli anaagambanga muganda we nti Musirusiru, asaanidde okusuulibwa mu muliro ogwa ggeyeena. Era zisanze n’obulamu bw’abantu obusiimibwa, singa, ng’oteeka ku bbali okusaasira, ggwe obwekebejja. Naye olw’okuba tonoonyereza ku bibi mu bukambwe obusukkiridde, tusuubira n’obuvumu okufuna ekifo gy’Oli. Naye buli akubalira ebirungi bye eby’amazima, akubalira ki ddala okuggyako ebirabo byo Ggwe? Singa abantu bamanya nti bantu bubantu; era nti eyeenyumiriza yeenyumirizenga mu Mukama. Kale nze, Ayi Ettendo lyange era Obulamu bwange, Katonda w’omutima gwange, nga nteeka ku bbali okumala akaseera ebikolwa bye ebirungi, bye nkwebaza n’essanyu, kaakano nkwegayirira olw’ebibi bya maama wange. Mpulira, nkwegayiridde, ku lw’Eddagala ly’ebiwundu byaffe, Eyawanikibwa ku muti, era kaakano ng’atudde ku mukono gwo ogwa ddyo, atwegayiririra gy’Oli. Mmanyi nti yakolanga eby’ekisa, era okuva mu mutima gwe n’asonyiwa abaali bamulinako amabanja, amabanja gaabwe; naawe musonyiwe amabanja ge, gonna g’ayinza okuba nga yeewola mu myaka emingi bwe gityo, okuva ku mazzi ag’obulokozi. Musonyiwe, Mukama, musonyiwe, nkwegayiridde; tomusalira musango. Okusaasira kwo kugulumizibwe okusinga obwenkanya bwo, kubanga ebigambo byo bya mazima, era wasuubiza okusaasira abo abasaasira; era Ggwe wabawa okuba ab’ekisa, Ggwe akwatirwa ekisa oyo gw’oyagala okukwatirwa ekisa, era olisaasira oyo gw’osaasidde. Era, nzikiriza, okoze dda kye nsaba; naye okkirize, Ayi Mukama, ebiweebwayo akamwa kange bye kakuwa ku bwagazi. Kubanga ye, olunaku lw’okufa kwe bwe lwali lusembedde, teyafaayo mubiri gwe kuzingibwa mu ngoye ez’ebbeeyi, wadde okusiigibwa ebyakaloosa; era teyeegomba kijjukizo ekirondeddwa, wadde okuziikibwa mu nsi ye ye. Ebyo teyabitulagira; naye yeegomba bwegombi erinnya lye lijjukirwenga ku Kyoto kyo, kye yaweerezanga awatali kubulako lunaku na lumu: gye yali amanyi nti ssaddaaka entukuvu egabibwa, eyo esangula ekiwandiiko ky’amabanja ekyali kitulumiriza; mwe yawangulirwa omulabe, oyo eyabala ebisobyo byaffe, n’anoonya eky’okutuvunaana, n’atalaba kintu na kimu mu Ye, Oyo mwe tuwangulira. Ani alimuddiza omusaayi ogutaliiko musango? Ani alimusasula omuwendo gwe yatugula nagwo, alyoke atutwale okutuggya gy’Ali? Ku Ssakalamentu ey’omutango gwaffe ogwo, omuweereza wo omukazi yasiba emmeeme ye n’olukoba lw’okukkiriza. Tewabaawo n’omu amwawula ku bukuumi bwo: empologoma newakubadde ogusota bireme okwesimba wakati, ku maanyi wadde ku bukuusa. Kubanga taliddamu nti talina ky’abanjibwa, aleme kusingisibwa musango n’akwatibwa omuloopi omukujjukujju; naye aliddamu nti ebibi bye yabisonyiyibwa Oyo, atasobola kusasulwa muntu yenna omuwendo ogwo Ye, ataalina bbanja lyonna, gwe yatusasulira. Kale awummulire mu mirembe wamu ne bba, gwe yali tasoose kufumbirwa omulala wadde oluvannyuma lwe; gwe yagondera, ng’akubalira ebibala n’obugumiikiriza, alyoke amukomyewo naye gy’Oli. Era luŋŋamya, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, luŋŋamya abaweereza bo baganda bange, batabani bo bakama bange, be mpeereza n’eddoboozi, n’omutima, n’ekkalaamu, bonna abalisoma Okwatula kuno, bajjukire ku Kyoto kyo Monnica omuweereza wo omukazi, wamu ne Patricius, eyali bba, mu mibiri gyabwe mwe wanzisa mu bulamu buno, mu ngeri gye simanyi. Bajjukire n’omutima ogw’okwewaayo bazadde bange mu kitangaala kino ekiyitawo, baganda bange wansi wo Ggwe Kitaffe mu Nnyaffe Ekkanisa Katoliki, era bannansi bannange mu Yerusaalemi eky’olubeerera, abantu bo abatambuze kye beegomba nga basinda okuva ku Kuvaayo kwabwe, okutuusa lwe balikomawo eyo. Bwe kityo okusaba kwa maama wange okwasembayo kwe yansaba, kulyoke kutuukirire gy’ali mu bungi okusingawo, olw’okusaba kw’abangi, nga kuyita mu kwatula kwange okusinga okuyita mu kusaba kwange.

fields.title: Ekitabo X
fields.body_html:
Essuula I

Ka nkumanye, Ayi Mukama, Ggwe ammanyi: ka nkumanye nga nange bwe mmanyiddwa. Ggwe Amaanyi g’emmeeme yange, yingira mu yo, ogifuule esaanire Ggwe, olyoke ogibeere nayo era ogikuumenga nga teriiko bbala wadde akamogo. Lino lye ssuubi lyange, noolwekyo kyenva njogera; era mu ssuubi lino mwe nsanyukira, bwe nsanyuka essanyu eriramu. Ebintu ebirala eby’obulamu buno, gye bikoma okukaabirwa, gye bikoma obutasaanira kukaabirwa; era gye bikoma okusaanira okukaabirwa, abantu gye bakoma obutabikaabira. Kubanga laba, Ggwe oyagala amazima, era oyo agakola ajja eri omusana. Ekyo kye njagala okukola mu mutima gwange mu maaso go nga nkwatulira: ne mu biwandiiko byange, mu maaso g’abajulirwa abangi.

Essuula II

Era Ggwe, Ayi Mukama, ali amaaso go obuziba bw’omutima gw’omuntu mwe bulabikira obwereere, kiki ekyandikukwekeddwa mu nze, ne bwe sandyagadde kukyatula? Kubanga nandibadde nkweka Ggwe okuva gye ndi, so si nze okuva gy’Oli. Naye kaakano, okusinda kwange bwe kuli omujulirwa nti seesiima, Ggwe oyakaayakana, era osiimibwa, era oyagalwa, era weegombebwa; ndyoke nkwatibwe ensonyi ku lwange, nneegaane, nkulonde Ggwe, era nneme kukusanyusa Ggwe wadde okwesanyusa nze, wabula mu Ggwe. Gy’Oli kale, Ayi Mukama, ndi mubikkule, ne bwe mba ki; era nnayogedde dda ebibala bye nfuna mu kukwatulira. So sikikola na bigambo na maloboozi ga mubiri, wabula n’ebigambo by’emmeeme yange, n’okukaaba kw’ebirowoozo, okutu kwo kwe kumanyi. Kubanga bwe mba omubi, okukwatulira tekuba kirala wabula okwenyiigira; naye bwe mba omutukuvu, tekuba kirala wabula obutakyetwalira: kubanga Ggwe, Ayi Mukama, owa omukisa omutuukirivu, naye osooka kumuwa butuukirivu ng’akyali atatya Katonda. Okwatula kwange kale, Ayi Katonda wange, mu maaso go, kukolebwa mu kasirise, era si mu kasirise. Kubanga mu ddoboozi kusirika; naye mu kwagala kw’omutima, kukaaba n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka. Kubanga sirina kirungi kye njogera eri abantu ky’otosoose kuwulira okuva gye ndi; so tewali kintu ng’ekyo ky’owulira okuva gye ndi ky’otosoose kungamba.

Essuula III

Kale nkolagana ki n’abantu, balyoke bawulire okwatula kwange—ng’abayinza okuwonya endwadde zange zonna—ekika ky’abantu abanyiikivu okumanya obulamu bw’abalala, naye abagayaavu okutereeza obwabwe? Lwaki baagala okuwulira okuva gye ndi bwe ndi; so nga tebaagala kuwulira okuva gy’Oli bo bwe bali? Era bamanya batya, bwe bawulira okuva gye ndi ebinkwatako, oba nga njogera mazima; ng’ate tewali muntu amanyi ebiri mu muntu, wabula omwoyo w’omuntu oyo ali mu ye? Naye bwe bawulira okuva gy’Oli ebibakwatako, tebayinza kugamba nti, “Mukama alimba.” Kubanga okuwulira okuva gy’Oli ebibakwatako kwe kuki, wabula okwemanya? era ani amanya n’agamba nti, “Si kituufu,” okuggyako ng’ye kennyini alimba? Naye kubanga okwagala kukkiriza byonna (kwe kugamba, mu abo bwe kwegatta nabo ne kubafuula omu), nange, Ayi Mukama, nnaakwatuliranga bwe ntyo, abantu balyoke bawulire, be siyinza kukakasa oba nga nkwatula mazima; naye bankkiriza, abo okwagala be kuggulira amatu gaabwe gye ndi.

Naye Ggwe, Omusawo wange ow’omunda ennyo, ntegeeza bulungi ebibala bye nnaakungula mu kukikola. Kubanga okwatula kw’ebibi byange eby’edda, bye wansonyiwa n’obibikka, olyoke ompe omukisa mu Ggwe, ng’okyusa emmeeme yange olw’Okukkiriza n’olwa Ssakalamentu lyo, bwe kusomebwa ne kuwulirwa, kuzuukusa omutima, guleme kwebaka mu kuggwaamu essuubi ne gugamba nti “Siyinza,” wabula guzuukuke mu kwagala okw’okusaasira kwo ne mu buwoomi bw’ekisa kyo, omunafu yenna mw’afuukira ow’amaanyi, bw’ategeera obunafu bwe ku bubwe olw’ekisa ekyo. Era abalungi basanyuka okuwulira ku bibi eby’edda eby’abo abaabiwonyezebwa kaakano, si lwa kuba nti bibi, wabula kubanga byaliwo naye kaakano tebikyaliwo. Kale bibala ki, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, omutima gwange gwe gukwatulira buli lunaku, nga gwesiga nnyo essuubi ly’okusaasira kwo okusinga obutaliiko musango bwagwo, bibala ki, nkwegayiridde, bye nfuna mu kwatulira n’abantu mu kitabo kino mu maaso go, bwe ndi kaakano, so si bwe nnali? Kubanga ebibala biri ebirala mbirabye era mbyogeddeko. Naye bwe ndi kaakano, mu kiseera kyennyini kye nkola okwatula kuno, bangi baagala okukimanya, abammanyi n’abatammanyi, abawulidde okuva gye ndi oba ebinkwatako; naye okutu kwabwe tekuli ku mutima gwange gye ndi, ne bwe mba ki. Kale baagala okumpulira nga njatula bwe ndi munda; eriiso lyabwe, wadde okutu kwabwe, wadde amagezi gaabwe gye bitayinza kutuuka; bakyagala, nga beetegefu okukkiriza—naye banaamanya? Kubanga okwagala, okubafuula abalungi, kubagamba nti mu kwatula kwange sirimba; era okwagala okwo okuli mu bo kunkkiriza.

Essuula IV

Naye bibala ki bye banaafuna mu kuwulira kino? Baagala okusanyukira wamu nange, bwe bawulira nga bwe nkusemberera okumpi, olw’ekirabo kyo? n’okunsabira, bwe banaawulira obuzito bwange bwe bunnemya ennyo? Abo be nnaabikkulira bwe ndi. Kubanga si kibala kitono, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, bangi okukwebaza ku lwaffe, era bangi okukwegayirira ku lwaffe. Omutima ogw’obwasseruganda gwagale mu nze ekyo ky’oyigiriza nti kisaana okwagalibwa, era gukungubagire mu nze ekyo ky’oyigiriza nti kisaana okukungubagirwa. Gubeere omutima ogw’obwasseruganda, so si ogw’omugwira, si ogw’abaana abagwira, ab’emimwa egyogera eby’obulimba, n’omukono gwabwe ogwa ddyo nga mukono gwa ddyo ogw’obutali butuukirivu, wabula omutima ogwo ogw’obwasseruganda, bwe gunsiima, gunsanyukira, ne bwe gutansiima, gunnakuwalira; kubanga ka gunsiime oba ka gutansiima, gunjagala. Abo be nnaabikkulira bwe ndi: banaassa ekikkaba olw’ebikolwa byange ebirungi, banaasinda olw’ebibi byange. Ebikolwa byange ebirungi bye by’otegeka, era bye birabo byo; ebibi byange bye byonoono byange, era ye nsala yo. Kale bassenga ekikkaba olw’ebimu, basindenga olw’ebirala; era ennyimba n’amaziga birinnye mu maaso go, nga biva mu mitima gya baganda bange, ebyoterezo byo. Era Ggwe, Ayi Mukama, sanyukira obubaane bwa yeekaalu yo entukuvu, onsaasire ng’okusaasira kwo okungi bwe kuli olw’erinnya lyo; era nga tolekulira ky’otandise, tuukiriza obutatuukirira bwange.

Kino kye kibala ky’okwatula kwange bwe ndi, so si bwe nnali: okukwatula kino, si mu maaso go wokka, mu kusanyuka okw’ekyama nga nkankana, ne mu nnaku ey’ekyama nga nnina essuubi; naye ne mu matu g’abaana b’abantu abakkiriza, abagabana nange essanyu lyange, era abagabana nange obulamu buno obufa, bannansi bannange, era abatambuze bannange, abaasooka okugenda, oba abagenda okugoberera, banywanyi bange mu kkubo. Abo be baweereza bo, baganda bange, b’oyagala okufuula batabani bo; bakama bange, b’ondagira okuweereza, bwe mba njagala okubeera omulamu naawe, ku bubwo. Naye Ekigambo kyo kino kyandibadde kitono singa kyalagira mu kwogera kwokka, ne kitasooka kukikola. Kino kale nkikola mu bikolwa ne mu bigambo, kino nkikola wansi w’ebiwaawaatiro byo; mu kabi akanene ennyo, singa emmeeme yange teyakkakkanyizibwa wansi wo mu biwaawaatiro byo, n’obunafu bwange ne butamanyibwa gy’Oli. Ndi mwana muto, naye Kitange abeera mulamu ennaku zonna, era Omukuumi wange ammala. Kubanga ye y’omu eyanzaala, era ankuuma: era Ggwe kennyini gwe bulungi bwange bwonna; Ggwe, Omuyinza w’ebintu byonna, ali nange, weewaawo, nga sinnaba kubeera naawe. Abo kale b’ondagira okuweereza be nnaabikkulira, si bwe nnali, wabula bwe ndi kaakano ne bwe nkyali. Naye nange sseesalira musango. Bwe ntyo kale bwe njagala okuwulirwa.

Essuula V

Kubanga Ggwe, Mukama, ggwe onsalira omusango: kubanga, newakubadde tewali muntu amanyi eby’omuntu, wabula omwoyo w’omuntu oyo ali mu ye, naye waliwo ekintu ekiri mu muntu, omwoyo w’omuntu oyo ali mu ye kye atamanyi ye kennyini. Naye Ggwe, Mukama, omumanyi wonna, Ggwe eyamukola. Naye nze, newakubadde mu maaso go neenyooma, ne neetwala okuba enfuufu n’evvu; kyokka mmanyiiko ekintu ku Ggwe, kye simanyi ku nze. Era mazima, kaakano tulaba ng’abali mu ndabirwamu eteraba bulungi, nga tetunnalaba maaso n’amaaso. Kale ebbanga lyonna lye mba ewala naawe, mbeera kumpi nange kennyini okusinga Ggwe; naye nkumanyi nti Ggwe toyinza kubonaabona mu ngeri yonna; naye nze, okukemebwa kwe nnyinza okugumira n’okwo kwe siyinza, simanyi. Era waliwo essuubi, kubanga oli mwesigwa, Ggwe atalituganya kukemebwa okusinga bwe tuyinza; naye ne mu kukemebwa onootuwa n’ekkubo ery’okukuwonamu, tulyoke tuyinze okukugumira. Kale nnaayatula kye mmanyi ku nze, era nnaayatula ne kye simanyi ku nze. Era kubanga kye mmanyi ku nze, nkimanyi kubanga ommulisizza; ne kye simanyi ku nze, sikimanya okutuusa ekizikiza kyange lwe kirifuuka ng’ettuntu mu maaso go.

Essuula VI

Si na kubuusabuusa, wabula n’okumanya okukakafu, kwe nkwagalamu, Mukama. Wakuba omutima gwange n’ekigambo kyo, ne nkwagala. Weewaawo n’eggulu, n’ensi, ne byonna ebirimu, laba, buli ludda bingamba okukwagala; era tebirekeraawo kukigamba eri bonna, balyoke baleme kubaako na kya kwewolereza. Naye okusingawo olisaasira oyo gw’olisaasira, era olikwatirwa ekisa oyo gwe wakwatirwa ekisa: bwe kitaba bwe kityo, eggulu n’ensi byogera ettendo lyo mu matu amaggale. Naye kiki kye njagala, bwe nkwagala? Si bulungi bwa mibiri, wadde okukwatagana okulungi okw’ebiseera, wadde okumasamasa kw’omusana, okusanyusa ennyo amaaso gaffe, wadde amaloboozi amawoomu ag’ennyimba ez’engeri nnyingi, wadde akaloosa akalungi ak’ebimuli, n’amafuta, n’ebyakaloosa, si maanu na mubisi gwa njuki, si bitundu by’omubiri ebisanyusa okuwambaatira kw’omubiri. Tewali na kimu ku ebyo kye njagala, bwe njagala Katonda wange; naye kyokka njagala ekika ky’omusana, n’eddoboozi, n’akaloosa, n’emmere, n’okuwambaatira, bwe njagala Katonda wange, omusana, eddoboozi, akaloosa, emmere, okuwambaatira kw’omuntu wange ow’omunda: emmeeme yange gy’eyakira ekyo ekifo kye kitayinza kugyamu, era gye kivugira ekyo ebiseera kye bitatwala, era gye kiwunyira ekyo omukka kye gutasaasaanya, era gye kiwoomera ekyo okulya kye kutakendeeza, era gye kyegattira ekyo okukkuta kye kutaawukanya. Ekyo kye njagala bwe njagala Katonda wange.

Era kino kiki? Nabuuza ensi, n’enziramu nti, “Si nze Ye”; ne byonna ebigirimu ne byatula bwe bityo. Nabuuza ennyanja n’obuziba, n’ebiramu ebyewalula, ne binziramu nti, “Tetuli Katonda wo, noonya waggulu waffe.” Nabuuza empewo etambula; empewo yonna n’ebigirimu ne binziramu nti, “Anaximenes yalimbibwa, si nze Katonda. “ Nabuuza eggulu, enjuba, omwezi, emmunyeenye, “Naffe (bwe bigamba) tetuli Katonda gw’onoonya.” Ne nziramu ebintu byonna ebyetoolodde enzigi z’omubiri gwange: “Mumbuulidde ku Katonda wange, nti si mmwe Ye; mumbuulireko ekintu ku Ye.” Ne bikaaba n’eddoboozi ery’omwanguka nti, “Ye yatukola. “ Okubibuuza kwange, kwali kulowooza kwange ku byo: n’obulungi bw’endabika yaabyo bwe bwali okuddamu. Ne nneekyukira nzekka, ne neegamba nti, “Oli ani?” Ne nziramu nti, “Ndi muntu.” Era laba, mu nze mwe mweyolekera gye ndi emmeeme n’omubiri, ekimu ebweru, ekirala munda. Mu kiruwa ku ebyo mwe nsaanira okunoonyeza Katonda wange? Nnali mmunoonyezza mu mubiri okuva ku nsi okutuuka ku ggulu, okutuuka ewala nga bwe nnali nsobola okutuma ababaka, ebimyanso by’amaaso gange. Naye ekisinga obulungi kye ky’omunda, kubanga gye kiri, ng’ekifuga era ekisala, ababaka bonna ab’omubiri gye baaleeta okuddamu kw’eggulu n’ensi, ne byonna ebibirimu, ebyagamba nti, “Tetuli Katonda, naye Ye yatukola.” Ebintu ebyo omuntu wange ow’omunda yabimanya olw’obuweereza bw’ow’ebweru: nze ow’omunda nabimanya; nze, amagezi, nga mpita mu by’okuwulira eby’omubiri gwange. Nabuuza ensi yonna nga bw’etondeddwa ku Katonda wange; n’enziramu nti, “Si nze Ye, naye Ye yankola.

Endabika eno ey’omubiri terabika eri bonna abalina obusobozi bw’okuwulira obutuukiridde? Kale lwaki teyogera bimu eri bonna? Ebisolo ebito n’ebinene bigiraba, naye tebiyinza kugibuuza: kubanga tewali magezi gateekeddwa waggulu w’obusobozi bwabyo obw’okuwulira okusala ku bye bubuulira. Naye abantu basobola okubuuza, ebintu bya Katonda ebitalabika bitegeerwe ne birabikira ddala mu bintu ebyakolebwa; naye olw’okubyagala, bafuuka abafugibwa byo: n’abafugibwa tebayinza kusala musango. So n’ebitonde tebiddamu abo ababibuuza, wabula nga basobola okusala; so tebikyusa ddoboozi lyabyo (kwe kugamba, endabika yaabyo), omuntu omu bw’alaba bulabi, omulala n’alaba n’abuuza, ne birabikira omu bwe biti, omulala bwe biti; wabula nga birabika kye kimu eri bombi, endabika esirika eri oyo, n’eyogera eri oli; weewaawo eyogera eri bonna; naye abategeera bokka be bageraageranya eddoboozi lyayo lye bafuna okuva ebweru, n’amazima ag’omunda. Kubanga amazima gaŋŋamba nti, “Eggulu, wadde ensi, wadde omubiri omulala gwonna si Katonda wo.” Kino, obutonde bwabyo bwennyini bukigamba eri oyo abiraba: “Biri kitole; ekitole kiba kitono mu kitundu kyakyo okusinga mu kyonna.” Kaakano gy’oli njogera, ayi emmeeme yange, ggwe kitundu kyange ekisinga obulungi: kubanga ggwe olamusa ekitole ky’omubiri gwange, ng’okiwa obulamu, omubiri bwe gutayinza kuwa mubiri munne: naye Katonda wo ye Bulamu bw’obulamu bwo ne gy’oli.

Essuula VII

Kale kiki kye njagala, bwe njagala Katonda wange? Ye ani oyo ali waggulu w’omutwe gw’emmeeme yange? Mu mmeeme yange yennyini mwe nnaalinnyira gy’Ali. Nnaasukka amaanyi ago agangatta n’omubiri gwange, ne gajjuza omubiri gwonna obulamu. So siyinza mu maanyi ago kuzuula Katonda wange; kubanga bwe kityo embalaasi oba ennyumbu ezitategeera zandimuzudde; kubanga ge maanyi ge gamu, emibiri gyazo nagyo mwe giramira. Naye waliwo amaanyi amalala, si ago gokka ge mpa obulamu, naye n’ago ge nteeka mu mubiri gwange obusobozi obw’okuwulira, Mukama gwe yantondera: ng’alagira eriiso obutawulira, n’okutu obutalaba; wabula eriiso, ndyoke ndabire mu lyo, n’okutu, ndyoke mpulire mu kwo; n’eri ebirala eby’okuwulira, buli kimu ekifo kyakyo n’omulimu gwakyo; ebyo, newakubadde nga byawukana, nze amagezi agamu, mbikoleramu. Nnaasukka ne ku maanyi gange gano; kubanga n’ago embalaasi n’ennyumbu zigalina, kubanga nazo ziwulira nga ziyita mu mubiri.

Essuula VIII

Kale nnaasukka ne ku maanyi gano ag’obutonde bwange, nga ndinnya mpolampola okutuuka gy’Ali eyankola. Ne ntuuka mu nnimiro ne mu mbiri engazi ez’okujjukira kwange, omuli eby’obugagga eby’ebifaananyi ebitabalika, ebyaleetebwamu okuva mu bintu eby’engeri zonna ebyategeerwa n’ebyokuwulira. Eyo mwe muterekeddwa buli kye tulowooza okwongereza ku ebyo, oba nga tubigaziya oba nga tubikendeeza, oba nga tukyusa mu ngeri endala yonna ebintu ebyo ebyokuwulira bye bituuseeko; ne buli kirala kyonna ekyateresebwa ne kiterekebwa, okwerabira kye kutannamira na kuziika. Bwe nnyingira omwo, nsaba ekyo kye njagala kireetebwe, ne wabaawo ekijja amangu ago; ebirala birina okunoonyezebwa okumala ebbanga, ne bireetebwa, ng’ebiggyibwa mu tterekero ery’omunda; ebirala bifubutuka mu bibinja, era nga waliwo ekintu ekirala ekyetaagibwa era ekinoonyezebwa, ne bibuuka mu maaso, ng’ebigamba nti, “Oba nze?” Ebyo mbigoba n’omukono gw’omutima gwange, okuva mu maaso g’okujjukira kwange; okutuusa ekyo kye njagala lwe kibikkulwa, ne kirabika, nga kiva mu kifo kyakyo eky’ekyama. Ebintu ebirala bijja mangu, mu nteekateeka etamenyese, nga bwe biyitibwa; ebiri mu maaso nga biwa ebbanga ebigoberera; era bwe biwa ebbanga, ne bikwekebwa amaaso, nga byetegefu okujja bwe ndibyagala. Ebyo byonna bibaawo bwe nnyiinyiza ekintu ku mutwe.

Eyo ebintu byonna mwe bikuumirwa nga byawuddwamu bulungi era nga bigabanyizibwamu ebika, buli kimu nga kyayingira mu kkubo lyakyo: ng’omusana, ne langi zonna n’endabika z’emibiri nga biyita mu maaso; mu matu amaloboozi ag’engeri zonna; evvumbe lyonna mu kkubo ly’ennyindo; obuwoomi bwonna mu kamwa; era mu kuwulira kw’omubiri gwonna, ekikakanyavu oba ekigonvu; ekyokya oba ekinnyogovu; oba ekikalubo; ekizito oba ekiwewuka; ebweru oba munda w’omubiri. Ebyo byonna omwalo ogwo omunene ogw’okujjukira gubyaniriza mu nkyukakyuka zaagwo ez’ekyama ezitabalika era ezitayogerekeka, bireetebwe era bifulumizibwe bwe byetaagibwa; buli kimu nga kiyingira mu mulyango gwakyo, ne kiterekebwa omwo. So ebintu byennyini tebiyingira; wabula ebifaananyi by’ebintu ebyategeerwa bye biba eyo nga byetegefu, ebirowoozo okubijjukira. Ebifaananyi ebyo, bwe bikolebwa, ani ayinza okukyogera, newakubadde nga kirabika lwatu mu kuwulira ki buli kimu mwe kyayingirira ne kiterekebwa? Kubanga ne bwe mba mu kizikiza ne mu kasirise, mu kujjukira kwange nsobola okufulumya langi, bwe njagala, ne njawula wakati w’enzirugavu n’enjeru, n’endala ze njagala: so n’amaloboozi tegeeyingiza ne gataataaganya ekifaananyi ekyayingizibwa amaaso gange, kye nneetegereza, newakubadde nago gali eyo, nga gagalamidde, era nga gaterekeddwa, ng’agali gokka. Kubanga nago ngayita, ne galabika amangu ago. Era newakubadde olulimi lwange lusirise, n’emimiro gyange giri kasirise, nsobola okuyimba nga bwe njagala; so ebifaananyi ebyo ebya langi, newakubadde nga biri eyo, tebyeyingiza ne bitaataaganya, nga wayitiddwa eggwanika eddala, eryayingira nga liyita mu matu. Bwe ntyo n’ebintu ebirala, ebyaleetebwamu ne bituumibwa n’ebyokuwulira ebirala, mbijjukira nga bwe njagala. Weewaawo, njawula evvumbe ly’amalanga n’erya vayoleti, newakubadde nga sirina kye mpunyiriza; era nsinza omubisi gw’enjuki okusinga envinnyo ewooma, ekiweweevu okusinga ekikalubo, mu kiseera ekyo nga siriiko kye ndega wadde kye nkwatako, wabula nga nzijukira bujjukizi.

Ebyo mbikolera munda, mu luggya olwo olugazi ennyo olw’okujjukira kwange. Kubanga eyo waliwo nange eggulu, ensi, ennyanja, ne buli kye nnali nsobola okulowoozaako omwo, okuggyako bye nneerabidde. Eyo era mwe nsisinkanira nzekka, ne nneejjukira, ne bwe nnakola, ne we nnakolera, ne kye nnakola, ne bwe nnali mpulira mu mutima. Eyo mwe muli byonna bye nzijukira, oba bye nnalaba nzekka, oba bye nnakkiriza ku bujulizi bw’abalala. Mu ggwanika lye limu mwe nzigya ebifaananyi ebipya n’ebipya eby’ebintu bye nnalaba, oba, okuva mu bye nnalaba, bye nnakkiriza, ne mbigatta n’eby’edda: era okuva awo ne ndowooza ku bikolwa, ebigenda okubaawo, n’essuubi ery’omu maaso, ne byonna ebyo ne mbirowoozaako nate, ng’ebiriwo kaakano. “Nnaakola kino oba kiri,” bwe ŋŋamba nze kennyini, mu tterekero eryo eddene ery’amagezi gange, eryajjula ebifaananyi by’ebintu ebingi bwe bityo era ebinene bwe bityo, “era kino oba kiri kirivaamu.” “Singa kino oba kiri kibaddewo!” “Katonda aziyize kino oba kiri!” Bwe ntyo bwe njogera nzekka: era bwe njogera, ebifaananyi by’ebyo byonna bye njogerako biba wo, nga biva mu ggwanika lye limu ery’okujjukira; so sandyogedde ku kimu ku byo, singa ebifaananyi tebyaliwo.

Amaanyi gano ag’okujjukira manene, manene nnyo ddala, Ayi Katonda wange; kisenge kigazi ekitaliiko kkomo! ani eyali atuuse ku ntobo yaakyo? naye gano maanyi gange, era gali mu butonde bwange; so nange sitegeera byonna bye ndi. N’olwekyo amagezi gafunze nnyo okwegyamu gokka. Kale ekyo kyandibadde wa, kye gatayinza kwegyamu? Kiri bweru waago, so si munda? kale lwaki tegeetegeera gokka? Okwewuunya okw’ekitalo kunkwata, era nsamaalirira olw’ekyo. Era abantu bagenda ewala okwewuunya obuwanvu bw’ensozi, amayengo amanene ag’ennyanja, amazzi amagazi ag’emigga, obugazi bw’oguyanja, n’entambula y’emmunyeenye, ne beebuusa amaaso bo bennyini; so tebeewuunya nti bwe nnayogera ku bintu bino byonna, saabiraba na maaso gange, naye sandisobodde kubyogerako, wabula nga mu kiseera ekyo ndaba ddala ensozi, amayengo, emigga, emmunyeenye bye nnali ndabye, n’oguyanja gwe nzikiriza nti guliwo, munda mu kujjukira kwange, era nga birina amabanga ge gamu amagazi wakati waabyo, nga bwe nnandibirabye ebweru. Naye saabiyingiza mu nze nga mbiraba, bwe nnabitunuulira n’amaaso gange; so tebiri nange byennyini, wabula ebifaananyi byabyo byokka. Era mmanyi okuwulira ki okw’omubiri buli kimu kwe kyayitamu okunteekebwamu.

Essuula IX

Naye si bino byokka obusobozi bw’okujjukira kwange obutapimika bwe bukuuma. Wano era waliwo byonna bye nnayiga mu by’amagezi ag’obuyigirize obw’enjawulo, ebitannaba kwerabirwa; nga byasengulwa ng’ebiteekeddwa mu kifo eky’omunda, so nga si kifo: so si bifaananyi byabyo, wabula ebintu byennyini. Kubanga, okumanya ebiwandiiko kye ki, okumanya okuwakana kye ki, ebika by’ebibuuzo bimeka, buli kye mmanyi ku ebyo, kibeera mu kujjukira kwange mu ngeri nti saakwata kifaananyi kyokka ne ndeka ekintu, oba nti kyavuga ne kiggwaawo ng’eddoboozi eryanywezebwa ku kutu olw’akabonero ako, mwe liyinza okujjukirwa, nga likyavuga, so nga terikyavuga; oba ng’akaloosa bwe kayitawo ne kabuuka mu mpewo ne kakwata ku kuwunyiriza, olwo ne kateeka mu kujjukira ekifaananyi kyako, kye tuzza obuggya nga tukijjukira; oba ng’emmere, mazima mu lubuto eteekyalina buwoomi, naye mu kujjukira ekyawooma mu ngeri emu; oba ng’ekintu kyonna omubiri kye guwulira nga gukikwatako, era nga kiggyiddwa gye tuli, okujjukira ne kukyakifaanaanya. Kubanga ebintu ebyo tebiyingizibwa mu kujjukira, wabula ebifaananyi byabyo byokka bye bikwatibwa n’embiro ez’ekitalo, ne biterekebwa ng’ebiri mu bisenge eby’ekitalo, ne biva omwo mu ngeri ey’ekitalo olw’okujjukira.

Essuula X

Naye kaakano bwe mpulira nti waliwo ebika by’ebibuuzo bisatu, “Ekintu kiriwo? kye ki? kiri kya ngeri ki? Mazima nkuuma ebifaananyi by’amaloboozi ebigambo ebyo mwe byakolebwa, era mmanyi nti amaloboozi ago, nga gawuuma, gaayita mu mpewo, era kaakano tegakyaliwo. Naye ebintu byennyini amaloboozi ago bye gategeeza, sibituukangako na kuwulira kwonna okw’omubiri gwange, so sibirabangako mu ngeri ndala wabula mu magezi gange; naye mu kujjukira kwange saaterekamu bifaananyi byabyo, wabula byo byennyini. Bwe byayingira mu nze, bigambe bwe bisobola; kubanga ntambudde mu makubo gonna ag’omubiri gwange, naye siyinza kuzuula kkubo lye byayingiriramu. Kubanga amaaso gagamba nti, “Singa ebifaananyi ebyo byalina langi, twabibuulirako.” Amatu gagamba nti, “Singa bivuga, twabitegeezaako.” Ennyindo zigamba nti, “Singa biwunya, byatuyitako.” Olulimi lugamba nti, “Bwe biba tebirina buwoomi, tombuuza.” Okukwatako kugamba nti, “Bwe kiba tekirina bunene, saakikwatako; bwe saakikwatako, saakitegeezaako.” Ebintu bino byayingira wa era bitya mu kujjukira kwange? Simanyi bwe byayingira. Kubanga bwe nnabiyiga, saakkiriza magezi ga muntu mulala, wabula nnabitegeera mu gange; era bwe nnabisiima nti bya mazima, ne mbikwasa go, nga mbitereka, nsobole okubifulumya bwe nnaabyagala. Kale byali mu mutima gwange, ne nga sinnaba kubiyiga, naye nga tebiri mu kujjukira kwange. Kale byali wa? oba lwaki, bwe byayogerwa, nnabikkiriza, ne ŋŋamba nti, “Bwe kiri, kya mazima,” wabula nga byali dda mu kujjukira, naye nga byasindikibwa emabega ne biziikibwa mu bunnya obw’omunda ennyo, nga singa omulala teyabijjukiza n’abifulumya, oboolyawo nnandibadde sisobola kubirowoozaako?

Essuula XI

Kale tukizuula nti okuyiga ebintu ebyo bye tutafuna ng’ebifaananyi okuyita mu biwulizi byaffe, wabula bye tutegeerera munda nga bwe biri ku bwabyo, awatali bifaananyi, si kirala wabula, mu kulowooza, okubikuŋŋaanya, era mu kubissaako omwoyo, okufaayo ebintu ebyo okujjukira bye kwalina edda nga bisaasaanidde era nga tebitegekeddwa, biteekebwe awo ng’ebiri ku mukono mu kujjukira okwo kwennyini mwe byali bigalamidde edda nga tebimanyiddwa, nga bisaasaanidde era nga tebifiibwako, bwe bityo ne bijjanga mangu mu birowoozo ebimaze okubimanyiira. Era ebintu bimeka eby’engeri eyo okujjukira kwange bye kusitula ebyazuulibwa dda, era nga bwe njogedde, ne biteekebwa ng’ebiri ku mukono, bye tugambibwa nti twabiyiga era ne tubimanya; bye nandirekedde okujjukira okumala akaseera akatono, byandiddamu okuziikibwa bwe bityo, ne biseeyeeyera, ng’olwo, mu bisenge eby’omunda ennyo, ne kiba nti biteekwa nate, ng’ebipya, okulowoozebwako okubiggyayo eyo, kubanga tebirina kifo kirala kye bibeeramu: naye biteekwa okuddamu okukuŋŋaanyizibwa, biryoke bimanyibwe; kwe kugamba, biteekwa okukuŋŋaanyizibwa awamu okuva gye byasaasaanira: era eyo ekigambo “cogitation” we kyava. Kubanga cogo (kuŋŋaanya) ne cogito (ddamu okukuŋŋaanya) birina enkolagana y’emu ng’eya ago ne agito, facio ne factito. Naye ebirowoozo bikiwambye ekigambo kino (cogitation) ne kifuuka kyabyo, ne kiba nti, si buli ekiba “kikuŋŋaanyiziddwa” mu ngeri yonna, wabula ekiba “kiddamu okukuŋŋaanyizibwa,” kwe kugamba, ekireetebwa awamu mu birowoozo, kye kigambibwa mu butuufu nti kifumiitirizibwako, oba kirowoozebwako.

Essuula XII

Okujjukira era kulimu amagezi n’amateeka agatabalika ag’emiwendo n’ebipimo, nga tewali na kimu ku byo ekiwulizi kyonna eky’omubiri kye kyakiteekako akabonero; kubanga tebirina langi, newakubadde eddoboozi, newakubadde obuwoomi, newakubadde akawoowo, newakubadde okukwatibwako. Mpulidde eddoboozi ly’ebigambo ebibyogerwako nga bikubaganyizibwako ebirowoozo: naye amaloboozi galala n’ebintu birala. Kubanga amaloboozi mu Luyonaani galala ne mu Lulatini galala; naye ebintu si bya Luyonaani, si bya Lulatini, era si bya lulimi lulala lwonna. Ndabye ennyiriri abazimbi ze bakuba, ezisinga obutono, ng’ewuzi ya nnabbubi; naye ezo za njawulo, si bifaananyi by’ennyiriri eriiso ery’omubiri ze lyandaga: azimanyi buli azitegeerera munda mu ye, awatali kulowooza ku mubiri gwonna gwonna. Era ntegedde n’ebiwulizi byonna eby’omubiri gwange emiwendo gy’ebintu bye tubala; naye emiwendo egyo gye tubalisa gya njawulo, era si bifaananyi by’egyo, n’olwekyo gyo giriwo ddala. Oyo atagiraba ansekerere olw’okwogera ebintu bino, nange nnaamusaasira, ng’ansekerera.

Essuula XIII

Ebyo byonna mbijjukira, era bwe nnabiyiga nkijjukira. Era mpulidde ebintu bingi ebyabiwakanyizibwako mu bulimba obw’amaanyi ennyo, era mbijjukira; era newakubadde nga bya bulimba, si bulimba nti mbijjukira; era nzijukira nti nnayawula wakati w’amazima ago n’obulimba buno obwabiwakanyizibwako. Era ntegeera nti okwawula ebintu bino kaakano kwa njawulo ku kujjukira nti emirundi mingi nnabyawula, bwe nnabirowoozangako emirundi mingi. Kale nzijukira nti emirundi mingi nnategeera ebintu bino; era kye njawula kaakano ne kye ntegeera, nkitereka mu kujjukira kwange, oluvannyuma ndyoke nzijukire nti nkitegeera kaakano. Bwe kityo era nzijukira nti nnajjukira; nga bwe kiri nti oluvannyuma bwe ndijjukira nti kaakano nsobodde okujjukira ebintu bino, ndikijjukira olw’amaanyi g’okujjukira.

Essuula XIV

Okujjukira okwo kwe kumu kulimu n’enneewulira z’ebirowoozo byange, si mu ngeri ebirowoozo byennyini gye bizirimu, nga biziwulira; wabula mu ngeri ya njawulo nnyo, okusinziira ku maanyi gaakwo kwokka. Kubanga awatali kusanyuka nzijukira nti nnasanyuka; era awatali nnaku nzijukira ennaku yange eyayita. Era nti nnatya, nkirowoozaako awatali kutya; era awatali kwegomba nzijukira okwegomba okwayita. Oluusi, ku ludda olulala, nzijukira n’essanyu ennaku yange ey’edda, n’essanyu ery’edda nga ndi mu nnaku. Kino si kya kwewuunyisa ku bikwata ku mubiri; kubanga ebirowoozo kintu kimu, n’omubiri kirala. Kale bwe nzijukira n’essanyu obulumi bw’omubiri obwayita, si kya kwewuunyisa nnyo. Naye kaakano olw’okuba okujjukira kwennyini bye birowoozo (kubanga bwe tukwasa omuntu ekintu okukikuuma mu kujjukira, tugamba nti, “Laba nga okikuuma mu birowoozo”; ne bwe twerabira, tugamba nti, “Tekyajja mu birowoozo byange,” era nti, “Kyava mu birowoozo byange,” nga tuyita okujjukira kwennyini ebirowoozo); bwe kiri bwe kityo, kiba kitya nti bwe nzijukira n’essanyu ennaku yange eyayita, ebirowoozo birina essanyu, okujjukira kulina ennaku; ebirowoozo nga bisanyuka olw’essanyu eribirimu, naye okujjukira, olw’ennaku eri mu kwo, ne kutanakuwala? Oba okujjukira oboolyawo si kwa birowoozo? Ani anaakyogera? Kale okujjukira kuli, ng’olwo, ng’olubuto lw’ebirowoozo, n’essanyu n’ennaku biri ng’emmere ewooma n’ekaawa; bwe bikwasibwa okujjukira, biba ng’ebiyise ne biyingira mu lubuto, gye biyinza okuterekebwa, naye ne bitawoomerwa. Kya kusekererwa okulowooza nti bino bifaanagana; naye era tebyawukanira ddala.

Naye, laba, nkiggya mu kujjukira kwange, bwe ŋŋamba nti waliwo okutabulwa kw’ebirowoozo kuna: okwegomba, essanyu, okutya, n’ennaku; era kyonna kye nsobola okukubaganyako ebirowoozo ku byo, nga njawulamu buli kimu mu biika byakyo ebitono, era nga nkinnyonnyola, kye nnaayogera nkisanga mu kujjukira kwange, era eyo gye nkiggya: naye ate sitabulwa na kimu ku kutabulwa okwo, bwe mbijjukira nga mbizza mu birowoozo; weewaawo, era nga sinnabizza na kubikomyawo, byali eyo; n’olwekyo byasobola, olw’okujjukira, okuggibwayo. Oboolyawo, kale, nga emmere bw’ezzibwayo okuva mu lubuto n’eddamu okugaaywa, bwe bityo ne bino bwe biggibwa mu kujjukira olw’okujjukira. Kale lwaki oyo akubaganya ebirowoozo, ng’ajjukira bw’atyo, tawoomerwa mu kamwa k’okufumiitiriza kwe obuwoomi bw’essanyu, oba obukaawu bw’ennaku? Oba ekyokulabirako kino tekifaanagana mu kino, kubanga tekifaanagana mu byonna? Kubanga ani yandyagadde okubyogerako, singa buli lwe twogera ku nnaku oba ku kutya, twandiwalirizibwa okunakuwala oba okutya? Naye era tetwandisobodde kubyogerako, singa tetwasanga mu kujjukira kwaffe, si maloboozi ga mannya gokka okusinziira ku bifaananyi ebiteekebwamu ebiwulizi by’omubiri, wabula n’endowooza ku bintu byennyini bye tutaafuna mu kkubo lyonna ery’omubiri, naye ebirowoozo byennyini bye byategeera olw’okulaba ku ebyo bye byayitamu, ne bibikwasa okujjukira, oba okujjukira ne kubikuuma kwokka nga tekubikwasiddwa.

Essuula XV

Naye oba nga lwa bifaananyi oba si bwe kityo, ani ayinza okukyogera amangu? Bwe ntyo, njogera ku jjinja, njogera ku njuba, ebintu byennyini nga tebiri mu maaso g’ebiwulizi byange, wabula ebifaananyi byabyo nga biri mu kujjukira kwange. Njogera ku bulumi bw’omubiri, naye nga tebuli nange, nga tewali kinnuma: naye singa ekifaananyi kyabwo tekyali mu kujjukira kwange, sandimanye kye nnaayogera ku bwo, newakubadde okwawula obulumi ku kunyumirwa nga njogera. Njogera ku bulamu bw’omubiri; nga ndi mulamu ku mubiri, ekintu kyennyini kiri nange; naye singa n’ekifaananyi kyakyo tekyali mu kujjukira kwange, sandisobodde n’akatono okujjukira eddoboozi ly’erinnya lino kye litegeeza. Era abalwadde, obulamu bwe bwandyogeddwako, tebanditegedde ekyogeddwa, singa ekifaananyi ekyo kyennyini tekyakuumibwa olw’amaanyi g’okujjukira, newakubadde ekintu kyennyini nga tekiri mu mubiri. Njogera ku miwendo gye tubalisa; era si bifaananyi byagyo, wabula gyo gyennyini giri mu kujjukira kwange. Njogera ku kifaananyi ky’enjuba, era ekifaananyi ekyo kiri mu kujjukira kwange. Kubanga sijjukira kifaananyi ky’ekifaananyi kyayo, wabula ekifaananyi kyennyini kiri nange, nga nkijjukira. Njogera ku kujjukira, era ntegeera kye njogerako. Era nkitegeerera wa, okuggyako mu kujjukira kwennyini? Era nakwo kuli eri kwo kwennyini olw’ekifaananyi kyakwo, so si ku bwakwo?

Essuula XVI

Kale bwe njogera ku kwerabira, era ne ntegeera kye njogerako? nnyinza ntya okukitegeera, singa saali nkijjukira? Siyogera ku ddoboozi ly’erinnya, wabula ku kintu kye litegeeza: singa nnali nkyerabidde, sandisobodde kutegeera ddoboozi eryo kye litegeeza. Kale bwe nzijukira okujjukira, okujjukira kwennyini kuba kuli eri kwo kwennyini, okuyita mu kwo kwennyini: naye bwe nzijukira okwerabira, wabaawo byombi okujjukira n’okwerabira; okujjukira kwe nzijukiza, n’okwerabira kwe nzijukira. Naye okwerabira kye ki, okuggyako okubulwa okujjukira? Kale kubaawo kutya ne nkujjukira, ng’ate bwe kubaawo sisobola kujjukira? Naye obanga kye tujjukira tukikuuma mu kujjukira, era nga, singa tetwali tujjukira kwerabira, tetwandisobodde n’akatono, nga tuwulira erinnya, okutegeera ekintu kye litegeeza, kale okwerabira kukuumibwa okujjukira. Kale kubaawo, tuleme kwerabira, ate bwe kubaawo, twerabira. Kino kiraga nti okwerabira, bwe tukujjukira, tekuba mu kujjukira ku bwakwo wabula olw’ekifaananyi kyakwo: kubanga singa kwali kuliwo ku bwakwo, tekwanditujjukizza, wabula kwanditwerabizza. Kale ani alikinoonyereza kino? ani alitegeera bwe kiri?

Mukama, nze, mazima, nteganira mu kino, weewaawo nteganira mu nze nzennyini; nfuuse ettaka ezzibu eryetaaga entuuyo ez’omu kyenyi ennyingi ennyo. Kubanga kaakano tetunoonyereza bitundu bya ggulu, oba okupima amabanga g’emmunyeenye, oba okubuuza ku ngeri ensi gy’etebenkeramu. Nze nzennyini nze nzijukira, nze ebirowoozo. Si kya kwewuunyisa nnyo, singa ekyo kye siri kiri wala nange. Naye kiki ekiri okumpi nange okusinga nze nzennyini? Era laba, amaanyi g’okujjukira kwange sigategeera; newakubadde nga sisobola na kwogera ku linnya lyange awatali kwo. Kubanga nnaayogera ki, nga kiri kyeyoleefu gye ndi nti nzijukira okwerabira? Nnaagamba nti ekyo tekiri mu kujjukira kwange, kye nzijukira? oba nnaagamba nti okwerabira kuli mu kujjukira kwange olw’ensonga eno, nneme okwerabira? Byombi biba bya busirusiru nnyo. Kkubo ki ery’okusatu eririwo? Nnyinza ntya okugamba nti ekifaananyi ky’okwerabira kye kikuumibwa okujjukira kwange, so si okwerabira kwennyini, bwe nkujjukira? Era nnyinza ntya n’okukyogera, ng’olaba bwe kiri nti ekifaananyi ky’ekintu kyonna bwe kiteekebwa mu kujjukira, ekintu kyennyini kiteekwa okusooka okubaawo, ekifaananyi ekyo mwe kinaggibwa okuteekebwamu? Kubanga bwe ntyo bwe nzijukira Carthage, bwe ntyo ebifo byonna bye nnabeeramu, bwe ntyo amaaso g’abantu be nnalaba, n’ebintu ebireetebwa ebiwulizi ebirala; bwe ntyo obulamu oba obulwadde bw’omubiri. Kubanga ebintu bino bwe byali biriwo, okujjukira kwange kwafuna okuva gye biri ebifaananyi, bye nnali nsobola, nga biri nange, okutunuulira n’okubizza mu birowoozo byange, bwe nnabijjukiranga nga tebiriwo. Kale obanga okwerabira kuno kukuumibwa mu kujjukira olw’ekifaananyi kyakwo, so si ku bwakwo, olwo kyeyoleka nti kwo kwennyini kwaliwo edda, ekifaananyi kyakwo kiryoke kiggibwe. Naye bwe kwaliwo, kwawandiika kutya ekifaananyi kyakwo mu kujjukira, ng’olaba okwerabira olw’okubaawo kwakwo kusangula n’ebyo bye kusanga nga byamala okuwandiikibwa? Naye era, mu ngeri yonna, newakubadde engeri eyo nga tesobola kulowoozebwa wadde okunnyonnyolwa, naye nkakasa nti nzijukira n’okwerabira kwennyini, okusangula bye tujjukira.

Essuula XVII

Amaanyi g’okujjukira mangi, kintu kya kutiisa, Ayi Katonda wange, obungi obw’engeri ez’enjawulo obuwanvu era obutaliiko kkomo; era ekintu kino bye birowoozo, era kino nze nzennyini. Kale ndi ki, Ayi Katonda wange? Ndi wa butonde ki? Obulamu obw’enjawulo era obw’engeri nnyingi, era obunene ennyo okukamala. Laba mu nsenyi, ne mu mpuku, ne mu binnya eby’okujjukira kwange, ebitabalika era nga bijjudde mu ngeri etabalika ebika by’ebintu ebitabalika, oba okuyita mu bifaananyi, ng’emibiri gyonna; oba nga biriwo ddala, ng’amagezi ag’emikono; oba okuyita mu ndowooza oba obubonero obumu, ng’enneewulira z’ebirowoozo, okujjukira bye kukuuma ne bwe biba nga ebirowoozo tebiziwulira, so nga buli ekiri mu kujjukira kiba ne mu birowoozo—mu ebyo byonna mwe nziruka, mwe mbuuka; mbbira eruuyi n’eruuyi, nga bwe nsobola, era tewali nkomerero. Amaanyi g’okujjukira bwe gali amangi bwe gatyo, n’amaanyi g’obulamu bwe gali amangi bwe gatyo, ne mu bulamu bw’omuntu obufa. Kale nnaakola ki, Ayi Ggwe obulamu bwange obw’amazima, Katonda wange? Ndiyita ne ku maanyi gange gano agayitibwa okujjukira: weewaawo, ndigayitako, ndyoke nkusemberere Ggwe, Ayi Musana omuwoomu. Ongamba ki? Laba, nninnya okuyita mu birowoozo byange nga ŋŋenda gy’Oli, Ggwe abeera waggulu wange. Weewaawo, kaakano ndiyita ku maanyi gange gano agayitibwa okujjukira, nga njagala okutuuka gy’Oli, eyo gy’oyinza okutuukibwako; n’okukwegattako, eyo omuntu gy’ayinza okukwegattirako. Kubanga n’ensolo n’ebinyonyi birina okujjukira; bwe kitaba bwe kityo tebyandisobodde kuddayo mu bunnya bwabyo ne mu bisu byabyo, newakubadde mu bintu ebirala bingi bye bimanyiira: era tebyandisobodde kumanyiira kintu kyonna, okuggyako olw’okujjukira. Kale ndiyita ne ku kujjukira, ndyoke ntuuke eri Oyo eyanjawula ku nsolo ez’amagulu ana n’anfuula omugezi okusinga ebinyonyi eby’omu bbanga; ndiyita ne ku kujjukira, era ndikusanga wa, Ggwe obuwoomi obulungi ddala era obukakafu? Era ndikusanga wa? Bwe ndikusanga ebweru w’okujjukira kwange, olwo sikukuuma mu kujjukira kwange. Era ndikusanga ntya, bwe siba nkujjukira?

Essuula XVIII

Kubanga omukazi eyabula ennoso ye, n’aginoonya ng’akoleezezza ettaala, singa teyagijjukira, teyandigizudde. Kubanga bwe yagizuula, yandimanye atya oba nga y’emu, singa teyagijjukira? Nzijukira nti nnanoonya era ne nzuula ebintu bingi; era kino kye kindaga, nti bwe nnabanga nnoonya kyonna ku byo, ne mbuuzibwa nti, “Kye kino?” “Kye kiri?” nnagambanga nti “Nedda,” okutuusa ekyo kye nnali nnoonya lwe kyandeetebwanga. Ekyo singa saakijjukira (kyonna kye kyali) newakubadde nga kyandeetebwa, sandikizudde, kubanga sandisobodde kukitegeera. Era bwe kityo bwe kiri bulijjo, bwe tunoonya ne tuzuula ekintu kyonna ekibuze. Naye, ekintu kyonna bwe kibula mu maaso mu butanwa, so si mu kujjukira (ng’omubiri gwonna ogulabika), ekifaananyi kyakyo kiba kikyakuumibwa munda, era kinoonyezebwa okutuusa lwe kikomezebwawo mu maaso; era bwe kizuulibwa, kitegeerebwa olw’ekifaananyi ekiri munda: era tetugamba nti tuzudde ekyabula, okuggyako nga tukitegedde; era tetuyinza kukitegeera, okuggyako nga tukijjukira. Naye kino kyali kibuze ku maaso, naye nga kikuumiddwa mu kujjukira.

Essuula XIX

Naye kiba kitya okujjukira kwennyini bwe kubuza ekintu, nga bwe kibaawo bwe twerabira ne tunoonya tulyoke tujjukire? Ku nkomerero tunoonyeza wa, okuggyako mu kujjukira kwennyini? era eyo, singa oboolyawo ekintu kimu kituweebwa mu kifo ky’ekirala, tukigaana, okutuusa ekyo kye tunoonya lwe kitusanga; era bwe kitusanga, tugamba nti, “Kye kino”; kye tutandyogedde singa tetwakitegedde, so tetwandikitegedde singa tetwakijjukira. Mazima kale twali tukyerabidde. Oba, kyonna tekyali kitubuze, wabula olw’ekitundu kye twali tukyakutte, ekitundu ekibuze kye kyanoonyezebwa; olw’okuba okujjukira kwawulira nti tekwali kutambuza wamu byonna bye kwali kumanyidde, era, ng’okulemaziddwa, olw’okusalibwako ku mpisa yaakwo ey’edda, ne kusaba okuddizibwa ekyo kye kwali kubulwa? Ng’ekyokulabirako, bwe tulaba oba bwe tulowooza ku muntu gwe tumanyi, ne twerabira erinnya lye, ne tugezaako okulijjukira; buli kirala ekijja tekyegatta naye; kubanga tekyali kimanyiddwa kulowoozebwako wamu naye, n’olwekyo kigaanibwa, okutuusa ekyo lwe kijja, okumanya kwe kuwummulirako obulungi ng’ekintu kye kumanyidde. Era ekyo kiva wa, okuggyako mu kujjukira kwennyini? kubanga ne bwe tukitegeera, nga tukijjukiziddwa omulala, eyo gye kiva. Kubanga tetukikkiriza ng’ekintu ekipya, wabula, nga tukijjukidde, tukkiriza nti ekyogeddwa kye kituufu. Naye singa kyali kisanguddwa ddala mu birowoozo, tetwandikijjukidde, ne bwe twandijjukiziddwa. Kubanga tetunnaba kwerabira ddala ekyo kye tujjukira nti twakyerabira. Kale kye twerabidde ddala, newakubadde nga kibuze, tetuyinza na kukinoonya.

Essuula XX

Kale nkunoonya ntya, Ayi Mukama? Kubanga bwe nkunoonya, Katonda wange, nnoonya obulamu obw’essanyu. Ndikunoonya, emmeeme yange ebeere nnamu. Kubanga omubiri gwange gubeera mulamu lwa mmeeme yange; n’emmeeme yange ebeera nnamu lwa Ggwe. Kale nnoonya ntya obulamu obw’essanyu, ng’olaba sibulina, okutuusa lwe ndisobola okugamba, we kinsaanira okukyogera, nti “Kimala”? Nnoonya ntya? Olw’okujjukira, ng’abadde nkyerabidde, nga nzijukira nti nnali nkyerabidde? Oba, nga njagala okubuyiga ng’ekintu ekitamanyiddwa, oba nga sibumanyangako, oba nga nnabwerabira bwe ntyo ne kiba nti sijjukira na kuba nti nnabwerabira? obulamu obw’essanyu si bwe bwagala bonna, era tewali n’omu atabwagala n’akatono? baabumanyira wa, ne babwagala bwe batyo? baabulabira wa, ne babwagala bwe batyo? Mazima tubulina, naye mu ngeri ki, simanyi. Weewaawo, waliwo engeri endala, omuntu bw’abulina, olwo n’aba wa ssanyu; era waliwo abalina omukisa, mu ssuubi. Bano babulina mu ngeri eya wansi, okusinga abo ababulina ddala mu kikolwa; naye bali bulungi okusinga abo abatali ba ssanyu wadde mu kikolwa wadde mu ssuubi. Naye ne bano, singa tebaabulina mu ngeri emu, tebandyagadde nnyo bwe batyo kuba ba ssanyu; era nti bakyagala, kikakafu ddala. Kale baabumanya, simanyi bwe baabumanya, era bwe batyo babulina olw’okumanya okumu, simanyi kwa ngeri ki, era mbuusabuusa oba nga buli mu kujjukira; obanga bwe kiri, olwo twali ba ssanyu edda; oba nga buli muntu ku bubwe, oba mu muntu oli eyasooka okwonoona, mwe twafiira ffenna, era gwe twazaalibwako ffenna n’ennaku, kino sikibuuza kaakano; wabula kyokka, oba nga obulamu obw’essanyu buli mu kujjukira? Kubanga tetwandibwagadde, singa tetwabumanya. Tuwulira erinnya, era ffenna twatula nti twegomba ekintu; kubanga tetusanyusibwa ddoboozi lyokka. Kubanga Omuyonaani bw’aliwulira mu Lulatini, tasanyuka, kubanga tamanyi kyogeddwa; naye ffe Abalatini tusanyuka, nga naye bwe yandisanyuse, singa yaliwulira mu Luyonaani; kubanga ekintu kyennyini si kya Luyonaani newakubadde kya Lulatini, Abayonaani n’Abalatini, n’abantu ab’ennimi endala zonna kye beegomba ennyo bwe batyo. Kale kimanyiddwa bonna, kubanga singa babuuzibwa n’eddoboozi limu nti “bandyagadde okuba ab’essanyu?” bandizzeemu awatali kubuusabuusa nti “bandyagadde.” Era kino tekyandisobose, okuggyako nga ekintu kyennyini erinnya lyakyo kye litegeeza kikuumibwa mu kujjukira kwabwe.

Essuula XXI

Naye kiri bwe kityo, ng’omuntu bw’ajjukira Carthage eyagiraba? Nedda. Kubanga obulamu obw’essanyu tebulabibwa na liiso, kubanga si mubiri. Kale nga bwe tujjukira emiwendo? Nedda. Kubanga gino, oyo agirina mu kumanya kwe, tanoonya kweyongera kugituukako; naye obulamu obw’essanyu tubulina mu kumanya kwaffe, era kyetuva tubwagala, era naye ne tukyegomba okubutuukako, tulyoke tube ab’essanyu. Kale nga bwe tujjukira obwogezi? Nedda. Kubanga newakubadde nga bwe bawulira erinnya lino, abamu bajjukira ekintu, so nga tebannaba kuba bogezi balungi, era bangi abaagala okuba bwe batyo, kwe kulaga nti kiri mu kumanya kwabwe; naye bano baalaba n’ebiwulizi byabwe eby’omubiri abalala nga bogezi balungi, ne basanyuka, era beegomba okufaanana bwe batyo (newakubadde nga mazima tebandisanyuse okuggyako olw’okumanya okumu okw’omunda ku kyo, era tebandyegombye kufaanana bwe batyo, okuggyako nga basanyuse bwe batyo); so nga obulamu obw’essanyu, tetubuwulira mu balala na kiwulizi kyonna eky’omubiri. Kale nga bwe tujjukira essanyu? Oboolyawo; kubanga essanyu lyange ndijjukira, ne bwe mba nga nnakuwadde, ng’obulamu obw’essanyu, nga sirina ssanyu; era sirabanga, siwulirangako, sinuusanga, siwoomyangako, wadde okukwatako essanyu lyange n’ekiwulizi eky’omubiri; naye nnalifunira mu birowoozo byange, bwe nnasanyuka; era okulimanya ne kunywerera mu kujjukira kwange, ne kiba nti nsobola okulijjukira oluusi n’okwenyinyala, ate oluusi n’okwegomba, okusinziira ku butonde bw’ebintu, bye nzijukira nti nnasanyukiramu. Kubanga ne mu bintu eby’obugwagwa nnabbira mu ssanyu erimu; lye kaakano bwe ndijjukira, ndikyawa era ndikolimira; ate oluusi mu bintu ebirungi era eby’ekitiibwa, bye nzijukira n’okwegomba, newakubadde oboolyawo nga tebikyaliwo; era n’olwekyo nzijukira n’ennaku essanyu ery’edda.

Kale nnafunira wa era ddi obulamu bwange obw’essanyu, ndyoke mbujjukire, mbwagale, era mbwegombe? So si nze nzekka, oba abalala abatonotono, wabula ffenna twandyagadde okuba ab’essanyu; kye tutandyegombye n’okwagala okukakafu bwe kutyo, singa tetwakimanya olw’okumanya okumu okukakafu. Naye kino kiri kitya, nti singa abantu babiri babuuzibwa oba nga bandyagadde okugenda mu ntalo, omu, oboolyawo, yandizzeemu nti yandyagadde, omulala nti teyandyagadde; naye singa babuuzibwa oba nga bandyagadde okuba ab’essanyu, bombi bandigambye amangu ago awatali kubuusabuusa nti bandyagadde; era omu yandigenze mu ntalo, n’omulala n’atagenda, si lwa nsonga ndala, wabula okuba ab’essanyu. Oboolyawo kiri nti ng’omu bw’anoonya essanyu lye mu kintu kino, omulala mu kiri, bonna bakkiriziganya mu kwegomba kwabwe okuba ab’essanyu, nga bwe bandigambye (singa babuuzibwa) nti baagala okuba n’essanyu, era essanyu lino ne baliyita obulamu obw’essanyu? Kale newakubadde ng’omu afuna essanyu lino mu ngeri emu, omulala mu ndala, bonna balina ekigendererwa kimu, kye bafuba okutuukako, kwe kugamba, essanyu. Era olw’okuba kino kintu bonna kye bateekwa okugamba nti baakiyitamu, kye kiva kisangibwa mu kujjukira, era ne kitegeerebwa buli lwe boogera ku linnya ly’obulamu obw’essanyu.

Essuula XXII

Kibe wala, Mukama, kibe wala n’omutima gw’omuweereza wo akwatulira wano, kibe wala, nti, essanyu ka libe lyonna lye liba, nneerowoozanga okuba ow’essanyu olw’ekyo. Kubanga waliwo essanyu eritaweebwa abatatya Katonda, wabula abo abakwagala ku lulwo, abalina Ggwe wennyini nga lye ssanyu lyabwe. Era buno bwe bulamu obw’essanyu, okusanyuka eri Ggwe, mu Ggwe, ku lulwo; buno bwe buli, era tewali bulala. Kubanga abo abalowooza nti waliwo obulala, bagoberera essanyu eddala so si ery’amazima. Naye era okwagala kwabwe tekukyuka kuva ku kifaananyi ky’essanyu ekimu.

Essuula XXIII

Kale si kya kakasa nti bonna baagala okuba abasanyufu, kubanga abo abatayagala kusanyukira mu Ggwe, obwo bwokka bwe bulamu obw’essanyu, tebaagala ddala bulamu obw’essanyu. Oba bonna obulamu buno babwagala, naye olw’okuba nti okwegomba kw’omubiri kulwanagana n’Omwoyo, n’Omwoyo n’alwanagana n’omubiri, ne batasobola kukola bye baagala, bagwa ku ekyo kye basobola, ne bakimatira; kubanga ekyo kye batasobola kukola, tebakyagala n’amaanyi agamala okubasobozesa okukikola? Kubanga mbuuza buli muntu: asinga kwagala kusanyukira mu mazima oba mu bulimba? Tebajja kulonzalonza kugamba nti “mu mazima,” nga bwe batalonzalonza kugamba nti “baagala okuba abasanyufu,” kubanga obulamu obw’essanyu kwe kusanyukira mu mazima: kubanga kuno kwe kusanyukira mu Ggwe, Ggwe Mazima, Ayi Katonda omusana gwange, obulamu bw’amaaso gange, Katonda wange. Buno bwe bulamu obw’essanyu bonna bwe baagala; obulamu buno bwokka obw’essanyu, bonna babwagala; okusanyukira mu mazima, bonna kwe baagala. Nsisinkanye bangi abaagala okulimba; naye ayagala okulimbibwa, sirabangako n’omu. Kale obulamu buno obw’essanyu baabumanyira wa, bwe kitali awo we baamanyira n’amazima?
