Kubanga omuntu bw’afuulibwa omuggya mu birowoozo bye, n’alaba era n’ategeera amazima go, teyeetaaga muntu kumulungamya, alyoke agoberere ngeri ye; wabula olw’okulungamya kwo akakasa okwagala kwo okulungi, okusiimibwa, era okutuukiridde bwe kuli: weewaawo, Ggwe omuyigiriza, kaakano ng’afuuliddwa asobola, okwawula Obusatu bw’Obumu, n’Obumu bw’Obusatu. Noolwekyo ku ekyo ekyayogerwa mu bungi, Tukole omuntu, kyongerwako mu bumu, Bw’atyo Katonda n’atonda omuntu: ne ku ekyo ekyayogerwa mu bungi, Mu ngeri yaffe, kyongerwako mu bumu, Mu kifaananyi kya Katonda. Bw’atyo omuntu bw’afuulibwa omuggya mu kumanya Katonda, mu kifaananyi ky’oyo eyamutonda: era bw’afuulibwa ow’omwoyo, akebera ebintu byonna (ebintu byonna ebisaanidde okukeberwa), naye ye kennyini tewali n’omu amukebera. Essuula XXIII Naye okuba nti akebera ebintu byonna, kino kikwatagana n’okuba nti afuga ebyennyanja eby’omu nnyanja, n’ebinyonyi eby’omu bbanga, n’ente zonna n’ensolo ez’omu nsiko, n’ensi yonna, na buli ekyewalulira ku nsi kyonna. Kubanga kino akikola olw’okutegeera kw’ebirowoozo bye, mw’afunira bintu bya Mwoyo wa Katonda; so nga bwe kitaba bwe kityo, omuntu eyateekebwa mu kitiibwa teyategeera, n’agerageranyizibwa n’ensolo ezitalina magezi, n’afuuka nga zo. Noolwekyo mu Kkanisa yo, Ayi Katonda waffe, ng’ekisa kyo bwe kiri kye wagiwa (kubanga tuli mulimu gwo, abaatondebwa okukolanga ebikolwa ebirungi), si abo bokka abateekeddwa mu bwakulembeze mu mwoyo, naye n’abo abagondera mu mwoyo abo abaabateekebwako,—kubanga mu ngeri eno mwe wakolera omuntu omusajja n’omukazi, mu kisa kyo eky’omwoyo, mwe wataba, ku bikwata ku kikula ky’omubiri, musajja wadde mukazi, kubanga tewali Muyudaaya wadde Muyonaani, wadde muddu wadde wa ddembe.—Abantu ab’omwoyo (oba abo abakulembera, oba abo abagondera); basala emisango mu mwoyo; si ku kumanya kuli okw’omwoyo okwakira mu bbanga (kubanga tebasaanidde kusalira musango buyinza obwa waggulu bwe butyo), era tebayinza kusalira Kitabo kyo kyennyini musango, newaakubadde nga waliwo ekitayakira bulungi omwo; kubanga tugondeza okutegeera kwaffe gye kiri, era tukakasa nti n’ekyo ekiggaddwa mu maaso gaffe kyogeddwa mu butuufu ne mu mazima. Kubanga bw’atyo omuntu, newaakubadde nga kaakano wa mwoyo era afuuliddwa omuggya mu kumanya Katonda mu kifaananyi ky’oyo eyamutonda, asaanidde okuba omukozi w’etteeka, so si omusazi w’omusango. So tasalira musango enjawulo eri wakati w’abantu ab’omwoyo n’ab’omubiri, abamanyiddwa mu maaso go, Ayi Katonda waffe, era abatannaba kweraga gye tuli mu bikolwa, tulyoke tubategeerere ku bibala byabwe: naye Ggwe, Ayi Mukama, obamanyi ne kaakano, era wabaawula n’obayita mu kyama, ebbanga nga terinnakolebwa. So ye, newaakubadde nga wa mwoyo, tasalira musango abantu ab’ensi eno abatateredde; kubanga afaayo ki okusalira ab’ebweru omusango, nga tamanyi ani ku bo alijja oluvannyuma mu buwoomi bw’ekisa kyo; era ani alisigala mu bukaawu obutaggwaawo obw’obutatya Katonda? Kale omuntu, gwe watonda mu kifaananyi kyo, teyaweebwa buyinza ku byaka eby’omu ggulu, wadde ku ggulu eryo ery’ekyama lyennyini, wadde ku misana n’ekiro, bye wayita nga eggulu terinnateekebwawo, wadde ku mazzi agakuŋŋaanye, ye nnyanja; wabula ye yaweebwa obuyinza ku ebyennyanja eby’omu nnyanja, n’ebinyonyi eby’omu bbanga, ne ku nsolo zonna, ne ku nsi yonna, ne ku buli ekyewalula ekyewalulira ku nsi. Kubanga ye asala omusango, n’akkiriza ky’alaba nga kituufu, n’agaana ky’alaba nga kikyamu, oba mu kukuza Ssakramentu ezo abantu ng’abo mwe batandikirwa, ng’okusaasira kwo bwe kubanoonya mu mazzi amangi; oba mu ekyo Ekyennyanja kiri mwe kiweerwayo, ekyo ensi etya Katonda ky’erya nga kimaze okuggibwa mu buziba; oba mu bigambo n’obubonero bw’ebigambo, ebifugibwa obuyinza bw’Ekitabo kyo,—obubonero ng’obwo obuva mu kamwa ne buvuga, nga bubuuka ng’obuli wansi w’ebbanga, mu kutaputa, mu kunnyonnyola, mu kwogera, mu kuwakana, mu kutukuza, oba mu kukusaba Ggwe, abantu balyoke baddemu nti, Amiina. Ebigambo ebyo byonna okwatulwa n’eddoboozi kiva ku buziba bw’ensi eno, n’obuzibe bw’omubiri, obutasobola kulaba birowoozo; kale kyetaagisa okwogerera waggulu mu matu; bwe kityo, newaakubadde ebinyonyi ebibuuka byala ku nsi, naye entandikwa yaabyo eva mu mazzi. Omuntu ow’omwoyo era asala omusango ng’akkiriza ekituufu, n’agaana ky’alaba nga kikyamu, mu bikolwa ne mu bulamu bw’abeesigwa; mu birabo byabwe eri abaavu, ng’ensi ereeta ebibala; ne ku mmeeme ennamu, ennamu olw’okufuga okwegomba kwayo, mu bulongoofu, mu kusiiba, mu kufumiitiriza okutukuvu; ne ku bintu ebyo ebitegeerwa n’ebiwulizi by’omubiri. Ku ebyo byonna kaakano kyogerwa nti asala omusango, era ku byo alina n’obuyinza okulongoosa. Essuula XXIV Naye kino kiki, era kyama kya ngeri ki? Laba, Ayi Mukama, owa abantu omukisa, balyoke bazaale bale, bajjuze ensi; kale ekyo tokituwamu kabonero tutegeere ekintu? Lwaki era tewawa mukisa obutangaavu, bwe wayita emisana, wadde ebbanga ly’eggulu, wadde ebyaka, wadde emmunyeenye, wadde ensi, wadde ennyanja? Nnandigambye nti Ggwe, Ayi Katonda, eyatutonda mu kifaananyi kyo, nnandigambye nti kyakusanyusa okuwa omuntu yekka omukisa guno ogw’enjawulo; singa tewawa bw’otyo ebyennyanja n’ebitonde ebinene ennyo eby’omu nnyanja omukisa, bizaale byale, bijjuze amazzi g’ennyanja, n’ebinyonyi byale ku nsi. Era nnandigambye nti omukisa guno gwali gwa bitonde ebyo byokka ebizaalibwa okuva mu kika kyabyo, singa nnasanga nga guweereddwa emiti egy’ebibala, n’ebimera, n’ensolo ez’oku nsi. Naye kaakano, ebimera, wadde emiti, wadde ensolo, wadde emisota, tebigambiddwa nti, Muzaale mwale; newaakubadde nga ebyo byonna, okufaanana ng’ebyennyanja, ebinyonyi, oba abantu, byeyongera ne bikuuma ekika kyabyo nga bizaala. Kale ŋŋambe ki, Ayi Mazima, Musana gwange? “nti kyayogerwa bwereere, nga tekirina makulu?” Si bwe kiri, Ayi Kitaffe ow’okusinza okw’amazima; kireme okubaawo, omuweereza w’ekigambo kyo okwogera bw’atyo. Era bwe sitegeera ky’otegeeza mu kigambo ekyo, abansinga, kwe kugamba, abalina okutegeera okusinga okwange, bakikozese bulungi okusinga nze, nga Ggwe, Katonda wange, bw’owadde buli muntu okutegeera. Naye n’okwatula kwange kusanyuse mu maaso go, mwe nkwatulira nti nzikiriza, Ayi Mukama, nti tewayogera bw’otyo bwereere; era sijja kukweka ekyo essomo lino kye linjijukiza. Kubanga kya mazima, era siraba kiyinza kunziyiza kutegeera bwe ntyo ebigambo eby’ebifaananyi eby’omu Bayibuli yo. Kubanga mmanyi nti ekintu kimu kiyinza okulagibwa mu ngeri nnyingi n’ebigambo eby’omubiri, ate nga kitegeerwa mu ngeri emu mu magezi; era nti ekitegeerwa mu ngeri nnyingi mu magezi kiyinza okulagibwa mu ngeri emu n’ebigambo eby’omubiri. Laba, okwagala okumu okwa Katonda n’okwa muliraanwa waffe, nga kwolesebwa mu mubiri mu Ssakramentu nnyingi ennyo, ne mu nnimi ezitabalika, ne mu buli lulimi, mu ngeri z’okwogera ezitabalika bwe zityo. Bwe bityo ebizaalibwa mu mazzi bwe bizaala ne byala. Era weetegereze, ggwe yenna asoma kino; laba, ekyo Ebyawandiikibwa kye bituwa, era eddoboozi kye lyatula mu ngeri emu yokka, nti Ku lubereberye Katonda yatonda eggulu n’ensi; kale tekitegeerwa mu ngeri nnyingi, si lwa bulimba bwa nsobi, wabula olw’amakulu ag’amazima ag’engeri ez’enjawulo? Bwe lityo ezzadde ly’abantu bwe lizaala ne lyala. Kale bwe tulowooza ku butonde bw’ebintu byennyini, si mu ngero, wabula mu makulu gaabyo amatuufu, olwo ekigambo nti muzaale mwale kituukirira ku bintu byonna ebiva mu nsigo. Naye bwe tutwala ebigambo ng’ebyayogerwa mu bifaananyi (ekyo kye ndowooza okuba ekigendererwa ky’Ebyawandiikibwa, ebitayinza, mazima, kuwa bwereere omukisa guno ezzadde ly’ebiramu eby’omu mazzi n’ery’omuntu bokka); olwo tusanga nti “obungi” kituukira ku bitonde eby’omwoyo n’eby’omubiri, nga mu ggulu ne mu nsi; ne ku batuukirivu n’abatali batuukirivu, nga mu butangaavu ne mu kizikiza; ne ku bawandiisi abatukuvu abaatubeerera abaweereza b’Amateeka, nga mu bbanga eriteekebwawo wakati w’amazzi n’amazzi; ne ku kibiina ky’abantu abakyali mu bukaawu bw’obutakkiriza, nga mu nnyanja; ne ku bunyiikivu bw’emmeeme entukuvu, nga mu lukalu; ne ku bikolwa eby’okusaasira eby’obulamu buno obwa kaakano, nga mu bimera ebireeta ensigo ne mu miti egibala ebibala; ne ku birabo eby’omwoyo ebyolesebwa olw’okuzimba, nga mu byaka eby’omu ggulu; ne ku kwegomba okutendekeddwa okwefuga, nga mu mmeeme ennamu. Mu byonna ebyo tusangamu obungi, ebingi, n’okweyongera; naye ekyo ekinaazaala ne kyala mu ngeri nti ekintu kimu kiyinza okwogerwa mu ngeri nnyingi, n’ekyogerwa ekimu ne kitegeerwa mu ngeri nnyingi, tetukisanga, okuggyako mu bubonero obwogerwa mu mubiri, ne mu bintu ebitegeerwa mu birowoozo. Mu bubonero obwogerwa mu mubiri tutegeera ebizaalibwa amazzi, ebyetaagisa olw’obuziba bw’omubiri; mu bintu ebitegeerwa mu birowoozo, ebizaalibwa abantu, olw’obugimu bw’amagezi. Era olw’ensonga eyo tukkiriza nti Ggwe, Mukama, wagamba ebika bino nti, Muzaale mwale. Kubanga mu mukisa guno ndowooza nti watuwa obuyinza n’obusobozi, okwogera mu ngeri nnyingi kye tutegeera nga kimu, era okutegeera mu ngeri nnyingi kye tusoma nga kyayogerwa mu ngeri emu, mu ngeri enzibu okutegeera. Bwe gatyo amazzi g’ennyanja bwe gajjula, agatayuguumizibwa wabula amakulu ag’enjawulo: bw’etyo n’ensi bw’ejjula olw’okweyongera kw’abantu, obukalu bwayo obulabikira mu kuyaayaana kwayo, era amagezi ge gagifuga. Essuula XXV Era nandyagadde okwogera, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, ekyo Ekyawandiikibwa ekiddako kye kinjijukiza; weewaawo, nja kwogera, era sijja kutya. Kubanga nja kwogera amazima, Ggwe wennyini ng’onzizaamu ekyo kye wayagala njogere okuva mu bigambo ebyo. Naye sikkiriza nti njogera amazima olw’okuluŋŋamizibwa okulala kwonna okuggyako okwo okuva gy’Oli, kubanga Ggwe oli Mazima, era buli muntu yenna mulimba. Kale oyo ayogera eby’obulimba ayogera ebiva mu bibye; noolwekyo ndyoke njogere amazima, nja kwogera ebiva mu bibyo. Laba, otuwadde okuba emmere buli kimera eky’ensigo ekiri ku nsi na buli muti ogw’ensigo mu kibala kyagwo. Era si ffe ffekka, naye n’ebinyonyi byonna eby’omu bbanga, n’ensolo ez’oku nsi, ne byonna ebyewalula; naye ebyennyanja n’ebitonde ebinene ennyo eby’omu nnyanja tobiwadde. Kaakano twagamba nti ebibala bino eby’ensi bitegeeza, era bifaananyizibwa mu ngero, ebikolwa eby’okusaasira ebitegekebwa okutuukiriza ebyetaago by’obulamu buno okuva mu nsi engimu. Ensi ng’eyo ye yali Onesifolo eyatyanga Katonda, ab’omu nnyumba ye be wakwatirwa ekisa, kubanga emirundi mingi yabeesabeesa Pawulo wo, era teyakwatirwa nsonyi lwa lujegere lwe. Bwe batyo n’abooluganda abaava e Makedoniya bwe baakola, era ebibala ng’ebyo bye baabala, bwe baamuwa bye yali abulwa. Naye nga yanakuwala nnyo olw’emiti egimu egitaamuwa bibala ebyamugwanira, bw’agamba nti, Mu kuwoza kwange okwasooka, tewaali n’omu yajja kubeera nange, bonna banjabulira. Nsaba Katonda ekyo kireme kubavunaanibwa. Kubanga ebibala bino bigwanira abo abatuweereza okuyigiriza okw’omwoyo okuva mu kutegeera kwabwe ebyama bya Katonda; era bibagwanira, ng’abantu; weewaawo era bibagwanira, ng’emmeeme ennamu, eyeewaayo okuba ekyokulabirako mu kwefuga kwonna; era bibagwanira, ng’ebitonde ebibuuka, olw’emikisa gyabwe egyala ku nsi, kubanga eddoboozi lyabwe lyabuna mu nsi zonna. Essuula XXVI Naye abaliisibwa ebibala bino be babisanyukira; so tebabisanyukira abo okulya kubafuukidde katonda waabwe. Kubanga ne mu abo ababigaba, ekibala si bye bagaba, wabula omutima gwe babigabisa. Kale oyo eyaweereza Katonda, so si lubuto lwe, ndaba bulungi lwaki yasanyuka; nkiraba, era nsanyuka wamu naye. Kubanga yali afunye okuva eri Abafiripi bye baamuweereza nga bayita mu Epafuladito; naye ndaba lwaki yasanyuka. Kubanga ekyo kye yasanyukira, kye yaliisibwa; kubanga, ng’ayogera amazima, agamba nti, Nasanyuka nnyo mu Mukama waffe, kubanga kaakano oluvannyuma lw’ebbanga muzzeemu okundowoozaako buggya, kye mwali mweraliikirira, naye nga kyali kibakooyesezza. Kale Abafiripi bano baali bakaze olw’obukoowu obw’ebbanga eddene, ne bawotoka ng’abatakyasobola kubala kibala kino eky’ekikolwa ekirungi; era abasanyukira bo, kubanga baddamu okuloka, so si ku lulwe, kubanga baamuwa bye yali abulwa. Kyova ayongerako nti, Soogera kino olwokubanga Ndiko kye nneetaaga, kubanga mu buli mbeera gye mbaamu nayiga okumalibwanga. Mmanyi okubeera nga sirina kantu, era mmanyi okuba nga nnina buli kimu. Mu buli ngeri ne mu bintu byonna nayiga ekyama ekiri mu kukkusibwa ne mu kuba omuyala, mu kuba n’ebingi ne mu bwetaavu. Nnyinza okukola byonna mu oyo ampa amaanyi. Kale kiki ky’osanyukira, Ayi Pawulo omukulu? kiki ky’osanyukira? kiki ky’oliisibwa, ggwe omuntu, afuuliddwa omuggya mu kutegeera Katonda, mu kifaananyi ky’oyo eyakutonda, ggwe emmeeme ennamu ey’okwefuga okwenkanidde awo, ggwe olulimi olufaanana ebinyonyi ebibuuka, oyogera ebyama? (kubanga ebitonde ng’ebyo bye bigwanira emmere eno;) kiki ekikuliisa? essanyu. Tuwulire ebiddako: Kyokka mukola bulungi okulumirirwa awamu nange mu kubonaabona kwange. Ekyo ky’asanyukira, ekyo ky’aliisibwa; kubanga baakola bulungi, so si kubanga obuzibu bwe bwakendeezebwa, oyo agamba Ggwe nti, Wangaziya bwe nnali mu nnaku; kubanga yali amanyi okuba n’ebingi, n’okubulwa, mu Ggwe amuwa amaanyi. Kubanga (bw’agamba) Mmwe, Abafiripi, mumanyi nti bwe nava e Makedoniya nga nakatandika okubuulira Enjiri, tewali Kkanisa n’emu eyampaayo akantu olw’ebyo bye yafuna okuggyako mmwe mwekka. Kubanga ddala ddala bwe nnali mu Sessaloniika mwampeereza emirundi ebiri mu bwetaavu bwange. Kaakano asanyuka nti bakomyewo ku bikolwa bino ebirungi; era asanyuka nti baddamu okuloka, ng’ennimiro engimu bw’eddamu okuba eya kiragala. Kale yasanyuka olw’ebyetaago bye ye, kubanga yagamba nti, Mwampeereza mu bwetaavu bwange? Ekyo ky’asanyukira? Mazima si ekyo. Naye tukimanya tutya? Kubanga ye yennyini amangu ago agamba nti, Soogera kino lwa kubanga njagala okufuna ekirabo, wabula njagala ekibala. Nayiga okuva gy’Oli, Katonda wange, okwawula wakati w’ekirabo n’ekibala. Ekirabo kye kintu kyennyini ekiweebwa oyo atuwa ebyetaagisa bino; nga ssente, emmere, eby’okunywa, engoye, aw’okusula, obuyambi: naye ekibala kwe kwagala okulungi era okutuufu okw’oyo agaba. Kubanga Omuyigiriza Omulungi teyagamba bugambi nti, Oyo asembeza nnabbi, wabula n’ayongerako nti, mu linnya lya nnabbi: so teyagamba bugambi nti, Oyo asembeza omuntu omutuukirivu, wabula n’ayongerako nti, mu linnya ly’omuntu omutuukirivu. Bwe kityo omu alifuna empeera y’emu nga nnabbi, n’omulala empeera y’omutuukirivu: so teyagamba bugambi nti, Buli aliwa omu ku baana bano abato egiraasi y’amazzi agannyogoga; wabula n’ayongerako nti, olw’erinnya ly’omuyigirizwa: n’amaliriza nti, Ddala ddala mbagamba nti talirema kuweebwa mpeera ye. Ekirabo kwe kusembeza nnabbi, okusembeza omuntu omutuukirivu, okuwa omuyigirizwa egiraasi y’amazzi agannyogoga: naye ekibala kwe kukola ekyo mu linnya lya nnabbi, mu linnya ly’omuntu omutuukirivu, mu linnya ly’omuyigirizwa. Eriya yaliisibwa ekibala nnamwandu eyali amanyi nti aliisa omusajja wa Katonda, era kyeyava amuliisa: naye nnamuŋŋoona yamuliisa ekirabo. So si muntu wa munda owa Eriya eyaliisibwa bw’atyo, wabula ow’ebweru yekka; ono yandisobodde n’okuzikirira olw’okubulwa emmere eyo. Essuula XXVII Kale nja kwogera ekiri eky’amazima mu maaso go, Ayi Mukama, nti abantu ab’omubiri n’abatakkiriza (abo okubakyusa n’okubatandika, Ssakramentu ez’entandikwa n’emirimu egy’amaanyi egy’ebyamagero byetaagisa, bye tulowooza okutegeezebwa erinnya ly’ebyennyanja n’ebitonde ebinene ennyo eby’omu nnyanja) bwe bawummuza omubiri gw’omuddu wo, oba bwe bamuyamba mu ngeri endala n’ekintu eky’omugaso mu bulamu buno obwa kaakano; naye nga tebamanyi lwaki kino kisaanye okukolebwa, era ku lwa nsonga ki; bo tebaliisa bano, so ne bano tebaliisibwa bo; kubanga abo tebakikola na kigendererwa kitukuvu era kituufu; so ne bano tebasanyukira birabo byabwe, kubanga ekibala kyabyo tebannakiraba. Kubanga omutima guliisibwa ekyo kye gusanyukira. Era kyebiva ebyennyanja n’ebitonde ebinene ennyo eby’omu nnyanja nga tebiriisibwa mmere ng’eyo, ensi gy’etaleeta okutuusa ng’emaze okwawulibwa n’okweyawula ku bukaawu bw’amayengo g’ennyanja. Essuula XXVIII Era Ggwe, Ayi Katonda, walaba buli kintu kye wakola, era, laba, kyali kirungi nnyo. Weewaawo naffe tukiraba bwe kityo, era laba, ebintu byonna birungi nnyo. Ku bika by’emirimu gyo ebya buli ngeri, bwe wamala okugamba nti “bibeewo,” ne bibaawo, walaba buli kimu nga kirungi. Emirundi musanvu mbaze nga kyawandiikibwa nti walaba ekyo kye wakola nga kirungi: era guno gwe gw’omunaana, nti walaba buli kintu kye wakola, era, laba, nga si kirungi kyokka, naye nga kirungi nnyo, kubanga kaakano byali wamu byonna. Kubanga kinnakimu byali birungi kyokka; naye byonna awamu, birungi, era birungi nnyo. Emibiri gyonna egy’endabika ennungi gikyoleka; kubanga omubiri ogugattiddwa n’ebitundu byonna ebirungi gusinga nnyo obulungi ebitundu ebyo byennyini nga biri byokka, ebituukiriza ekyo kyonna olw’okugattibwa kwabyo mu ntegeka ennungi; newaakubadde nga n’ebitundu kinnakimu nabyo birungi. Essuula XXIX Era ne nneetegereza nnyo okumanya oba nga emirundi musanvu oba munaana walaba emirimu gyo nga mirungi, bwe gyakusanyusa; naye mu kulaba kwo saasangamu biseera, mwe nnandisobodde okutegeera nti walaba emirundi egyenkanidde awo ebyo bye wakola. Ne ŋŋamba nti, “Mukama, Ebyawandiikibwa bino ebyo tebiri bya mazima, kubanga Ggwe oli wa mazima, era nga oli Mazima ggwe wabiteekawo? kale lwaki ongamba nti, ‘mu kulaba kwo temuli biseera’; so nga Ebyawandiikibwa byo bino bingamba nti ekyo kye wakola buli lunaku, walaba nga kirungi: era bwe nnabibala, ne nzuula emirundi emeka.” Ku kino onziramu, kubanga oli Katonda wange, era n’eddoboozi ery’amaanyi ogamba omuddu wo mu kutu kwe okw’omunda, ng’omenya obuggavu bw’amatu gange era ng’oyogerera waggulu nti, “Ggwe omuntu, ekyo Ebyawandiikibwa byange kye bigamba, Nze nkyogera: naye byo byogera mu biseera; so ebiseera tebirina kakwate na Kigambo kyange; kubanga Ekigambo kyange kibeerawo mu butaggwaawo obwenkanankana n’obwange. Bwe kityo ebintu bye mulaba nga muyita mu Mwoyo wange, Nze mbiraba; nga bwe kiri nti ebyo bye mwogera mu Mwoyo wange, Nze mbyogera. Kale bwe mulaba ebintu ebyo mu biseera, Nze sibiraba mu biseera; nga bwe mwogera mu biseera, Nze sibyogera mu biseera.” Essuula XXX Ne mpulira, Ayi Mukama Katonda wange, ne nnywa ettondo ly’obuwoomi okuva mu mazima go, ne ntegeera nti waliwo abantu abamu abatasiima mirimu gyo; abagamba nti emingi ku gyo wagikola ng’okakiddwa obwetaavu; ng’enkula y’eggulu, n’entegeka ennungi ey’emmunyeenye; era nti tewagikola mu ebyo ebyali ebibyo, wabula nti byali bitondeddwa walala okuva mu nsibuko endala, ggwe olyoke obikuŋŋaanye, obigatte era obiyunge, bwe wazimba bbugwe w’ensi yonna okuva mu balabe bo be wawangula; bo, nga basibiddwa mu kizimbe ekyo, baleme kuddamu kukujeemera. Ku bintu ebirala bagamba nti tewabikola, wadde okubigatta, ng’ebiramu byonna eby’omubiri n’ebitonde byonna ebitonotono ennyo, ne buli ekirina emmirandira mu ttaka; wabula nti endowooza ekulwanyisa, n’obutonde obulala obutaatondebwa Ggwe, obukontana naawe, bye byazaala ne bikola ebintu ebyo mu bitundu bino ebya wansi eby’ensi. Balalu abo aboogera bwe batyo, kubanga tebalaba mirimu gyo mu Mwoyo wo, so tebakutegeerera mu gyo. Essuula XXXI Naye abo abalaba ebintu bino mu Mwoyo wo, Ggwe olaba mu bo. Kale bwe balaba nga ebintu bino birungi, Ggwe olaba nga birungi; era buli ekisanyusa ku lulwo, Ggwe osanyusa mu kyo, era ebyo ebitusanyusa nga biyita mu Mwoyo wo, bikusanyusa Ggwe mu ffe. Kubanga muntu ki ategeera eby’omuntu omulala okuggyako omwoyo w’omuntu oyo ali mu ffe? Noolwekyo n’ebintu bya Katonda tewali abimanyi okuggyako Omwoyo wa Katonda. Era kaakano (bw’agamba) ffe tetwafuna mwoyo wa ku nsi, wabula Omwoyo eyava eri Katonda, tulyoke tumanye ebintu Katonda bye yatuwa obuwa. Ne nnabulirwa nti, “Mazima ebintu bya Katonda tewali abimanyi okuggyako Omwoyo wa Katonda: kale naffe tumanya tutya ebintu Katonda by’atuwa?” Ne nziramu nti; “kubanga ebintu bye tumanya mu Mwoyo we, n’ebyo tewali abimanyi okuggyako Omwoyo wa Katonda. Kubanga nga bwe kyayogerwa obulungi eri abo abaali bagenda okwogera mu Mwoyo wa Katonda nti, si mmwe mugenda okwogera: bwe kityo kyogerwa bulungi eri abo abamanya nga bayita mu Mwoyo wa Katonda nti, ‘Si mmwe mumanya.’ Era nga bwe kyogerwa obulungi eri abo abalaba nga bayita mu Mwoyo wa Katonda nti, ‘Si mmwe mulaba’; bwe kityo buli kye balaba nga kirungi nga bayita mu Mwoyo wa Katonda, si bo, wabula Katonda y’alaba nga kirungi.” Kale kintu kimu omuntu okulowooza nti ekirungi kibi, ng’abo be twogeddeko waggulu bwe bakola; kirala, omuntu okulaba ekirungi nga kirungi (ng’ebitonde byo bwe bisanyusa bangi, kubanga birungi, naye nga Ggwe tobasanyusa mu byo, bwe baagala okubyesiimisa okusinga Ggwe); era kirala, omuntu bw’alaba ekintu nga kirungi, Katonda okulaba mu ye nga kirungi, kwe kugamba nti Ye ayagalibwe mu ekyo kye yakola, Ye atayinza kwagalibwa wabula olw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, Oyo gwe yatuwa. Kubanga okwagala kwa Katonda kufukiddwa mu mitima gyaffe Omwoyo Omutukuvu gwe twaweebwa: Oyo mwe tulabira nti buli ekiriwo mu ddaala lyonna, kirungi. Kubanga kiva gy’Ali Oyo, yennyini atali mu ddaala, wabula ky’Ali, Ali. Essuula XXXII Webale, Ayi Mukama. Tulaba eggulu n’ensi, oba ekitundu eky’omubiri, ekya waggulu n’ekya wansi, oba ekitonde eky’omwoyo n’eky’omubiri; era mu kulungiya ebitundu bino, ebikola entuumo yonna ey’ensi, oba okusingawo, obutonde bwonna, tulaba obutangaavu nga butondeddwa, era nga bwawuliddwa ku kizikiza. Tulaba ebbanga ly’eggulu, oba omubiri ogwo ogwasooka ogw’ensi, wakati w’amazzi ag’omwoyo aga waggulu n’amazzi ag’omubiri aga wansi, oba (kubanga n’eryo liyitibwa eggulu) ebbanga lino ery’empewo ebinyonyi eby’omu ggulu mwe bitambulira, wakati w’amazzi ago agasitulwa waggulu waabyo mu lufu, ne mu biro eby’ekiro ebitangaavu ne gatonnya ng’omusulo; n’amazzi ago amazito agakulukutira ku nsi. Tulaba endabika y’amazzi agakuŋŋaanye mu nnimiro z’ennyanja; n’olukalu, mu kusooka nga lwereere, ate nga lutondeddwa okulabika n’okutegekebwa obulungi, weewaawo n’ekirungo ky’ebimera n’emiti. Tulaba ebyaka nga byaka okuva waggulu, enjuba okumala emisana, omwezi n’emmunyeenye okusanyusa ekiro; era nti mu ebyo byonna, ebiro bimanyibwe era biragibwe. Tulaba buli wamu obutonde obubisi, nga bujjudde ebyennyanja, ebisolo, n’ebinyonyi; kubanga obunene bw’empewo, obusitula okubuuka kw’ebinyonyi, bweyongera obuzito olw’olufu oluva mu mazzi. Tulaba endabika y’ensi ng’eyooyooteddwa ebitonde eby’oku nsi, n’omuntu, eyatondebwa mu kifaananyi kyo ne mu ngeri yo, ng’ayita mu kifaananyi kyo ekyo kyennyini ne mu ngeri yo (kwe kugamba obuyinza bw’amagezi n’okutegeera), ng’ateekeddwa okufuga ebitonde byonna ebitalina magezi. Era nga mu mmeeme ye bwe mulimu obuyinza obumu obufuga nga bulagira, n’obulala obufugibwa, bulyoke buwulire; bwe kityo omusajja yatonderwa, ne mu mubiri, omukazi, ow’obutonde obwenkanankana n’obubwe mu magezi ag’okutegeera kwe okw’endowooza, naye mu kikula ky’omubiri gwe, abeera wansi w’ekikula ky’omusajja we mu ngeri y’emu, ng’okwegomba okw’okukola bwe kwagala okuggya okumanya okukola obulungi mu magezi ag’omutima. Ebyo tubiraba, era birungi kinnakimu, era byonna awamu birungi nnyo. Essuula XXXIII Emirimu gyo gikutendereze, tulyoke tukwagale; era ka tukwagale, emirimu gyo gilyoke gikutendereze, egirina okuva mu biseera entandikwa n’enkomerero, okuvaayo n’okugwa, okukula n’okuvunda, enkula n’okubulwa enkula. Kale girina okuddiriŋŋana kwagyo okw’enkya n’akawungeezi, egimu mu kyama, egirala mu lwatu; kubanga gyakolebwa Ggwe okuva mu butaliiko kintu, so si okuva mu Ggwe; si mu kirungo kyonna ekitali kikyo, oba ekyali kisooka, wabula mu kirungo ekyatondebwa awamu nagyo (kwe kugamba, ekyatondebwa Ggwe mu kiseera kye kimu), kubanga ekirungo ekyo mu mbeera yaakyo eteriiko nkula, Ggwe, awatali kiseera kyonna wakati, wakiwa enkula. Kubanga ekirungo ky’eggulu n’ensi bwe kiri ekintu kimu, n’enkula kintu kirala, ekirungo wakikola okuva mu butaliiko ddala kintu, naye enkula y’ensi okuva mu kirungo ekitaliiko nkula: naye byombi omulundi gumu, enkula n’egoberera ekirungo awatali kulwawo kwonna. Essuula XXXIV Era twetegerezza n’ekyo kye wayagala kifaanaganyizibwe, oba mu kutonda, oba mu nkolagana y’ebintu mu nsengeka eyo. Era twalaba nti ebintu kinnakimu birungi, era byonna awamu birungi nnyo, mu Kigambo kyo, mu Mwana wo Omu Yekka, eggulu n’ensi, Omutwe n’omubiri gw’Ekkanisa, mu kuteekateeka kwo okwaliwo ng’ebiro byonna tebinnabaawo, awatali nkya na kawungeezi. Naye bwe watandika okutuukiriza mu biseera ebyo bye wali oteeseteese, olw’okubikkula ebyakwekebwa, n’okutereeza obutali butebenkevu bwaffe; kubanga ebibi byaffe byali bitulengejjeko waggulu, era twali tusse mu buziba obw’ekizikiza; era Omwoyo wo omulungi n’atambulira waggulu waffe, okutuyamba mu kiseera ekituufu; era n’oleetera abatatya Katonda okuweebwa obutuukirivu, n’obaawula ku babi; era n’okola ebbanga ery’obuyinza bw’Ekitabo kyo wakati w’abo abaateekebwa waggulu, abaali ab’okukuwulira n’obuwombeefu, n’abo abaali wansi, abaali ab’okubagondera: era n’okuŋŋaanya ekibiina ky’abatakkiriza mu lukwe lumu, obunyiikivu bw’abeesigwa bulyoke bulabike, era bazaale ebikolwa eby’ekisa, nga bagabira n’abaavu obugagga bwabwe obw’oku nsi, balyoke bafune obw’omu ggulu. Oluvannyuma lw’ebyo n’okoleeza ebitangaala ebimu mu bbanga, Abatukuvu bo, abalina ekigambo eky’obulamu; era nga bayakaayakana n’obuyinza obw’ekitiibwa obwateekebwa waggulu olw’ebirabo eby’omwoyo; ate oluvannyuma lw’ebyo, olw’okuyingiza Abamawanga abatakkiriza, n’oggya mu bintu eby’omubiri Amasakalamentu, n’ebyamagero ebirabika, n’engeri z’ebigambo ezikwatagana n’ebbanga ly’Ekitabo kyo, abeesigwa mwe bandiweereddwa omukisa ne beeyongera obungi. Ate n’obumba emmeeme ennamu ey’abeesigwa, ng’oyita mu kwagala okutegekeddwa obulungi olw’amaanyi g’okwefuga: era oluvannyuma lw’ebyo, ebirowoozo ebikugondera Ggwe wekka era ebiteetaaga kugoberera buyinza bwa muntu yenna, n’obizza buggya mu kifaananyi kyo ne mu nfaanana yo; era n’ossa ebikolwa byabyo eby’amagezi wansi w’obukulu bw’okutegeera, ng’omukazi bw’agondera omusajja; era ku Bifo byonna eby’Obuweereza bwo, ebyetaagisa okutuukiriza abeesigwa mu bulamu buno, n’oyagala abeesigwa abo bennyini babiweereze ebintu ebirungi olw’ebyetaago byabwe eby’omu kiseera kino, ebinaabaleetera ebibala mu biseera ebigenda okujja. Ebyo byonna tubiraba, era birungi nnyo, kubanga Ggwe obiraba mu ffe, Ggwe atuwadde Omwoyo wo, mwe tuyinza okubiraba, era mu byo okukwagala Ggwe. Essuula XXXV Ayi Mukama Katonda, tuwe emirembe: (kubanga Ggwe otuwadde byonna;) emirembe egy’okuwummula, emirembe egya Ssabbiiti, egitaliiko kawungeezi. Kubanga enteekateeka eno yonna ennungi ennyo ey’ebintu ebirungi ennyo, bwe biriba bimaze emirimu gyabyo, eriggwaawo; kubanga mu byo mwalimu enkya n’akawungeezi. Essuula XXXVI Naye olunaku olw’omusanvu terulina kawungeezi, era terugwa; kubanga Ggwe walutukuza lubeerewo emirembe n’emirembe; ekyo kye wakola oluvannyuma lw’emirimu gyo egyali emirungi ennyo, ng’owummula ku lunaku olw’omusanvu, newakubadde nga wagikola ng’oli mu kuwummula okutasalako, eddoboozi ly’Ekitabo kyo lisobole okukitulangirira nga bukyali, nti naffe oluvannyuma lw’emirimu gyaffe (egiri emirungi ennyo ku lw’ekyo, kubanga Ggwe ogituwadde), tuliwummulira mu Ggwe naffe mu Ssabbiiti ey’obulamu obutaggwaawo. Essuula XXXVII Kubanga olwo oliwummulira mu ffe, nga bw’okolera mu ffe kaakano; era bw’atyo okuwummula okwo kuliba kwo okuyita mu ffe, nga emirimu gino bwe giri gyo egiyita mu ffe. Naye Ggwe, Mukama, okola bulijjo, era owummula bulijjo. Tolaba mu biseera, so tonyeenyezebwa mu biseera, so towummulira mu kiseera; naye era Ggwe oleeta ebintu ebirabibwa mu biseera, weewaawo n’ebiseera byennyini, n’okuwummula okuva mu biseera. Essuula XXXVIII Kale ffe tulaba ebintu bino bye wakola, kubanga biriwo: naye biriwo kubanga Ggwe obiraba. Era ffe tulaba ebweru nti biriwo, ne munda nti birungi; naye Ggwe wabiraba eyo, nga bimaze okukolebwa, gye wabirabira nga tebinnakolebwa. Era ffe mu kiseera eky’oluvannyuma twakubirizibwa okukola obulungi, emitima gyaffe bwe gyamala okufuna ekirowoozo ekiva eri Omwoyo wo; naye mu kiseera eky’edda twakubirizibwa okukola obubi, nga tukuvaako Ggwe; naye Ggwe, Katonda Omu, Omulungi, tewalekerawo kukola bulungi. Era naffe tulina ebikolwa ebirungi ebimu, olw’ekirabo kyo, naye tebiri bya mirembe na mirembe; oluvannyuma lwabyo tusuubira okuwummulira mu kutukuza kwo okunene. Naye Ggwe, ng’oli Omulungi ateetaaga kirungi kirala, owummula bulijjo, kubanga okuwummula kwo ye Ggwe wennyini. Era muntu ki ayinza okuyigiriza omuntu okutegeera kino? oba Malayika ki, Malayika? oba Malayika ki, omuntu? Kisabibwe gy’Oli, kinoonyezebwe mu Ggwe, kikonkonerwe gy’Oli; bwe kityo, bwe kityo bwe kirifunibwa, bwe kityo bwe kirizuulibwa, bwe kityo bwe kiriggulwawo. Amiina. Gratias Tibi Domine
